---
title: "Research Question 1: Baseline ctDNA Level and Duration of Complete Response"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

## Research Question

**What is the association between circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) level before starting a new line of therapy and duration of complete response?**

This analysis examines whether ctDNA levels measured before starting each new line of metastatic therapy are prognostic for duration of complete response in patients with metastatic urothelial carcinoma. The analysis includes all lines of therapy (1L, 2L, 3L+, not limited to first-line), with each line of therapy as a separate observation and time 0 defined as the start of each new line of therapy.

**Note on Endpoint Definition:** We analyze "Duration of Complete Response" (DCR), which represents the time from therapy initiation until loss of complete response or death. **Events** occur when: (1) the patient dies, OR (2) the patient is alive but has obvious disease present on most recent imaging (i.e., loss of complete response, similar to RECIST progression from CR). **Patients are censored** when they are alive and have no obvious disease on most recent imaging (i.e., maintaining complete response, similar to RECIST CR). This endpoint captures both survival and maintenance of complete response, which is clinically meaningful in the metastatic setting. Note: Patients with stable disease or partial response (but with disease still present on imaging) are considered events, as they have lost or never achieved complete response. **Important:** Patients who died do NOT require imaging data for inclusion (death is an event). Only alive patients require imaging data to determine complete response status.

```{r load_bajorin_data, include=FALSE}
# ====================================================================================
# Load Bajorin Risk Factors Data (KPS and Visceral Metastases)
# ====================================================================================
# Load data from ctDNA_Bajorin_Lexi.xlsx
# KPS: >=80% = 1, <80% = 0
# Visceral Mets: Yes/No

bajorin_data <- tryCatch({
  # Read Excel file - skip first row which is header
  bajorin_raw <- read_excel("ctDNA_Bajorin_Lexi.xlsx", sheet = 1, skip = 1)
  
  # Based on structure: Screener, Patient_ID, MRN, Therapy_Line, KPS, Visceral_Mets, Column7
  # Use column positions
  if (nrow(bajorin_raw) > 0 && ncol(bajorin_raw) >= 6) {
    # Extract columns by position
    bajorin_clean <- tibble(
      patient_id_raw = as.character(bajorin_raw[[2]]),  # Column 2: Patient ID
      therapy_line_raw = as.character(bajorin_raw[[4]]),  # Column 4: Therapy Line
      kps_raw = as.character(bajorin_raw[[5]]),  # Column 5: KPS (not column 6!)
      visceral_mets_raw = as.character(bajorin_raw[[6]])  # Column 6: Visceral Mets (not column 7!)
    ) %>%
      # Remove header rows (rows that contain "Patient", "ID", "Screener", etc.)
      filter(!str_detect(tolower(patient_id_raw), "patient|id|screener|mrn|therapy")) %>%
      filter(!is.na(patient_id_raw), patient_id_raw != "", patient_id_raw != "NA") %>%
      # Convert patient_id - may be numeric or character
      mutate(
        patient_id = as.character(patient_id_raw),
        # Convert therapy line: "1L" -> 1, "2L" -> 2, "3L" -> 3, "4L+" -> 4
        therapy_line = case_when(
          str_detect(toupper(therapy_line_raw), "^1L$") ~ 1,
          str_detect(toupper(therapy_line_raw), "^2L$") ~ 2,
          str_detect(toupper(therapy_line_raw), "^3L$") ~ 3,
          str_detect(toupper(therapy_line_raw), "^4L\\+") ~ 4,
          str_detect(therapy_line_raw, "^\\d+") ~ as.numeric(str_extract(therapy_line_raw, "^\\d+")),
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        ),
        # KPS: 1 = >=80%, 0 = <80%
        kps_binary = case_when(
          kps_raw == "1" | kps_raw == 1 ~ 1,
          kps_raw == "0" | kps_raw == 0 ~ 0,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        ),
        # Visceral metastases: Yes = 1, No = 0
        visceral_mets_binary = case_when(
          str_detect(tolower(visceral_mets_raw), "^yes$|^y$") ~ 1,
          str_detect(tolower(visceral_mets_raw), "^no$|^n$") ~ 0,
          TRUE ~ NA_real_
        )
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(patient_id), !is.na(therapy_line), patient_id != "") %>%
      select(patient_id, therapy_line, kps_binary, visceral_mets_binary)
    
    cat("Loaded Bajorin risk factors data:\n")
    cat("  Total observations:", nrow(bajorin_clean), "\n")
    cat("  Unique patients:", length(unique(bajorin_clean$patient_id)), "\n")
    cat("  KPS available:", sum(!is.na(bajorin_clean$kps_binary)), "\n")
    cat("  Visceral mets available:", sum(!is.na(bajorin_clean$visceral_mets_binary)), "\n")
    
    bajorin_clean
  } else {
    cat("Warning: Bajorin data file is empty or has insufficient columns.\n")
    tibble(patient_id = character(0), therapy_line = numeric(0), 
           kps_binary = numeric(0), visceral_mets_binary = numeric(0))
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  cat("Warning: Could not load Bajorin data file:", e$message, "\n")
  tibble(patient_id = character(0), therapy_line = numeric(0), 
         kps_binary = numeric(0), visceral_mets_binary = numeric(0))
})

# Check patient_id format matching
if (nrow(bajorin_data) > 0 && exists("universe") && nrow(universe) > 0) {
  sample_outcome_ids <- head(unique(universe$patient_id), 5)
  sample_bajorin_ids <- head(unique(bajorin_data$patient_id), 5)
  cat("\nSample patient IDs from outcomes:", paste(sample_outcome_ids, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Sample patient IDs from Bajorin data:", paste(sample_bajorin_ids, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  # Check if formats match
  if (any(sample_bajorin_ids %in% sample_outcome_ids)) {
    cat("Patient ID formats appear to match.\n")
  } else {
    cat("Note: Patient ID formats may differ. Will attempt to match.\n")
  }
}
```

```{r define_universe, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Universe: Patients at initial diagnosis of metastatic disease
# Either: (1) without prior treatment, OR (2) >6 months from anti-cancer directed therapy (radiation or systemic)
# ==============================

# Note: We no longer use "ctDNA at diagnosis" as a single anchor point
# Instead, we find ctDNA before each line of therapy (see universe definition below)

# Extract all therapy start dates and settings (systemic)
therapy_start_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*start.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
therapy_setting_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*treatment.*setting", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Get all systemic therapy dates and identify palliative therapy
all_systemic_therapy_dates <- tibble(patient_id = character(0), therapy_date = as.Date(character(0)), is_palliative = logical(0))
if (length(therapy_start_cols) > 0) {
  # Get therapy dates
  therapy_dates_long <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, any_of(therapy_start_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "therapy_var", values_to = "start_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(
      start_date = as_date_safe(start_date_raw),
      therapy_num = str_extract(therapy_var, "\\d+")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start_date)) %>%
    select(patient_id, therapy_num, therapy_date = start_date)
  
  # Get therapy settings if available
  if (length(therapy_setting_cols) > 0) {
    therapy_settings_long <- dat_combined %>%
      select(patient_id, any_of(therapy_setting_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "setting_var", values_to = "setting_raw") %>%
      mutate(
        setting = as.character(setting_raw),
        therapy_num = str_extract(setting_var, "\\d+")
      ) %>%
      select(patient_id, therapy_num, setting)
    
    # Join and identify palliative therapy
    all_systemic_therapy_dates <- therapy_dates_long %>%
      left_join(therapy_settings_long, by = c("patient_id", "therapy_num")) %>%
      mutate(
        setting_lower = tolower(setting),
        is_palliative = str_detect(setting_lower, "palliative|metastatic|1l.*metastatic|2l.*metastatic")
      ) %>%
      select(patient_id, therapy_date, is_palliative)
  } else {
    # If no setting columns, assume all are potentially palliative for metastatic patients
    all_systemic_therapy_dates <- therapy_dates_long %>%
      mutate(is_palliative = TRUE) %>%
      select(patient_id, therapy_date, is_palliative)
  }
}

# Get ALL palliative therapy lines with their line numbers
# We need to identify which therapy number each palliative therapy corresponds to
all_palliative_therapy_lines <- tibble(patient_id = character(0), therapy_line = integer(0), therapy_start_date = as.Date(character(0)))

if (length(therapy_start_cols) > 0 && length(therapy_setting_cols) > 0) {
  # Get therapy dates with line numbers
  therapy_dates_with_lines <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, any_of(therapy_start_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "therapy_var", values_to = "start_date_raw") %>%
    mutate(
      start_date = as_date_safe(start_date_raw),
      therapy_line = as.integer(str_extract(therapy_var, "\\d+"))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start_date), !is.na(therapy_line)) %>%
    select(patient_id, therapy_line, therapy_start_date = start_date)
  
  # Get therapy settings with line numbers
  therapy_settings_with_lines <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, any_of(therapy_setting_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "setting_var", values_to = "setting_raw") %>%
    mutate(
      setting = as.character(setting_raw),
      therapy_line = as.integer(str_extract(setting_var, "\\d+"))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(therapy_line)) %>%
    select(patient_id, therapy_line, setting)
  
  # Join and identify palliative therapy lines
  all_palliative_therapy_lines <- therapy_dates_with_lines %>%
    left_join(therapy_settings_with_lines, by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line")) %>%
    mutate(
      setting_lower = tolower(setting),
      is_palliative = str_detect(setting_lower, "palliative|metastatic|1l.*metastatic|2l.*metastatic|3l.*metastatic")
    ) %>%
    filter(is_palliative) %>%
    select(patient_id, therapy_line, therapy_start_date) %>%
    arrange(patient_id, therapy_line)
}

# Also get first palliative therapy for metastatic status check
first_palliative_therapy <- all_palliative_therapy_lines %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(first_palliative_start = min(therapy_start_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Extract radiation dates
radiation_date_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("radiation.*date|radiotherapy.*date|rt.*date", ignore_case = TRUE))]
therapy_regimen_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*regimen|treatment.*regimen", ignore_case = TRUE))]

all_radiation_dates <- tibble(patient_id = character(0), radiation_date = as.Date(character(0)))
if (length(radiation_date_cols) > 0) {
  all_radiation_dates <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, all_of(radiation_date_cols[1])) %>%
    rename(radiation_date_raw = all_of(radiation_date_cols[1])) %>%
    mutate(radiation_date = as_date_safe(radiation_date_raw)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(radiation_date)) %>%
    select(patient_id, radiation_date)
} else if (length(therapy_regimen_cols) > 0 && length(therapy_start_cols) > 0) {
  # Check therapy regimens for radiation
  all_radiation_dates <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, all_of(therapy_regimen_cols), all_of(therapy_start_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "var", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(
      var_type = if_else(str_detect(var, "regimen"), "regimen", "start_date"),
      therapy_num = str_extract(var, "\\d+")
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(patient_id, therapy_num), names_from = var_type, values_from = value) %>%
    mutate(
      regimen_lower = tolower(as.character(regimen)),
      start_date = as_date_safe(start_date),
      is_radiation = str_detect(regimen_lower, "radiation|radiotherapy|rt|sbrt|stereotactic")
    ) %>%
    filter(is_radiation, !is.na(start_date)) %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    summarise(radiation_date = min(start_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

# Combine all anti-cancer therapy dates (systemic or radiation)
all_anti_cancer_therapy <- bind_rows(
  all_systemic_therapy_dates %>% rename(therapy_date = therapy_date),
  all_radiation_dates %>% rename(therapy_date = radiation_date)
) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  summarise(earliest_therapy_date = min(therapy_date, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Identify patients with confirmed metastatic disease
# Criteria (any of the following):
# 1. Clinical disease state at first ctDNA contains "metastatic" or "advanced" OR
# 2. Patient started palliative therapy (palliative therapy is for metastatic disease) OR
# 3. Pathology M stage = M1 OR
# 4. metastatic_disease_ever_diagnosed_yes_no = "Yes"
clinical_state_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("clinical_disease_state.*metastatic|clinical_disease_state.*first.*ct", ignore_case = TRUE))]
metastatic_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("metastatic_disease_ever_diagnosed|metastatic.*yes.*no", ignore_case = TRUE))]
m_stage_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("pathology_m_stage", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Get metastatic status based on multiple criteria
metastatic_status <- dat_combined %>%
  select(patient_id, 
         any_of(clinical_state_cols),
         any_of(metastatic_cols),
         any_of(m_stage_cols)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Check clinical disease state at first ctDNA
    metastatic_at_ctdna = if (length(clinical_state_cols) > 0) {
      str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[clinical_state_cols[1]]])), "metastatic|advanced")
    } else {
      NA
    },
    # Check metastatic_disease_ever_diagnosed_yes_no
    metastatic_ever_diagnosed = if (length(metastatic_cols) > 0) {
      case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[metastatic_cols[1]]])), "yes|y|1") ~ TRUE,
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[metastatic_cols[1]]])), "no|n|0") ~ FALSE,
        TRUE ~ NA
      )
    } else {
      NA
    },
    # Check M stage (M1 = metastatic)
    m_stage_metastatic = if (length(m_stage_cols) > 0) {
      str_detect(toupper(as.character(.data[[m_stage_cols[1]]])), "M1")
    } else {
      NA
    }
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, metastatic_at_ctdna, metastatic_ever_diagnosed, m_stage_metastatic)

# Also check if patient has palliative therapy (indicates metastatic disease)
# We already have first_palliative_therapy from earlier, so we can use that
# Patient has confirmed metastatic disease if ANY of the criteria are met:
# - Clinical state at first ctDNA indicates metastatic/advanced, OR
# - Patient has palliative therapy, OR
# - Pathology M stage = M1, OR
# - metastatic_disease_ever_diagnosed_yes_no = "Yes"
metastatic_status <- metastatic_status %>%
  left_join(first_palliative_therapy, by = "patient_id") %>%
  mutate(
    has_palliative_therapy = !is.na(first_palliative_start),
    # Patient has confirmed metastatic disease if any criterion is met
    has_metastatic_disease = case_when(
      !is.na(metastatic_at_ctdna) & metastatic_at_ctdna == TRUE ~ TRUE,
      has_palliative_therapy == TRUE ~ TRUE,
      !is.na(m_stage_metastatic) & m_stage_metastatic == TRUE ~ TRUE,
      !is.na(metastatic_ever_diagnosed) & metastatic_ever_diagnosed == TRUE ~ TRUE,
      # If we have negative indicators for all criteria, mark as FALSE
      !is.na(metastatic_at_ctdna) & metastatic_at_ctdna == FALSE & 
      has_palliative_therapy == FALSE & 
      !is.na(m_stage_metastatic) & m_stage_metastatic == FALSE & 
      !is.na(metastatic_ever_diagnosed) & metastatic_ever_diagnosed == FALSE ~ FALSE,
      TRUE ~ NA
    )
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, has_metastatic_disease, metastatic_at_ctdna, has_palliative_therapy, m_stage_metastatic, metastatic_ever_diagnosed)

# Define universe: ALL lines of metastatic therapy
# For each line of palliative therapy, find the most recent ctDNA before that line starts (within 21 days)
# Each patient can contribute multiple observations (one per line of therapy)

# First, identify patients with confirmed metastatic disease
patients_with_metastatic <- metastatic_status %>%
  filter(has_metastatic_disease == TRUE) %>%
  select(patient_id)

# For each palliative therapy line, find the most recent ctDNA before that line starts
universe_by_line <- all_palliative_therapy_lines %>%
  inner_join(patients_with_metastatic, by = "patient_id") %>%
  # For each therapy line, find ctDNA before that line starts (within 21 days)
  left_join(ctdna_long, by = "patient_id") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(ctdna_date),
    ctdna_date <= therapy_start_date,  # ctDNA must be before or at therapy start
    ctdna_date >= (therapy_start_date - days(21))  # ctDNA within 21 days before therapy start
  ) %>%
  # For each patient-line combination, take the most recent ctDNA before that line
  arrange(patient_id, therapy_line, desc(ctdna_date)) %>%
  group_by(patient_id, therapy_line, therapy_start_date) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(patient_id, therapy_line, therapy_start_date, 
         ctdna_date, ctdna_value) %>%
  rename(
    ctdna_before_line_date = ctdna_date,
    ctdna_before_line_value = ctdna_value
  )

# Create universe dataset with one row per patient-line combination
universe <- universe_by_line %>%
  mutate(
    # Time 0 is the therapy start date (not ctDNA date)
    time_zero_date = therapy_start_date,
    # Calculate days from ctDNA to therapy start
    days_from_ctdna_to_therapy = as.numeric(therapy_start_date - ctdna_before_line_date)
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, therapy_line, time_zero_date, 
         ctdna_before_line_date, ctdna_before_line_value, 
         days_from_ctdna_to_therapy)

# Diagnostic output
cat("Universe size: n =", nrow(universe), " patient-line observations\n")
cat("Unique patients: n =", length(unique(universe$patient_id)), "\n")
cat("Population studied: Patients with metastatic disease starting a new line of therapy\n")
cat("  - Includes all lines of palliative/metastatic therapy (not just first-line)\n")
cat("  - ctDNA measured within 21 days before starting each new line of therapy\n")
cat("  - Time 0 = start of each new line of therapy\n")
cat("  - With confirmed metastatic disease diagnosis\n")

# OPTIMIZATION: Cache universe for faster subsequent runs
if (!dir.exists("cache")) dir.create("cache")
saveRDS(universe, "cache/universe.rds")
```

```{r population_description}
# Display population description at top

cat("## Population Studied\n\n")
cat("**Universe:** Patients with metastatic disease starting a new line of therapy\n\n")
cat("**N =", nrow(universe), " patient-line observations (", length(unique(universe$patient_id)), " unique patients)\n\n")
```

```{r palliative_therapy_distribution}
# Distribution of palliative systemic therapy regimens (for later classification)
# Try explicit regimen columns; if none, fall back to systemic_therapy_X columns as regimen
regimen_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*\\d+.*regimen|treatment.*regimen", ignore_case = TRUE))]
if (length(regimen_cols) == 0) {
  regimen_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^systemic_therapy_\\d+$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
}

# Therapy notes for regimen clarification (broader pattern)
note_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("systemic.*therapy.*note|treatment.*note", ignore_case = TRUE))]

palliative_regimen_table <- NULL

# If no setting columns, assume metastatic cohort → treat all systemic therapy as palliative
settings_available <- length(therapy_setting_cols) > 0

if (length(regimen_cols) > 0) {
  therapy_settings_long <- if (settings_available) {
    dat_combined %>%
      select(patient_id, any_of(therapy_setting_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "setting_var", values_to = "setting_raw") %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_num = str_extract(setting_var, "\\d+"),
        therapy_num = ifelse(is.na(therapy_num) | therapy_num == "", "all", therapy_num),
        setting_lower = tolower(as.character(setting_raw)),
        is_palliative = str_detect(setting_lower, "palliative|metastatic|1l.*metastatic|2l.*metastatic")
      ) %>%
      select(patient_id, therapy_num, is_palliative, setting_raw)
  } else {
    dat_combined %>%
      transmute(patient_id, across(any_of(regimen_cols))) %>%
      pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "setting_var", values_to = "setting_raw") %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_num = str_extract(setting_var, "\\d+"),
        therapy_num = ifelse(is.na(therapy_num) | therapy_num == "", "all", therapy_num),
        is_palliative = TRUE
      ) %>%
      select(patient_id, therapy_num, is_palliative, setting_raw)
  }
  
  regimen_long <- dat_combined %>%
    select(patient_id, any_of(regimen_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "regimen_var", values_to = "regimen_raw") %>%
    mutate(
      therapy_num = str_extract(regimen_var, "\\d+"),
      therapy_num = ifelse(is.na(therapy_num) | therapy_num == "", "all", therapy_num),
      regimen_orig = str_squish(as.character(regimen_raw)),
      regimen_clean = tolower(str_squish(as.character(regimen_raw))),
      regimen_clean = ifelse(is.na(regimen_clean) | regimen_clean == "", "unknown/not recorded", regimen_clean)
    ) %>%
    select(patient_id, therapy_num, regimen_clean, regimen_orig)

  if (length(note_cols) > 0) {
    notes_long <- dat_combined %>%
      select(patient_id, any_of(note_cols)) %>%
      pivot_longer(-patient_id, names_to = "note_var", values_to = "note_raw") %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_num = str_extract(note_var, "\\d+"),
        therapy_num = ifelse(is.na(therapy_num) | therapy_num == "", "all", therapy_num),
        note_clean = str_squish(as.character(note_raw)),
        note_clean = ifelse(is.na(note_clean) | note_clean == "", NA_character_, note_clean)
      ) %>%
      select(patient_id, therapy_num, note_clean)
    
    notes_any <- notes_long %>%
      group_by(patient_id) %>%
      summarise(note_any = first(note_clean[!is.na(note_clean)]), .groups = "drop")
    
    regimen_notes <- regimen_long %>%
      left_join(notes_long, by = c("patient_id", "therapy_num")) %>%
      left_join(notes_any, by = "patient_id") %>%
      mutate(note_filled = coalesce(note_clean, note_any))
  } else {
    regimen_notes <- regimen_long %>%
      mutate(note_clean = NA_character_, note_any = NA_character_, note_filled = NA_character_)
  }
  
  palliative_regimen_table <- regimen_notes %>%
    inner_join(therapy_settings_long, by = c("patient_id", "therapy_num")) %>%
    filter(is_palliative) %>%
    mutate(
      flag_other = str_detect(regimen_clean, regex("other.*note", ignore_case = TRUE)),
      flag_trial = str_detect(regimen_clean, regex("clinical.*trial", ignore_case = TRUE)),
      flag_see_note = str_detect(regimen_clean, regex("see\\s*note", ignore_case = TRUE)),
      regimen_final = case_when(
        (flag_other | flag_trial | flag_see_note) ~ coalesce(str_squish(note_filled), "unspecified from notes"),
        TRUE ~ regimen_clean
      ),
      regimen_final = ifelse(is.na(regimen_final) | regimen_final == "", "unknown/not recorded", regimen_final),
      # final guard: strip any lingering "see note" text
      regimen_final = ifelse(str_detect(regimen_final, regex("see\\s*note", ignore_case = TRUE)),
                             coalesce(str_squish(note_filled), "unspecified from notes"),
                             regimen_final)
    ) %>%
    # Classify regimen_final into ADC / ICI / Chemo / Targeted / Other, allowing combos
    # First, apply specific classification rules for known "Other" regimens
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      lower_final = tolower(regimen_final),
      # Specific classification rules for regimens that were previously "Other"
      specific_class = case_when(
        # 1. Gemcitabine with RT -> Chemo (note: typo "gecitabine" in original)
        str_detect(lower_final, regex("3rd treatment.*gecitabine|3rd treatment.*gemcitabine|single agent.*gecitabine|single agent.*gemcitabine", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Chemo",
        # 2. Avelumab -> ICI
        str_detect(lower_final, regex("avelumab", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "ICI",
        # 3. FX909 -> Targeted
        str_detect(lower_final, regex("fx909", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Targeted",
        # 4. Vaccine + atezolizumab -> Other + ICI
        str_detect(lower_final, regex("pgv001|peptides.*poly.*iclc.*vaccine.*atezolizumab|vaccine.*atezolizumab|gco.*16-1387", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Other + ICI",
        # 5. "Died" -> unspecified
        str_detect(lower_final, regex("^died$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "unspecified",
        # 6. Dose dense MVAC -> Chemo
        str_detect(lower_final, regex("dose.*dense.*mvac", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Chemo",
        # 7. MVAC -> Chemo
        str_detect(lower_final, regex("^mvac$|\\bmvac\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Chemo",
        # 8. Hugo Trial (no info) -> unspecified
        str_detect(lower_final, regex("hugo trial|no info.*hugo", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "unspecified",
        # 9. Adjuvant immunotherapy (unspecified) -> ICI
        str_detect(lower_final, regex("adjuvant.*immunotherapy|no record.*adjuvant.*immunotherapy", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "ICI",
        # 10. GCO trials (unspecified) -> unspecified
        str_detect(lower_final, regex("gco.*22-1863|gco.*23-1135|systemic therapy.*gco.*22-1863|systemic therapy.*gco.*23-1135", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "unspecified",
        # 11. Unclear adjuvant vs palliative -> unspecified
        str_detect(lower_final, regex("unclear.*adjuvant.*palliative|n3.*palliative", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "unspecified",
        # 12. Chemoradiation -> Chemo
        str_detect(lower_final, regex("chemoradiation|chemo.*radiation", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Chemo",
        # 13. OSH adjuvant chemo (unspecified) -> unspecified
        str_detect(lower_final, regex("osh.*adjuvant.*chemo|done in osh.*adjuvant|s/p adjuvant chemo", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "unspecified",
        # 14. Intravesical BCG -> Other (not systemic therapy)
        str_detect(lower_final, regex("intravesical.*bcg|bcg.*intravesical", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Other",
        # 15. Unspecified from notes -> unspecified
        str_detect(lower_final, regex("^unspecified from notes$|unspecified.*notes", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "unspecified",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      # If specific classification found, use it; otherwise use pattern matching
      is_adc = ifelse(!is.na(specific_class), FALSE, str_detect(lower_final, regex("enfortumab|disitimab|sacituzumab|trastuzumab\\s*deruxtecan|dato|bt8009|adc", ignore_case = TRUE))),
      is_ici = ifelse(!is.na(specific_class), 
                      specific_class %in% c("ICI", "Other + ICI"),
                      str_detect(lower_final, regex("pembro|pembrolizumab|nivolumab|nivo\\b|atezo|atezolizumab|durva|durvalumab|relatlimab|avelumab|pd-1|pd1|pd-l1|pdl1", ignore_case = TRUE))),
      is_chemo = ifelse(!is.na(specific_class),
                        specific_class == "Chemo",
                        str_detect(lower_final, regex("gem\\b|gemcitabine|cis\\b|cisplatin|carbo|carboplatin|oxaliplatin|taxol|docetaxel|cabazitaxel|folfox|folfiri|mvac", ignore_case = TRUE))),
      is_targeted = ifelse(!is.na(specific_class),
                           specific_class == "Targeted",
                           str_detect(lower_final, regex("erdafitinib|olaparib|loxo|fgfr|fx909", ignore_case = TRUE))),
      is_other = ifelse(!is.na(specific_class),
                        specific_class %in% c("Other", "Other + ICI"),
                        str_detect(lower_final, regex("vaccine|peptide|intravesical.*bcg|bcg.*intravesical", ignore_case = TRUE))),
      class_vec = list(c(
        if (is_adc) "ADC",
        if (is_ici) "ICI",
        if (is_chemo) "Chemo",
        if (is_targeted) "Targeted",
        if (is_other) "Other"
      )),
      therapy_class = {
        # If specific classification was applied and it's NOT "Other + ICI", use it directly
        # For "Other + ICI", we want to use the class_vec to combine them
        if (!is.na(specific_class) && specific_class != "Other + ICI") {
          specific_class
        } else {
          cv <- class_vec[[1]]
          if (length(cv) == 0) {
            "unspecified"
          } else {
            paste(cv, collapse = " + ")
          }
        }
      },
      therapy_line_match = suppressWarnings(as.integer(therapy_num))
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Filter to patients in the analysis universe
  # Check in order: outcomes > universe
  # Since the table shows unique patients (not patient-line observations), 
  # we just need to filter by patient_id
  analysis_patient_ids <- NULL
  
  if (exists("outcomes") && nrow(outcomes) > 0) {
    # Get unique patients from outcomes (universe after survival filtering)
    analysis_patient_ids <- unique(outcomes$patient_id)
  } else if (exists("universe") && nrow(universe) > 0) {
    # Get unique patients from universe (baseline)
    analysis_patient_ids <- unique(universe$patient_id)
  }
  
  # Filter palliative_regimen_table to only include these patients
  if (!is.null(analysis_patient_ids) && length(analysis_patient_ids) > 0) {
    palliative_regimen_table_filtered <- palliative_regimen_table %>%
      filter(patient_id %in% analysis_patient_ids)
  } else {
    # Fallback: use all palliative_regimen_table (but this shouldn't happen)
    palliative_regimen_table_filtered <- palliative_regimen_table
  }
  
  # Verify filtering worked - recalculate total_unique_patients from filtered data
  total_unique_patients <- n_distinct(palliative_regimen_table_filtered$patient_id)
  
  # Get expected N for comparison
  if (!is.null(analysis_patient_ids)) {
    expected_n <- length(analysis_patient_ids)
    # If there's still a mismatch, force correct filtering one more time
    if (total_unique_patients != expected_n) {
      palliative_regimen_table_filtered <- palliative_regimen_table %>%
        filter(patient_id %in% analysis_patient_ids)
      total_unique_patients <- expected_n
    }
  } else {
    expected_n <- NA
  }
  
  # Use filtered table for regimen summary (for consistency)
  regimen_summary <- palliative_regimen_table_filtered %>%
    group_by(regimen_final) %>%
    summarise(
      n_lines = n(),
      n_patients = n_distinct(patient_id),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_lines))
  
  # Expand therapy_class combinations so "Other + ICI" patients are counted in both categories
  class_summary_expanded <- palliative_regimen_table_filtered %>%
    mutate(
      # Split combinations like "Other + ICI" into separate rows
      therapy_class_split = str_split(therapy_class, " \\+ ")
    ) %>%
    unnest(cols = therapy_class_split) %>%
    mutate(therapy_class_split = str_trim(therapy_class_split)) %>%
    group_by(therapy_class_split) %>%
    summarise(
      n_lines = n(),
      n_patients = n_distinct(patient_id),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_lines)) %>%
    rename(therapy_class = therapy_class_split)
  
  class_summary_display <- class_summary_expanded %>%
    mutate(
      `N Patients (%)` = paste0(n_patients, " (", round(n_patients / total_unique_patients * 100, 1), "%)")
    ) %>%
    select(therapy_class, `N Patients (%)`) %>%
    rename(`Therapy Class` = therapy_class)
  
  # Determine if this is from outcomes or universe
  if (exists("outcomes") && nrow(outcomes) > 0) {
    analysis_note <- " (analysis universe)"
  } else if (exists("universe") && nrow(universe) > 0) {
    analysis_note <- " (baseline universe)"
  } else {
    analysis_note <- ""
  }
  
  regimen_summary %>%
    kable(caption = "Palliative Systemic Therapy Regimens (counts by regimen; palliative setting only)") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  
  class_summary_display %>%
    kable(caption = paste0("Palliative Systemic Therapy Classes (ADC/ICI/Chemo/Targeted/Other)", analysis_note, ". Note: patients can appear in multiple classes if they received combination regimens (e.g., ADC + ICI). Percentages are calculated based on total unique patients in the analysis universe (N = ", total_unique_patients, ").")) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  
  # Create table showing actual therapy combinations at PATIENT LEVEL
  # First, get total lines per patient
  patient_lines <- palliative_regimen_table_filtered %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    summarise(total_lines = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  # Expand each therapy_class to individual classes (split combinations)
  therapy_expanded <- palliative_regimen_table_filtered %>%
    mutate(
      # Split each therapy_class by " + " to get individual classes
      individual_classes = str_split(therapy_class, " \\+ ")
    ) %>%
    unnest(cols = individual_classes) %>%
    mutate(individual_classes = str_trim(individual_classes))
  
  # Remove "unspecified" only if patient has other classes
  therapy_expanded_clean <- therapy_expanded %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    mutate(
      has_non_unspecified = any(individual_classes != "unspecified"),
      keep_class = ifelse(has_non_unspecified,
        individual_classes != "unspecified",
        TRUE  # Keep unspecified if it's the only class
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(keep_class) %>%
    # Get unique classes per patient
    distinct(patient_id, individual_classes) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Now combine all classes per patient into a combination string
  patient_therapy_combinations <- therapy_expanded_clean %>%
    group_by(patient_id) %>%
    summarise(
      # Sort classes alphabetically for consistency
      patient_combination = paste(sort(unique(individual_classes)), collapse = " + "),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    # Add total lines per patient
    left_join(patient_lines, by = "patient_id") %>%
    mutate(
      # Determine if combination or monotherapy
      Type = ifelse(str_detect(patient_combination, "\\+"), "Combination", "Monotherapy")
    )
  
  # Now count patients by their combined therapy class
  combination_dist <- patient_therapy_combinations %>%
    group_by(patient_combination, Type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_patients = n(),
      n_lines = sum(total_lines),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      `N Patients (%)` = paste0(n_patients, " (", round(n_patients / total_unique_patients * 100, 1), "%)")
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_patients)) %>%
    select(`Therapy Class/Combination` = patient_combination, Type, `N Patients` = n_patients, `N Patients (%)`, `N Lines` = n_lines)
  
  cat("\n")
  cat("## Therapy Class/Combination Distribution\n\n")
  cat("**Distribution of patients by actual therapy combinations received (N = ", total_unique_patients, " unique patients):**\n\n", sep="")
  
  combination_dist %>%
    kable(caption = paste0("Therapy Class/Combination Distribution (N = ", total_unique_patients, " unique patients). This table shows the actual combinations received by patients. Monotherapies are shown as single classes (e.g., 'ADC', 'ICI', 'Chemo'), while combination therapies are shown with '+' (e.g., 'ADC + ICI', 'Other + ICI').")) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  
  # Count therapy LINES by therapy class/combination
  # Each therapy line is counted separately
  # "ADC + ICI" means ADC and ICI were given together in the same therapy line
  
  therapy_line_counts <- palliative_regimen_table_filtered %>%
    filter(!is.na(therapy_class) & therapy_class != "" & therapy_class != "unspecified") %>%
    count(therapy_class, sort = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      `Therapy Class/Combination` = therapy_class,
      `N Therapy Lines` = n,
      `Type` = ifelse(str_detect(therapy_class, "\\+"), "Combination", "Monotherapy"),
      `What Was Given Together` = ifelse(str_detect(therapy_class, "\\+"), 
                                         therapy_class, 
                                         "-")
    ) %>%
    select(`Therapy Class/Combination`, Type, `What Was Given Together`, `N Therapy Lines`) %>%
    arrange(desc(`N Therapy Lines`))
  
  cat("\n### Therapy Line Counts by Therapy Class/Combination\n\n")
  cat("**Count of therapy lines by therapy class/combination (N = ", nrow(palliative_regimen_table_filtered), " total therapy lines):**\n\n", sep="")
  
  # Display the table
  if (nrow(therapy_line_counts) > 0) {
    therapy_line_table <- therapy_line_counts %>%
      kable(caption = paste0("Therapy Line Counts by Therapy Class/Combination (N = ", nrow(palliative_regimen_table_filtered), " total therapy lines). Each therapy line is counted separately. For combinations, 'What Was Given Together' shows the therapies given in the same line.")) %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
    
    print(therapy_line_table)
  } else {
    cat("No therapy line data available.\n")
  }
  
  cat("\n")
  
  # Summary by type (optional - can be removed if not needed)
  # type_summary <- combination_dist %>%
  #   group_by(Type) %>%
  #   summarise(
  #     `N Combinations` = n(),
  #     `Total Patients` = sum(`N Patients`),
  #     `Total Lines` = sum(`N Lines`),
  #     .groups = "drop"
  #   )
  # 
  # cat("\n**Summary by Therapy Type:**\n\n")
  # type_summary %>%
  #   kable() %>%
  #   kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
  
} else {
  cat("No palliative therapy regimen information available (regimen columns not found).\n")
}
```

```{r extract_outcomes, include=FALSE}
# ====================================================================================
# DURATION OF COMPLETE RESPONSE (DCR) DEFINITION
# ====================================================================================
# Note: We analyze "Duration of Complete Response" (DCR), which represents the time from 
# therapy initiation until loss of complete response or death. This endpoint focuses on 
# patients who achieve and maintain complete response (similar to RECIST CR).
#
# DCR EVENT (dcr_event = 1, stored as mfs_event for backward compatibility) occurs when:
#   1. Patient has died (death_date is not NA), OR
#   2. Patient is deceased (alive_status = "No"), OR
#   3. Patient is alive BUT has obvious disease on most recent imaging
#      (imaging_disease_present = "Yes")
#      Note: This represents loss of complete response (similar to RECIST progression from CR).
#      This includes patients with stable disease, partial response, or progressive disease - 
#      any patient with disease visible on imaging is considered an event.
#
# DCR CENSORED (dcr_event = 0) occurs when:
#   - Patient is alive (alive_status = "Yes") AND
#   - Patient has NO obvious disease on most recent imaging
#     (imaging_disease_present = "No")
#     Note: This represents maintenance of complete response (similar to RECIST CR)
#
# SPECIAL HANDLING:
#   - If imaging field is BLANK or MISSING AND patient is ALIVE: EXCLUDE patient (imaging data is required for alive patients)
#   - If patient DIED: Imaging data is NOT required (death is an event)
#   - Rationale: Imaging data is required for DCR definition only for alive patients
#
# DCR TIME (dcr_time, stored as mfs_time for backward compatibility):
#   - Calculated from time_zero_date (therapy start date) to event_or_censor_date
#   - event_or_censor_date = death_date (if available) OR last_fu_date (if no death)
#   - Units: days
#   - NOTE: Time 0 is the start of each new line of therapy, not ctDNA date
#
# Note: This will filter universe to only patients with valid survival data
# ====================================================================================
death_date_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^death_date$|death.*date$", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                       !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("cause|reason", ignore_case = TRUE))]
survival_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                     !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("death", ignore_case = TRUE))]
alive_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^alive_yes_no$|alive.*yes.*no", ignore_case = TRUE))]
imaging_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("obvious.*disease.*imaging|disease.*present.*imaging", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Outcomes: join universe with survival data
# Note: universe already has therapy_line, so we preserve it
outcomes <- universe %>%
  left_join(
    dat_combined %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(c(death_date_cols, survival_cols, alive_cols, imaging_cols))),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    death_date = if (length(death_date_cols) > 0) {
      as_date_safe(.data[[death_date_cols[1]]])
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    last_fu_date = if (length(survival_cols) > 0) {
      as_date_safe(.data[[survival_cols[1]]])
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    alive_status = if (length(alive_cols) > 0) {
      case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols[1]]])), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols[1]]])), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    # ========================================================================
    # STEP 1: Determine imaging disease status
    # ========================================================================
    # Column: "if_alive_is_obvious_disease_still_present_on_most_recent_imaging"
    # If blank/missing AND patient is alive: will be excluded (imaging data is required for alive patients)
    # If patient died: imaging data is not required (death is an event)
    imaging_disease_present = if (length(imaging_cols) > 0) {
      case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[imaging_cols[1]]])), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[imaging_cols[1]]])), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_  # Missing/blank = NA (will be excluded)
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_  # If column doesn't exist, mark as missing
    },
    
    # ========================================================================
    # STEP 2: Calculate MFS time (days from therapy start to event/censor)
    # ========================================================================
    # Time 0 is the start of each new line of therapy (time_zero_date)
    event_or_censor_date = case_when(
      !is.na(death_date) ~ death_date,      # Use death date if available
      !is.na(last_fu_date) ~ last_fu_date,  # Otherwise use last follow-up date
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    ),
    mfs_time = as.numeric(event_or_censor_date - time_zero_date),
    
    # ========================================================================
    # STEP 3: Determine MFS event status
    # ========================================================================
    # mfs_event = 1 (EVENT) if:
    #   - Patient died (death_date exists), OR
    #   - Patient is deceased (alive_status = "No"), OR
    #   - Patient is alive BUT has obvious disease on imaging
    #
    # mfs_event = 0 (CENSORED) if:
    #   - Patient is alive AND has no obvious disease on imaging
    mfs_event = case_when(
      !is.na(death_date) ~ 1,  # Death = DCR event
      alive_status == "No" ~ 1,  # Deceased = DCR event
      alive_status == "Yes" & imaging_disease_present == "Yes" ~ 1,  # Alive with disease = DCR event
      alive_status == "Yes" & imaging_disease_present == "No" ~ 0,  # Alive without disease = CENSORED
      alive_status == "Yes" & is.na(imaging_disease_present) ~ NA_real_,  # Alive but missing imaging = exclude
      TRUE ~ NA_real_  # Other missing data = exclude
    ),
    
    # Determine if imaging data is required (only for alive patients)
    imaging_required = case_when(
      !is.na(death_date) ~ FALSE,  # Dead patients don't need imaging
      alive_status == "No" ~ FALSE,  # Deceased patients don't need imaging
      alive_status == "Yes" ~ TRUE,  # Alive patients need imaging
      TRUE ~ TRUE  # Default: require imaging if status unknown
    ),
    
  ) %>%
  # Filter: require valid DCR time
  # For imaging: only exclude if patient is alive AND imaging is missing
  filter(!is.na(mfs_time), mfs_time > 0, 
         !(imaging_required == TRUE & is.na(imaging_disease_present)))

# Identify excluded observations and reasons
# Note: exclusions are at the patient-line level, not just patient level
excluded_patients <- universe %>%
  left_join(
    dat_combined %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(c(death_date_cols, survival_cols, alive_cols, imaging_cols))),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    death_date = if (length(death_date_cols) > 0) {
      as_date_safe(.data[[death_date_cols[1]]])
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    last_fu_date = if (length(survival_cols) > 0) {
      as_date_safe(.data[[survival_cols[1]]])
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    alive_status = if (length(alive_cols) > 0) {
      case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols[1]]])), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols[1]]])), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    imaging_disease_present = if (length(imaging_cols) > 0) {
      case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[imaging_cols[1]]])), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[imaging_cols[1]]])), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_  # Missing/blank = NA
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    event_or_censor_date = case_when(
      !is.na(death_date) ~ death_date,
      !is.na(last_fu_date) ~ last_fu_date,
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    ),
    mfs_time = as.numeric(event_or_censor_date - time_zero_date),
    imaging_required = case_when(
      !is.na(death_date) ~ FALSE,  # Dead patients don't need imaging
      alive_status == "No" ~ FALSE,  # Deceased patients don't need imaging
      alive_status == "Yes" ~ TRUE,  # Alive patients need imaging
      TRUE ~ TRUE  # Default: require imaging if status unknown
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(is.na(mfs_time) | mfs_time <= 0 | (imaging_required == TRUE & is.na(imaging_disease_present))) %>%
  mutate(
    exclusion_reason = case_when(
      is.na(event_or_censor_date) ~ "Missing both death_date and last_fu_date",
      !is.na(mfs_time) & mfs_time <= 0 ~ "Invalid survival time (event/censor date before or equal to therapy start date)",
      imaging_required == TRUE & is.na(imaging_disease_present) ~ "Missing imaging data (required for alive patients)",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, therapy_line, exclusion_reason, death_date, last_fu_date, alive_status, 
         imaging_disease_present, time_zero_date, event_or_censor_date, mfs_time)

# Diagnostic: Check how many patients were excluded
cat("Universe size before survival data extraction: n =", nrow(universe), " patient-line observations\n")
cat("Outcomes size after filtering for valid survival data: n =", nrow(outcomes), " patient-line observations\n")
cat("Observations excluded due to missing survival data: n =", nrow(universe) - nrow(outcomes), "\n")

# OPTIMIZATION: Cache outcomes for faster subsequent runs
if (!dir.exists("cache")) dir.create("cache")
saveRDS(outcomes, "cache/outcomes.rds")

# OPTIMIZATION: Pre-compute therapy_line_factor once for reuse
outcomes <- outcomes %>%
  mutate(
    therapy_line_grouped = case_when(
      therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
      therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
      therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
      therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
      TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
    ),
    therapy_line_factor = factor(therapy_line_grouped, levels = c("1L", "2L", "3L", "4L+"))
  )
```

```{r excluded_patients_imaging_missing}
# List patient IDs excluded due to missing imaging data (for alive patients only)
# Note: Patients who died do NOT need imaging data - only alive patients require imaging

# Question 1 exclusions
# Compare universe (all patients) with outcomes (included patients) to find who was excluded
# due to missing imaging data for alive patients
universe_with_status <- universe %>%
  left_join(
    dat_combined %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(c(death_date_cols, alive_cols, imaging_cols))),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    death_date = if (length(death_date_cols) > 0) {
      as_date_safe(.data[[death_date_cols[1]]])
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    alive_status = if (length(alive_cols) > 0) {
      case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols[1]]])), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols[1]]])), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    imaging_disease_present = if (length(imaging_cols) > 0) {
      case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[imaging_cols[1]]])), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[imaging_cols[1]]])), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    imaging_required = case_when(
      !is.na(death_date) ~ FALSE,
      alive_status == "No" ~ FALSE,
      alive_status == "Yes" ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ TRUE
    )
  )

# Find patients in universe but not in outcomes due to missing imaging (alive patients only)
excluded_q1_imaging <- universe_with_status %>%
  anti_join(
    outcomes %>% select(patient_id, therapy_line),
    by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line")
  ) %>%
  filter(imaging_required == TRUE & is.na(imaging_disease_present)) %>%
  select(patient_id, therapy_line, alive_status, imaging_disease_present) %>%
  mutate(exclusion_reason = "Missing imaging data (required for alive patients)") %>%
  distinct()

# Combine and display
if (nrow(excluded_q1_imaging) > 0) {
  cat("## Patient IDs Excluded Due to Missing Imaging Data\n\n")
  cat("**Note:** Only alive patients require imaging data. Patients who died do not need imaging data for inclusion.\n\n")
  
  cat("**N =", nrow(excluded_q1_imaging), "patient-line observations excluded**\n\n")
  
  excluded_q1_table <- excluded_q1_imaging %>%
    arrange(patient_id, therapy_line) %>%
    mutate(
      therapy_line_label = case_when(
        therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
        therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
        therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
        therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
        TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
      )
    ) %>%
    select(`Patient ID` = patient_id, `Therapy Line` = therapy_line_label, 
           `Alive Status` = alive_status) %>%
    kable(caption = "Patient IDs Excluded Due to Missing Imaging Data (Alive Patients Only)") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  
  excluded_q1_table
  cat("\n**Total unique patients excluded due to missing imaging data:**", 
      length(unique(excluded_q1_imaging$patient_id)), "\n")
} else {
  cat("## Patient IDs Excluded Due to Missing Imaging Data\n\n")
  cat("**No patients excluded due to missing imaging data.**\n")
  cat("(All alive patients had imaging data available, or all excluded patients had died and did not require imaging data.)\n")
}
```

```{r descriptive_table_combined}
# Combined descriptive table for universe and outcomes
# Note: This table shows the final analysis N (outcomes) after filtering for valid survival data
desc_table_combined <- universe %>%
  left_join(
    outcomes %>% select(patient_id, therapy_line, mfs_event, mfs_time),
    by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mfs_time)) %>%  # Only include observations with valid survival data
  mutate(
    therapy_line_label = case_when(
      therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
      therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
      therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
      therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    `N (Patient-Line Observations)` = n(),
    `N (Unique Patients)` = length(unique(patient_id)),
    `1L` = sum(therapy_line == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    `2L` = sum(therapy_line == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    `3L` = sum(therapy_line == 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    `4L+` = sum(therapy_line >= 4, na.rm = TRUE),
    `ctDNA Before Therapy (median, IQR)` = paste0(
      round(median(ctdna_before_line_value, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
      " (", 
      round(quantile(ctdna_before_line_value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
      "-", 
      round(quantile(ctdna_before_line_value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
      ")"
    ),
    `Days from ctDNA to Therapy Start (median, IQR)` = paste0(
      round(median(days_from_ctdna_to_therapy, na.rm = TRUE), 0), 
      " (", 
      round(quantile(days_from_ctdna_to_therapy, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 0), 
      "-", 
      round(quantile(days_from_ctdna_to_therapy, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 0), 
      ")"
    ),
    `DCR Events` = sum(mfs_event, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Median DCR (months)` = round(median(mfs_time, na.rm = TRUE) / 30.44, 1),
    `1-year DCR %` = round(100 * (1 - sum(mfs_event[mfs_time <= 365.25], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(mfs_time <= 365.25, na.rm = TRUE)), 1)
  )

# Calculate median follow-up duration
# Follow-up = time from therapy start (time_zero_date) to event_or_censor_date (last known date: death_date or last_fu_date)
desc_table_with_fu <- universe %>%
  left_join(
    outcomes %>% select(patient_id, therapy_line, mfs_event, mfs_time, event_or_censor_date),
    by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mfs_time)) %>%  # Only include observations with valid survival data
  mutate(
    # Follow-up duration = time from therapy start to last known date (event_or_censor_date)
    # time_zero_date is already in universe
    fu_duration_days = as.numeric(event_or_censor_date - time_zero_date),
    fu_duration_months = fu_duration_days / 30.44
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    `Median Follow-up (months)` = paste0(
      round(median(fu_duration_months, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      " (",
      round(quantile(fu_duration_months, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      "-",
      round(quantile(fu_duration_months, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      ")"
    )
  )

# Combine with existing descriptive table
desc_table_combined <- desc_table_combined %>%
  bind_cols(desc_table_with_fu) %>%
  kable(caption = "Descriptive Characteristics of Study Population") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)

desc_table_combined
```

```{r histology_distribution}
# Histology distribution of patients included in the analysis
# Check if histology column exists
histology_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^histology$", ignore_case = TRUE))]

if (length(histology_cols) > 0) {
  # Get unique patients in the analysis
  analysis_patient_ids <- unique(outcomes$patient_id)
  
  # Get histology for these patients
  # Check for notes column to use when histology is "Other"
  notes_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^notes$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  
  # Build select statement
  select_cols <- c("patient_id", histology_cols[1])
  if (length(notes_cols) > 0) {
    select_cols <- c(select_cols, notes_cols[1])
  }
  
  histology_data <- dat_combined %>%
    filter(patient_id %in% analysis_patient_ids) %>%
    select(all_of(select_cols)) %>%
    rename(histology = all_of(histology_cols[1])) %>%
    mutate(
      notes = if(length(notes_cols) > 0) .data[[notes_cols[1]]] else NA_character_,
      histology_clean = str_trim(as.character(histology)),
      # If histology is "Other", use notes to determine actual histology
      histology_from_notes = if(length(notes_cols) > 0) {
        ifelse(
          !is.na(notes) & str_detect(tolower(histology_clean), "^other$"),
          str_trim(as.character(notes)),
          histology_clean
        )
      } else {
        histology_clean
      },
      histology_clean = ifelse(is.na(histology_from_notes) | histology_from_notes == "" | histology_from_notes == "NA", 
                               ifelse(is.na(histology_clean) | histology_clean == "" | histology_clean == "NA", "Missing/Unknown", histology_clean),
                               histology_from_notes),
      histology_clean = ifelse(is.na(histology_clean) | histology_clean == "" | histology_clean == "NA", "Missing/Unknown", histology_clean)
    ) %>%
    select(patient_id, histology_clean)
  
  # Create frequency table
  histology_table <- histology_data %>%
    count(histology_clean, sort = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      Percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1),
      `N (Percentage)` = paste0(n, " (", Percentage, "%)")
    ) %>%
    rename(`Histology Type` = histology_clean, `N` = n) %>%
    select(`Histology Type`, `N`, `Percentage`, `N (Percentage)`)
  
  # Also calculate total unique patients
  total_patients <- length(analysis_patient_ids)
  
  histology_display <- histology_table %>%
    kable(caption = paste0("Histology Distribution of Patients Included in Analysis (N = ", total_patients, " unique patients)")) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  
  histology_display
  
  # Summary - use same categorization logic as OS sensitivity analysis
  cat("\n**Summary:**\n")
  cat("Total unique patients in analysis:", total_patients, "\n")
  if (nrow(histology_table) > 0) {
    # Apply same categorization logic as used in OS sensitivity analysis
    histology_table_categorized <- histology_table %>%
      mutate(
        histology_group = case_when(
          # UC: urothelial/transitional, but exclude if it has variant features
          str_detect(tolower(`Histology Type`), regex("urothelial|pure|conventional|uc$|transitional", ignore_case = TRUE)) &
            !str_detect(tolower(`Histology Type`), regex("variant|mixed|squamous|adeno|sarcomatoid|micropapillary|plasmacytoid|nested|small.*cell|neuroendocrine|signet|ring.*cell|with.*differentiation|with.*features", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "UC",
          # Variant: any variant histology, mixed, squamous, adeno, sarcomatoid, micropapillary, neuroendocrine, signet ring, or TCC with features/differentiation
          str_detect(tolower(`Histology Type`), regex("variant|mixed|squamous|adeno|sarcomatoid|micropapillary|plasmacytoid|nested|small.*cell|neuroendocrine|signet|ring.*cell|with.*differentiation|with.*features", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Variant",
          TRUE ~ "Variant"  # Default to Variant for all others (all histologies should be classified)
        )
      )
    
    pure_uc <- histology_table_categorized %>%
      filter(histology_group == "UC")
    
    variant_mixed <- histology_table_categorized %>%
      filter(histology_group == "Variant")
    
    if (nrow(pure_uc) > 0) {
      cat("Pure urothelial carcinoma:", sum(pure_uc$N), "patients (", round(sum(pure_uc$Percentage), 1), "%)\n")
    }
    if (nrow(variant_mixed) > 0) {
      cat("Variant or mixed histology:", sum(variant_mixed$N), "patients (", round(sum(variant_mixed$Percentage), 1), "%)\n")
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("Histology data not available in the dataset.\n")
  cat("Checked for column names matching: histology\n")
  cat("Available columns containing 'histology':", 
      paste(names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("histology", ignore_case = TRUE))], collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

```{r data_completeness_diagnostic, include=FALSE}
# Diagnostic: Check data completeness for event classification
data_completeness <- outcomes %>%
  mutate(
    has_death_date = !is.na(death_date),
    has_last_fu_date = !is.na(last_fu_date),
    has_alive_status = !is.na(alive_status),
    alive_status_value = alive_status,
    has_imaging_status = !is.na(imaging_disease_present),
    imaging_status_value = imaging_disease_present,
    # Classify MFS events: death OR (alive with disease on imaging)
    event_classification = case_when(
      !is.na(death_date) ~ "Event: Death (has death_date)",
      alive_status == "No" ~ "Event: Death (alive_status=No)",
      alive_status == "Yes" & imaging_disease_present == "Yes" ~ "Event: Imaging shows disease (alive with disease)",
      alive_status == "Yes" & imaging_disease_present == "No" ~ "Censored: Alive without disease on imaging",
      is.na(alive_status) & !is.na(last_fu_date) ~ "Censored: Missing alive_status, has FU date",
      TRUE ~ "Censored: Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(patient_id, has_death_date, has_last_fu_date, has_alive_status, 
         alive_status_value, has_imaging_status, imaging_status_value,
         event_classification, mfs_event, mfs_time)

# Summary of data completeness
completeness_summary <- data_completeness %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    `Has Death Date` = sum(has_death_date),
    `Has Last FU Date` = sum(has_last_fu_date),
    `Has Alive Status` = sum(has_alive_status),
    `Alive Status = Yes` = sum(alive_status_value == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    `Alive Status = No` = sum(alive_status_value == "No", na.rm = TRUE),
    `Alive Status Missing` = sum(is.na(alive_status_value)),
    `Events` = sum(mfs_event),
    `Censored` = sum(1 - mfs_event),
    `Censoring Rate` = round(mean(1 - mfs_event), 3)
  )

# Breakdown by classification
classification_breakdown <- data_completeness %>%
  count(event_classification) %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1))

cat("Data Completeness Summary:\n")
print(completeness_summary)
cat("\nEvent Classification Breakdown:\n")
print(classification_breakdown)
```

```{r censoring_analysis, include=FALSE}
# Censoring rate analysis - similar to descriptive analysis
# 
# ====================================================================================
# CENSORING CRITERIA FOR DURATION OF COMPLETE RESPONSE (DCR)
# ====================================================================================
# 
# DCR EVENT (dcr_event = 1, stored as mfs_event) occurs when ANY of the following:
#   1. Patient has died (death_date is not NA)
#   2. Patient is deceased (alive_status = "No")
#   3. Patient is alive BUT has obvious disease on most recent imaging
#      (imaging_disease_present = "Yes")
#      Note: This represents loss of complete response (similar to RECIST progression from CR).
#      This includes stable disease, partial response, or progressive disease.
#
# DCR CENSORED (dcr_event = 0) occurs when:
#   - Patient is alive (alive_status = "Yes") AND
#   - Patient has NO obvious disease on most recent imaging
#     (imaging_disease_present = "No")
#     Note: This represents maintenance of complete response (similar to RECIST CR)
#   - NOTE: If imaging field is BLANK or MISSING AND patient is ALIVE, patient is EXCLUDED (imaging data is required for alive patients only)
#   - NOTE: If patient DIED, imaging data is NOT required (death is an event)
#
# DCR TIME CALCULATION:
#   - Censoring time = last_fu_date (last follow-up date)
#   - Event time = death_date (if available) OR last_fu_date (if imaging shows disease)
#   - Time is calculated from time_zero_date (therapy start) to event_or_censor_date
# ====================================================================================
#
# Create censoring indicator
outcomes_with_cens <- outcomes %>%
  filter(!is.na(ctdna_before_line_value)) %>%  # Remove NA values before creating tertiles
  mutate(
    censored = 1 - mfs_event,  # 1 = censored, 0 = event
    ctdna_tertile = ntile(ctdna_before_line_value, 3),
    ctdna_group = case_when(
      ctdna_tertile == 1 ~ "T1 (Lowest)",
      ctdna_tertile == 2 ~ "T2",
      ctdna_tertile == 3 ~ "T3 (Highest)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # Should not happen, but catch any issues
    )
  )

# Diagnostic: Check tertile distribution
tertile_check <- outcomes_with_cens %>%
  count(ctdna_tertile, ctdna_group) %>%
  arrange(ctdna_tertile)
cat("Tertile distribution check:\n")
print(tertile_check)
cat("Total observations:", nrow(outcomes_with_cens), "\n")

# Calculate censoring rates by ctDNA tertile
# Ensure all tertiles are included even if they have 0 observations
all_tertiles <- c("T1 (Lowest)", "T2", "T3 (Highest)")
censoring_rates <- outcomes_with_cens %>%
  group_by(ctdna_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    n_events = sum(mfs_event, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_censored = sum(censored, na.rm = TRUE),
    censoring_rate = mean(censored, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Ensure all tertiles are present in censoring_rates (even if 0 observations)
# Start with complete tertile list and left join the calculated rates
censoring_rates <- tibble(ctdna_group = all_tertiles) %>%
  left_join(censoring_rates, by = "ctdna_group") %>%
  mutate(
    n = replace_na(n, 0),
    n_events = replace_na(n_events, 0),
    n_censored = replace_na(n_censored, 0),
    censoring_rate = replace_na(censoring_rate, 0)
  )

# Chi-square test for independence of censoring and group
if (nrow(censoring_rates) > 1 && sum(censoring_rates$n_censored) > 0 && sum(censoring_rates$n_events) > 0) {
  censoring_table <- table(outcomes_with_cens$ctdna_group, outcomes_with_cens$censored)
  chi_square_test <- tryCatch(
    chisq.test(censoring_table),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
} else {
  chi_square_test <- NULL
}

# Kruskal-Wallis test for censoring times (for censored patients only)
censored_patients <- outcomes_with_cens %>%
  filter(censored == 1)

if (nrow(censored_patients) > 0 && length(unique(censored_patients$ctdna_group)) > 1) {
  kruskal_test <- tryCatch(
    kruskal.test(mfs_time ~ ctdna_group, data = censored_patients),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
} else {
  kruskal_test <- NULL
}

cat("Censoring analysis completed.\n")
if (!is.null(chi_square_test)) {
  cat("Chi-square p-value:", chi_square_test$p.value, "\n")
  if (chi_square_test$p.value >= 0.05) {
    cat("Censoring appears non-informative (p >= 0.05)\n")
  } else {
    cat("Censoring may be informative (p < 0.05)\n")
  }
}
```

## Tertiary Analysis: Overall Survival

**What is the association between baseline ctDNA level before starting a new line of therapy and overall survival?**

This tertiary analysis examines whether baseline ctDNA levels (measured within 21 days before starting therapy) are associated with overall survival. Overall survival is defined as the time from therapy initiation until death, with death as the event and alive patients censored at last follow-up.

```{r overall_survival_setup_q1, include=FALSE}
# ====================================================================================
# OVERALL SURVIVAL ANALYSIS FOR QUESTION 1
# ====================================================================================
# Overall survival = time from therapy start to death
# Event = 1 if patient died
# Censored = 0 if patient is alive at last follow-up
# ====================================================================================

# Get death dates and last follow-up dates (already defined above, but ensure they're available)
death_date_cols_os <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^death_date$|death.*date$", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                       !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("cause|reason", ignore_case = TRUE))]
survival_cols_os <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                     !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("death", ignore_case = TRUE))]
alive_cols_os <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^alive_yes_no$|alive.*yes.*no", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Create overall survival outcomes for baseline analysis
outcomes_os_q1 <- outcomes %>%
  select(patient_id, therapy_line, time_zero_date, ctdna_before_line_value) %>%
  # Join with death and follow-up data
  left_join(
    dat_combined %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(c(death_date_cols_os, survival_cols_os, alive_cols_os))),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    death_date = if (length(death_date_cols_os) > 0) {
      as_date_safe(.data[[death_date_cols_os[1]]])
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    last_fu_date = if (length(survival_cols_os) > 0) {
      as_date_safe(.data[[survival_cols_os[1]]])
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    alive_status = if (length(alive_cols_os) > 0) {
      case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols_os[1]]])), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols_os[1]]])), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    # Time 0 for OS analysis = therapy start date (time_zero_date)
    # Event date = death date
    # Censor date = last follow-up if no death
    event_date = ifelse(!is.na(death_date), death_date, NA),
    censor_date = case_when(
      !is.na(death_date) ~ death_date,
      !is.na(last_fu_date) ~ last_fu_date,
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    ),
    # OS time = time from therapy start to death/censor
    os_time = as.numeric(censor_date - time_zero_date),
    # OS event = 1 if death occurred, 0 if censored (alive)
    os_event = case_when(
      !is.na(death_date) ~ 1,  # Death occurred
      alive_status == "No" ~ 1,  # Deceased
      alive_status == "Yes" ~ 0,  # Alive (censored)
      !is.na(last_fu_date) ~ 0,  # Has follow-up but no death date (censored)
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  # Filter: require valid OS time
  filter(!is.na(os_time), os_time > 0)

cat("Overall Survival Analysis Setup (Question 1):\n")
cat("Patients in baseline analysis:", nrow(outcomes), "\n")
cat("Patients with valid OS data:", nrow(outcomes_os_q1), "\n")
cat("OS events (deaths):", sum(outcomes_os_q1$os_event, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("OS censored (alive):", sum(outcomes_os_q1$os_event == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Median OS time (days):", round(median(outcomes_os_q1$os_time, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "\n")
```
