```{r overall_survival_analysis_q1, include=FALSE}
# ====================================================================================
# OVERALL SURVIVAL ANALYSIS: Baseline ctDNA and OS
# ====================================================================================
# Perform Cox models for OS with baseline ctDNA as predictor
# ====================================================================================

# Initialize N variables (will be set to actual values if analysis is available)
n_os_unadj <- 0
n_os_line <- 0
n_os_line_class <- 0
n_os_adj <- 0
n_os_tert_unadj <- 0
n_os_tert_adj <- 0
n_os_tert_multiv <- 0

if (exists("outcomes_os_q1") && nrow(outcomes_os_q1) > 0) {
  # Prepare data for models (similar to DCR and TTNT analysis)
  outcomes_os_for_model <- outcomes_os_q1 %>%
    # Join therapy class
    left_join(
      palliative_regimen_table %>%
        mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(is.na(therapy_line_match), NA_integer_, therapy_line_match)) %>%
        select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, therapy_class) %>%
        distinct(),
      by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line" = "therapy_line_match")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      therapy_line_grouped = case_when(
        therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
        therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
        therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
        therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
        TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
      ),
      therapy_line_factor = factor(therapy_line_grouped, levels = c("1L", "2L", "3L", "4L+")),
      therapy_class = replace_na(therapy_class, "unspecified"),
      therapy_class_factor = factor(therapy_class)
    )
  
  # Join Bajorin risk factors if available
  # IMPORTANT: Normalize therapy lines >= 4 to 4 for matching
  if (exists("bajorin_data") && nrow(bajorin_data) > 0) {
    bajorin_data_normalized_os <- bajorin_data %>%
      mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(therapy_line >= 4, 4, therapy_line))
    
    outcomes_os_for_model <- outcomes_os_for_model %>%
      mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(therapy_line >= 4, 4, therapy_line)) %>%
      left_join(
        bajorin_data_normalized_os %>% select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, kps_binary, visceral_mets_binary),
        by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line_match")
      ) %>%
      select(-therapy_line_match) %>%
      mutate(
        kps_factor = factor(kps_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("KPS <80%", "KPS ≥80%")),
        visceral_mets_factor = factor(visceral_mets_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Visceral Mets", "Visceral Mets"))
      )
  } else {
    outcomes_os_for_model <- outcomes_os_for_model %>%
      mutate(
        kps_binary = NA_real_,
        visceral_mets_binary = NA_real_,
        kps_factor = factor(NA, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("KPS <80%", "KPS ≥80%")),
        visceral_mets_factor = factor(NA, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Visceral Mets", "Visceral Mets"))
      )
  }
  
  # Filter to observations with baseline ctDNA
  outcomes_os_for_model <- outcomes_os_for_model %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_before_line_value))
  
  # Initialize N variables
  n_os_unadj <- 0
  n_os_line <- 0
  
  # Model 1: Unadjusted (ctDNA only)
  # Count complete cases
  outcomes_os_unadj <- outcomes_os_for_model %>%
    filter(!is.na(os_time), !is.na(os_event))
  n_os_unadj <- nrow(outcomes_os_unadj)
  
  cox_os_unadj <- tryCatch({
    coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1), 
          data = outcomes_os_for_model)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  cox_os_unadj_summary <- NULL
  if (!is.null(cox_os_unadj)) {
    cox_os_unadj_summary <- summary(cox_os_unadj)
  }
  
  # Model 2: Adjusted for line of therapy
  # Count complete cases
  outcomes_os_line <- outcomes_os_for_model %>%
    filter(!is.na(os_time), !is.na(os_event), !is.na(therapy_line_factor))
  n_os_line <- nrow(outcomes_os_line)
  
  cox_os_line <- tryCatch({
    coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1) + therapy_line_factor, 
          data = outcomes_os_for_model)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  cox_os_line_summary <- NULL
  if (!is.null(cox_os_line)) {
    cox_os_line_summary <- summary(cox_os_line)
  }
  
  # Model 3a: Adjusted for KPS only (if available)
  cox_os_kps <- NULL
  cox_os_kps_summary <- NULL
  n_os_kps <- 0
  if (sum(!is.na(outcomes_os_for_model$kps_binary)) > 0) {
    outcomes_os_kps <- outcomes_os_for_model %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary))
    
    if (nrow(outcomes_os_kps) > 0) {
      cox_os_kps <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1) + kps_factor, 
              data = outcomes_os_kps)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(cox_os_kps)) {
        cox_os_kps_summary <- summary(cox_os_kps)
        n_os_kps <- cox_os_kps$n  # Use actual N from model
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Model 3b: Adjusted for visceral metastases only (if available)
  cox_os_visceral <- NULL
  cox_os_visceral_summary <- NULL
  n_os_visceral <- 0
  if (sum(!is.na(outcomes_os_for_model$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0) {
    outcomes_os_visceral <- outcomes_os_for_model %>%
      filter(!is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
    
    if (nrow(outcomes_os_visceral) > 0) {
      cox_os_visceral <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1) + visceral_mets_factor, 
              data = outcomes_os_visceral)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(cox_os_visceral)) {
        cox_os_visceral_summary <- summary(cox_os_visceral)
        n_os_visceral <- cox_os_visceral$n  # Use actual N from model
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Model 3c: Adjusted for therapy class only (if available)
  # Filter therapy classes with sufficient sample size
  therapy_class_counts_os <- outcomes_os_for_model %>%
    filter(!is.na(therapy_class)) %>%
    count(therapy_class) %>%
    filter(n >= 5) %>%
    pull(therapy_class)
  
  cox_os_class <- NULL
  cox_os_class_summary <- NULL
  n_os_class <- 0
  if (length(therapy_class_counts_os) > 0) {
    outcomes_os_class <- outcomes_os_for_model %>%
      filter(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_os | is.na(therapy_class))
    
    if (nrow(outcomes_os_class) > 0) {
      outcomes_os_class <- outcomes_os_class %>%
        mutate(
          therapy_class_filtered = ifelse(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_os, therapy_class, "unspecified"),
          therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
        )
      
      cox_os_class <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1) + therapy_class_factor_filtered, 
              data = outcomes_os_class)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(cox_os_class)) {
        cox_os_class_summary <- summary(cox_os_class)
        n_os_class <- cox_os_class$n  # Use actual N from model
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Model 3d: Adjusted for line of therapy + therapy class (for backward compatibility)
  outcomes_os_line_class <- outcomes_os_for_model %>%
    filter(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_os | is.na(therapy_class))
  
  cox_os_line_class <- NULL
  cox_os_line_class_summary <- NULL
  n_os_line_class <- 0
  if (nrow(outcomes_os_line_class) > 0 && length(therapy_class_counts_os) > 0) {
    outcomes_os_line_class <- outcomes_os_line_class %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_class_filtered = ifelse(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_os, therapy_class, "unspecified"),
        therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
      )
    
    cox_os_line_class <- tryCatch({
      coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1) + 
            therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor_filtered, 
            data = outcomes_os_line_class)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_os_line_class)) {
      cox_os_line_class_summary <- summary(cox_os_line_class)
      n_os_line_class <- cox_os_line_class$n  # Use actual N from model
    } else {
      n_os_line_class <- 0
    }
  }
  
  # Model 4: Multivariate (line + therapy class + KPS + visceral mets)
  # Use flexible model building
  has_kps_os <- sum(!is.na(outcomes_os_for_model$kps_binary)) > 0
  has_visceral_os <- sum(!is.na(outcomes_os_for_model$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0
  has_therapy_class_os <- length(therapy_class_counts_os) > 0
  
  cox_os_adj <- NULL
  cox_os_adj_summary <- NULL
  outcomes_os_multiv <- outcomes_os_for_model %>% filter(FALSE)
  n_os_adj <- 0
  
  if (has_kps_os && has_visceral_os) {
    outcomes_os_multiv <- outcomes_os_for_model %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
    
    if (nrow(outcomes_os_multiv) > 0) {
      # Build formula dynamically
      formula_parts_os <- c("log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1)", "therapy_line_factor")
      
      if (has_therapy_class_os) {
        outcomes_os_multiv <- outcomes_os_multiv %>%
          mutate(
            therapy_class_filtered = ifelse(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_os, therapy_class, "unspecified"),
            therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
          )
        formula_parts_os <- c(formula_parts_os, "therapy_class_factor_filtered")
      }
      
      formula_parts_os <- c(formula_parts_os, "kps_factor", "visceral_mets_factor")
      formula_str_os <- paste("Surv(os_time, os_event) ~", paste(formula_parts_os, collapse = " + "))
      
      cox_os_adj <- tryCatch({
        coxph(as.formula(formula_str_os), data = outcomes_os_multiv)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(cox_os_adj)) {
        cox_os_adj_summary <- summary(cox_os_adj)
        n_os_adj <- cox_os_adj$n  # Use actual N from model
      } else {
        n_os_adj <- 0
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Add tertile comparisons (T2 vs T1, T3 vs T1) for OS
  if (nrow(outcomes_os_for_model) >= 3) {
    outcomes_os_for_tertiles <- outcomes_os_for_model %>%
      filter(!is.na(ctdna_before_line_value), !is.na(os_time), !is.na(os_event)) %>%
      mutate(
        ctdna_tertile = ntile(ctdna_before_line_value, 3),
        ctdna_tertile_label = case_when(
          ctdna_tertile == 1 ~ "T1 (Lowest)",
          ctdna_tertile == 2 ~ "T2",
          ctdna_tertile == 3 ~ "T3 (Highest)"
        ),
        ctdna_tertile_factor = factor(ctdna_tertile_label, 
                                        levels = c("T1 (Lowest)", "T2", "T3 (Highest)"))
      )
    
    # Unadjusted tertile model
    cox_os_tertiles_unadj <- tryCatch({
      coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_factor, data = outcomes_os_for_tertiles)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_os_tertiles_unadj)) {
      n_os_tert_unadj <- cox_os_tertiles_unadj$n  # Use actual N from model
    } else {
      n_os_tert_unadj <- 0
    }
    
    # Adjusted tertile model (for line of therapy)
    outcomes_os_tertiles_adj <- outcomes_os_for_tertiles %>%
      filter(!is.na(therapy_line_factor))
    
    cox_os_tertiles_adj <- tryCatch({
      coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_factor + therapy_line_factor, 
            data = outcomes_os_tertiles_adj)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_os_tertiles_adj)) {
      n_os_tert_adj <- cox_os_tertiles_adj$n  # Use actual N from model
    } else {
      n_os_tert_adj <- 0
    }
    
    # Fully adjusted tertile model (line + therapy class + KPS + visceral mets)
    cox_os_tertiles_multiv <- NULL
    n_os_tert_multiv <- 0
    if (has_kps_os && has_visceral_os) {
      outcomes_os_tertiles_multiv <- outcomes_os_for_tertiles %>%
        filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
      
      if (nrow(outcomes_os_tertiles_multiv) > 0) {
        formula_parts_os_tert <- c("ctdna_tertile_factor", "therapy_line_factor")
        
        if (has_therapy_class_os) {
          outcomes_os_tertiles_multiv <- outcomes_os_tertiles_multiv %>%
            mutate(
              therapy_class_filtered = ifelse(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_os, therapy_class, "unspecified"),
              therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
            )
          formula_parts_os_tert <- c(formula_parts_os_tert, "therapy_class_factor_filtered")
        }
        
        formula_parts_os_tert <- c(formula_parts_os_tert, "kps_factor", "visceral_mets_factor")
        formula_str_os_tert <- paste("Surv(os_time, os_event) ~", paste(formula_parts_os_tert, collapse = " + "))
        
        cox_os_tertiles_multiv <- tryCatch({
          coxph(as.formula(formula_str_os_tert), data = outcomes_os_tertiles_multiv)
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if (!is.null(cox_os_tertiles_multiv)) {
          n_os_tert_multiv <- cox_os_tertiles_multiv$n  # Use actual N from model
        } else {
          n_os_tert_multiv <- 0
        }
      } else {
        n_os_tert_multiv <- 0
      }
    } else {
      n_os_tert_multiv <- 0
    }
  } else {
    cox_os_tertiles_unadj <- NULL
    cox_os_tertiles_adj <- NULL
    cox_os_tertiles_multiv <- NULL
    outcomes_os_for_tertiles <- outcomes_os_for_model %>% filter(FALSE)
    # Keep N variables at 0 if tertiles not available
  }
  
  cat("OS Cox Models:\n")
  cat("Unadjusted model:", ifelse(!is.null(cox_os_unadj), "Fitted", "Not fitted"), "\n")
  cat("Adjusted for line:", ifelse(!is.null(cox_os_line), "Fitted", "Not fitted"), "\n")
  cat("Adjusted for line + class:", ifelse(!is.null(cox_os_line_class), "Fitted", "Not fitted"), "\n")
  cat("Multivariate model:", ifelse(!is.null(cox_os_adj), "Fitted", "Not fitted"), "\n")
} else {
  cox_os_unadj <- NULL
  cox_os_line <- NULL
  cox_os_line_class <- NULL
  cox_os_adj <- NULL
  cox_os_tertiles_unadj <- NULL
  cox_os_tertiles_adj <- NULL
  cox_os_tertiles_multiv <- NULL
  outcomes_os_for_tertiles <- outcomes_os_for_model %>% filter(FALSE)
  # Initialize N variables to 0 if analysis not available
  n_os_unadj <- 0
  n_os_line <- 0
  n_os_line_class <- 0
  n_os_adj <- 0
  n_os_tert_unadj <- 0
  n_os_tert_adj <- 0
  n_os_tert_multiv <- 0
  cat("OS analysis not available - insufficient data.\n")
}
```

```{r os_results_table_q1}
# Display OS Cox model results
if (exists("cox_os_unadj") && !is.null(cox_os_unadj) && 
    exists("cox_os_unadj_summary") && !is.null(cox_os_unadj_summary)) {
  
  # Build results table
  os_results_list <- list()
  
  # Unadjusted
  if (!is.null(cox_os_unadj_summary)) {
    hr_os_unadj <- cox_os_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_os_unadj_lower <- cox_os_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_os_unadj_upper <- cox_os_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_os_unadj <- cox_os_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    os_results_list[[length(os_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
      `Model` = "Unadjusted",
      `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_os_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_os_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
      `P-value` = ifelse(p_os_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_unadj, 3)))
    )
  }
  
  # Adjusted for line
  if (!is.null(cox_os_line) && !is.null(cox_os_line_summary)) {
    hr_os_line <- cox_os_line_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_os_line_lower <- cox_os_line_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_os_line_upper <- cox_os_line_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_os_line <- cox_os_line_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    os_results_list[[length(os_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
      `Model` = "Adjusted for line of therapy",
      `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_os_line, 2), " (", round(hr_os_line_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_line_upper, 2), ")"),
      `P-value` = ifelse(p_os_line < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_line, 3)))
    )
  }
  
  # Adjusted for KPS
  if (!is.null(cox_os_kps) && !is.null(cox_os_kps_summary)) {
    hr_os_kps <- cox_os_kps_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_os_kps_lower <- cox_os_kps_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_os_kps_upper <- cox_os_kps_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_os_kps <- cox_os_kps_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    os_results_list[[length(os_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
      `Model` = "Adjusted for KPS",
      `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_os_kps, 2), " (", round(hr_os_kps_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_kps_upper, 2), ")"),
      `P-value` = ifelse(p_os_kps < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_kps, 3)))
    )
  }
  
  # Adjusted for visceral metastases
  if (!is.null(cox_os_visceral) && !is.null(cox_os_visceral_summary)) {
    hr_os_visceral <- cox_os_visceral_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_os_visceral_lower <- cox_os_visceral_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_os_visceral_upper <- cox_os_visceral_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_os_visceral <- cox_os_visceral_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    os_results_list[[length(os_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
      `Model` = "Adjusted for visceral metastases",
      `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_os_visceral, 2), " (", round(hr_os_visceral_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_visceral_upper, 2), ")"),
      `P-value` = ifelse(p_os_visceral < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_visceral, 3)))
    )
  }
  
  # Adjusted for therapy class only
  if (!is.null(cox_os_class) && !is.null(cox_os_class_summary)) {
    hr_os_class <- cox_os_class_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_os_class_lower <- cox_os_class_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_os_class_upper <- cox_os_class_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_os_class <- cox_os_class_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    os_results_list[[length(os_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
      `Model` = "Adjusted for therapy class",
      `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_os_class, 2), " (", round(hr_os_class_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_class_upper, 2), ")"),
      `P-value` = ifelse(p_os_class < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_class, 3)))
    )
  }
  
  # Multivariate
  if (!is.null(cox_os_adj) && !is.null(cox_os_adj_summary)) {
    hr_os_adj <- cox_os_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_os_adj_lower <- cox_os_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_os_adj_upper <- cox_os_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_os_adj <- cox_os_adj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    adj_text_os <- "line of therapy"
    if (has_therapy_class_os) adj_text_os <- paste0(adj_text_os, ", therapy class")
    adj_text_os <- paste0(adj_text_os, ", KPS, and visceral metastases")
    
    os_results_list[[length(os_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
      `Model` = paste0("Adjusted for ", adj_text_os),
      `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_os_adj, 2), " (", round(hr_os_adj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_adj_upper, 2), ")"),
      `P-value` = ifelse(p_os_adj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_adj, 3)))
    )
  }
  
  # Add tertile comparisons (T2 vs T1, T3 vs T1) for OS
  if (exists("cox_os_tertiles_unadj") && !is.null(cox_os_tertiles_unadj)) {
    cox_os_tertiles_unadj_summary <- summary(cox_os_tertiles_unadj)
    
    # T2 vs T1 (unadjusted)
    if (nrow(cox_os_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients) >= 1) {
      hr_os_t2_unadj <- exp(cox_os_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "coef"])
      hr_os_t2_unadj_lower <- cox_os_tertiles_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
      hr_os_t2_unadj_upper <- cox_os_tertiles_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
      p_os_t2_unadj <- cox_os_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      os_results_list[[length(os_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "T2 vs T1 (Unadjusted)",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_os_t2_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_os_t2_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_t2_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_os_t2_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_t2_unadj, 3)))
      )
    }
    
    # T3 vs T1 (unadjusted)
    if (nrow(cox_os_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients) >= 2) {
      hr_os_t3_unadj <- exp(cox_os_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients[2, "coef"])
      hr_os_t3_unadj_lower <- cox_os_tertiles_unadj_summary$conf.int[2, "lower .95"]
      hr_os_t3_unadj_upper <- cox_os_tertiles_unadj_summary$conf.int[2, "upper .95"]
      p_os_t3_unadj <- cox_os_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      os_results_list[[length(os_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "T3 vs T1 (Unadjusted)",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_os_t3_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_os_t3_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_t3_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_os_t3_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_t3_unadj, 3)))
      )
    }
  }
  
  # Check if fully adjusted tertile models are available first (prioritize these)
  fully_adj_os_available <- FALSE
  if (exists("cox_os_tertiles_multiv") && !is.null(cox_os_tertiles_multiv)) {
    model_converged_os <- tryCatch({
      isTRUE(cox_os_tertiles_multiv$converged)
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    
    if (model_converged_os) {
      cox_os_tertiles_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_os_tertiles_multiv)
      tertile_idx_os_multiv <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_os_tertiles_multiv_summary$coefficients), "ctdna_tertile_factor"))
      
      # T2 vs T1 (fully adjusted)
      if (length(tertile_idx_os_multiv) >= 1) {
        hr_os_t2_multiv <- exp(cox_os_tertiles_multiv_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_os_multiv[1], "coef"])
        hr_os_t2_multiv_lower <- cox_os_tertiles_multiv_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_os_multiv[1], "lower .95"]
        hr_os_t2_multiv_upper <- cox_os_tertiles_multiv_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_os_multiv[1], "upper .95"]
        p_os_t2_multiv <- cox_os_tertiles_multiv_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_os_multiv[1], "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        if (!is.na(hr_os_t2_multiv) && is.finite(hr_os_t2_multiv) && hr_os_t2_multiv > 0 && hr_os_t2_multiv < 1e10 &&
            !is.na(hr_os_t2_multiv_lower) && is.finite(hr_os_t2_multiv_lower) &&
            !is.na(hr_os_t2_multiv_upper) && is.finite(hr_os_t2_multiv_upper)) {
          
          adj_text_os_tert <- "line of therapy"
          if (has_therapy_class_os) adj_text_os_tert <- paste0(adj_text_os_tert, ", therapy class")
          adj_text_os_tert <- paste0(adj_text_os_tert, ", KPS, and visceral metastases")
          
          os_results_list[[length(os_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Model` = paste0("T2 vs T1 (Adjusted for ", adj_text_os_tert, ")"),
            `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_os_t2_multiv, 2), " (", round(hr_os_t2_multiv_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_t2_multiv_upper, 2), ")"),
            `P-value` = ifelse(p_os_t2_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_t2_multiv, 3)))
          )
          fully_adj_os_available <- TRUE
        }
      }
      
      # T3 vs T1 (fully adjusted)
      if (length(tertile_idx_os_multiv) >= 2) {
        hr_os_t3_multiv <- exp(cox_os_tertiles_multiv_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_os_multiv[2], "coef"])
        hr_os_t3_multiv_lower <- cox_os_tertiles_multiv_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_os_multiv[2], "lower .95"]
        hr_os_t3_multiv_upper <- cox_os_tertiles_multiv_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_os_multiv[2], "upper .95"]
        p_os_t3_multiv <- cox_os_tertiles_multiv_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_os_multiv[2], "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        if (!is.na(hr_os_t3_multiv) && is.finite(hr_os_t3_multiv) && hr_os_t3_multiv > 0 && hr_os_t3_multiv < 1e10 &&
            !is.na(hr_os_t3_multiv_lower) && is.finite(hr_os_t3_multiv_lower) &&
            !is.na(hr_os_t3_multiv_upper) && is.finite(hr_os_t3_multiv_upper)) {
          
          adj_text_os_tert <- "line of therapy"
          if (has_therapy_class_os) adj_text_os_tert <- paste0(adj_text_os_tert, ", therapy class")
          adj_text_os_tert <- paste0(adj_text_os_tert, ", KPS, and visceral metastases")
          
          os_results_list[[length(os_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Model` = paste0("T3 vs T1 (Adjusted for ", adj_text_os_tert, ")"),
            `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_os_t3_multiv, 2), " (", round(hr_os_t3_multiv_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_t3_multiv_upper, 2), ")"),
            `P-value` = ifelse(p_os_t3_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_t3_multiv, 3)))
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # If fully adjusted models not available, fall back to line-adjusted models
  if (!fully_adj_os_available && exists("cox_os_tertiles_adj") && !is.null(cox_os_tertiles_adj)) {
    cox_os_tertiles_adj_summary <- summary(cox_os_tertiles_adj)
    
    # Find tertile coefficient indices
    tertile_idx_os <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_os_tertiles_adj_summary$coefficients), "ctdna_tertile_factor"))
    
    # T2 vs T1 (adjusted for line only)
    if (length(tertile_idx_os) >= 1) {
      hr_os_t2_adj <- exp(cox_os_tertiles_adj_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_os[1], "coef"])
      hr_os_t2_adj_lower <- cox_os_tertiles_adj_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_os[1], "lower .95"]
      hr_os_t2_adj_upper <- cox_os_tertiles_adj_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_os[1], "upper .95"]
      p_os_t2_adj <- cox_os_tertiles_adj_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_os[1], "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      os_results_list[[length(os_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "T2 vs T1 (Adjusted for line of therapy)",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_os_t2_adj, 2), " (", round(hr_os_t2_adj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_t2_adj_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_os_t2_adj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_t2_adj, 3)))
      )
    }
    
    # T3 vs T1 (adjusted for line only)
    if (length(tertile_idx_os) >= 2) {
      hr_os_t3_adj <- exp(cox_os_tertiles_adj_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_os[2], "coef"])
      hr_os_t3_adj_lower <- cox_os_tertiles_adj_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_os[2], "lower .95"]
      hr_os_t3_adj_upper <- cox_os_tertiles_adj_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_os[2], "upper .95"]
      p_os_t3_adj <- cox_os_tertiles_adj_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_os[2], "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      os_results_list[[length(os_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "T3 vs T1 (Adjusted for line of therapy)",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_os_t3_adj, 2), " (", round(hr_os_t3_adj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_t3_adj_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_os_t3_adj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_t3_adj, 3)))
      )
    }
  }
  
  if (length(os_results_list) > 0) {
    os_results_table <- bind_rows(os_results_list) %>%
      kable(caption = "Cox Proportional Hazards Model: ctDNA Level Before Therapy and Overall Survival. Top section shows continuous ctDNA (log10(ctDNA + 1)) with HR progression as covariates are added. Bottom section shows tertile comparisons (T2 vs T1, T3 vs T1) with T1 (Lowest) as reference. HR > 1 indicates shorter overall survival (higher risk of death) compared to reference.") %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
    
    os_results_table
  } else {
    cat("Overall Survival Cox model results not available.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Overall Survival analysis results table not available.\n")
  cat("Unadjusted model not available or did not converge.\n")
}
```

## Comparison: Quantitative vs Qualitative ctDNA Models for Overall Survival

This analysis compares whether a quantitative (continuous log-transformed) ctDNA model is more informative than a qualitative (binary: 0 vs >0) threshold model for overall survival.

```{r os_quantitative_vs_qualitative_comparison, include=FALSE}
# ====================================================================================
# Comparison: Quantitative (Continuous) vs Qualitative (Binary: 0 vs >0) ctDNA Models for OS
# ====================================================================================
# This analysis compares whether a quantitative (continuous log-transformed) ctDNA 
# model is more informative than a qualitative (binary: 0 vs >0) threshold model for OS.
# ====================================================================================

if (exists("outcomes_os_for_model") && nrow(outcomes_os_for_model) > 0) {
  # Create binary ctDNA variable: 0 = ctDNA = 0 (negative), 1 = ctDNA > 0 (positive)
  outcomes_os_binary <- outcomes_os_for_model %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_before_line_value)) %>%
    mutate(
      ctdna_binary = ifelse(ctdna_before_line_value == 0, 0, 1),
      ctdna_binary_factor = factor(ctdna_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("ctDNA = 0 (Negative)", "ctDNA > 0 (Positive)"))
    )
  
  # Check distribution of ctDNA values
  ctdna_distribution_os <- outcomes_os_binary %>%
    summarise(
      n_total = n(),
      n_zero = sum(ctdna_before_line_value == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_positive = sum(ctdna_before_line_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_zero = round(n_zero / n_total * 100, 1),
      pct_positive = round(n_positive / n_total * 100, 1),
      median_positive = median(ctdna_before_line_value[ctdna_before_line_value > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
      q25_positive = quantile(ctdna_before_line_value[ctdna_before_line_value > 0], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75_positive = quantile(ctdna_before_line_value[ctdna_before_line_value > 0], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  # Fit binary models for OS (same structure as quantitative models)
  
  # Model 1: Unadjusted (binary ctDNA only)
  cox_os_binary_unadj <- tryCatch({
    coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ ctdna_binary_factor, data = outcomes_os_binary)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  cox_os_binary_unadj_summary <- NULL
  if (!is.null(cox_os_binary_unadj)) {
    cox_os_binary_unadj_summary <- summary(cox_os_binary_unadj)
  }
  
  # Model 2: Adjusted for line of therapy
  cox_os_binary_line <- tryCatch({
    coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ ctdna_binary_factor + therapy_line_factor, 
          data = outcomes_os_binary)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  cox_os_binary_line_summary <- NULL
  if (!is.null(cox_os_binary_line)) {
    cox_os_binary_line_summary <- summary(cox_os_binary_line)
  }
  
  # Model 3: Multivariate (line + therapy class + KPS + visceral mets) - if available
  cox_os_binary_multiv <- NULL
  cox_os_binary_multiv_summary <- NULL
  has_kps_os_binary <- sum(!is.na(outcomes_os_binary$kps_binary)) > 0
  has_visceral_os_binary <- sum(!is.na(outcomes_os_binary$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0
  
  # Check therapy class sample sizes
  therapy_class_counts_os_binary <- outcomes_os_binary %>%
    filter(!is.na(therapy_class)) %>%
    count(therapy_class) %>%
    filter(n >= 5) %>%
    pull(therapy_class)
  has_therapy_class_os_binary <- length(therapy_class_counts_os_binary) > 0
  
  if (has_kps_os_binary && has_visceral_os_binary) {
    outcomes_os_binary_multiv <- outcomes_os_binary %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
    
    if (nrow(outcomes_os_binary_multiv) > 0) {
      # Build formula dynamically
      formula_parts_os_binary <- c("ctdna_binary_factor", "therapy_line_factor")
      
      if (has_therapy_class_os_binary) {
        outcomes_os_binary_multiv <- outcomes_os_binary_multiv %>%
          mutate(
            therapy_class_filtered = ifelse(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_os_binary, therapy_class, "unspecified"),
            therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
          )
        formula_parts_os_binary <- c(formula_parts_os_binary, "therapy_class_factor_filtered")
      }
      
      formula_parts_os_binary <- c(formula_parts_os_binary, "kps_factor", "visceral_mets_factor")
      formula_str_os_binary <- paste("Surv(os_time, os_event) ~", paste(formula_parts_os_binary, collapse = " + "))
      
      cox_os_binary_multiv <- tryCatch({
        coxph(as.formula(formula_str_os_binary), data = outcomes_os_binary_multiv)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(cox_os_binary_multiv)) {
        cox_os_binary_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_os_binary_multiv)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Get quantitative model results (already computed above)
  # Use the variables from the OS analysis chunk
  
  # Initialize comparison results list
  os_comparison_results_list <- list()
  
  # 1. Unadjusted models
  if (!is.null(cox_os_binary_unadj) && !is.null(cox_os_binary_unadj_summary)) {
    hr_os_binary_unadj <- cox_os_binary_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_os_binary_unadj_lower <- cox_os_binary_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_os_binary_unadj_upper <- cox_os_binary_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_os_binary_unadj <- cox_os_binary_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    aic_os_binary_unadj <- AIC(cox_os_binary_unadj)
    bic_os_binary_unadj <- BIC(cox_os_binary_unadj)
  } else {
    hr_os_binary_unadj <- NA
    hr_os_binary_unadj_lower <- NA
    hr_os_binary_unadj_upper <- NA
    p_os_binary_unadj <- NA
    aic_os_binary_unadj <- NA
    bic_os_binary_unadj <- NA
  }
  
  if (!is.null(cox_os_unadj) && exists("cox_os_unadj_summary") && !is.null(cox_os_unadj_summary)) {
    hr_os_unadj <- cox_os_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_os_unadj_lower <- cox_os_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_os_unadj_upper <- cox_os_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_os_unadj <- cox_os_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    aic_os_quant_unadj <- AIC(cox_os_unadj)
    bic_os_quant_unadj <- BIC(cox_os_unadj)
  } else {
    hr_os_unadj <- NA
    hr_os_unadj_lower <- NA
    hr_os_unadj_upper <- NA
    p_os_unadj <- NA
    aic_os_quant_unadj <- NA
    bic_os_quant_unadj <- NA
  }
  
  os_comparison_results_list[[length(os_comparison_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
    `Model Type` = "Unadjusted",
    `Quantitative HR (95% CI)` = ifelse(!is.na(hr_os_unadj),
                                        paste0(round(hr_os_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_os_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
                                        "N/A"),
    `Quantitative P-value` = ifelse(!is.na(p_os_unadj),
                                   ifelse(p_os_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_unadj, 3))),
                                   "N/A"),
    `Quantitative AIC` = ifelse(!is.na(aic_os_quant_unadj), round(aic_os_quant_unadj, 1), NA),
    `Quantitative BIC` = ifelse(!is.na(bic_os_quant_unadj), round(bic_os_quant_unadj, 1), NA),
    `Qualitative HR (95% CI)` = ifelse(!is.na(hr_os_binary_unadj), 
                                       paste0(round(hr_os_binary_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_os_binary_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_binary_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
                                       "N/A"),
    `Qualitative P-value` = ifelse(!is.na(p_os_binary_unadj),
                                   ifelse(p_os_binary_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_binary_unadj, 3))),
                                   "N/A"),
    `Qualitative AIC` = ifelse(!is.na(aic_os_binary_unadj), round(aic_os_binary_unadj, 1), NA),
    `Qualitative BIC` = ifelse(!is.na(bic_os_binary_unadj), round(bic_os_binary_unadj, 1), NA)
  )
  
  # 2. Adjusted for line of therapy
  if (!is.null(cox_os_binary_line) && !is.null(cox_os_binary_line_summary)) {
    ctdna_idx_os_binary_line <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_os_binary_line_summary$coefficients), "ctdna_binary_factor"))
    if (length(ctdna_idx_os_binary_line) > 0) {
      hr_os_binary_line <- cox_os_binary_line_summary$conf.int[ctdna_idx_os_binary_line[1], "exp(coef)"]
      hr_os_binary_line_lower <- cox_os_binary_line_summary$conf.int[ctdna_idx_os_binary_line[1], "lower .95"]
      hr_os_binary_line_upper <- cox_os_binary_line_summary$conf.int[ctdna_idx_os_binary_line[1], "upper .95"]
      p_os_binary_line <- cox_os_binary_line_summary$coefficients[ctdna_idx_os_binary_line[1], "Pr(>|z|)"]
    } else {
      hr_os_binary_line <- NA
      hr_os_binary_line_lower <- NA
      hr_os_binary_line_upper <- NA
      p_os_binary_line <- NA
    }
    aic_os_binary_line <- AIC(cox_os_binary_line)
    bic_os_binary_line <- BIC(cox_os_binary_line)
  } else {
    hr_os_binary_line <- NA
    hr_os_binary_line_lower <- NA
    hr_os_binary_line_upper <- NA
    p_os_binary_line <- NA
    aic_os_binary_line <- NA
    bic_os_binary_line <- NA
  }
  
  if (!is.null(cox_os_line) && exists("cox_os_line_summary") && !is.null(cox_os_line_summary)) {
    hr_os_line <- cox_os_line_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_os_line_lower <- cox_os_line_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_os_line_upper <- cox_os_line_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_os_line <- cox_os_line_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    aic_os_quant_line <- AIC(cox_os_line)
    bic_os_quant_line <- BIC(cox_os_line)
  } else {
    hr_os_line <- NA
    hr_os_line_lower <- NA
    hr_os_line_upper <- NA
    p_os_line <- NA
    aic_os_quant_line <- NA
    bic_os_quant_line <- NA
  }
  
  os_comparison_results_list[[length(os_comparison_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
    `Model Type` = "Adjusted for line of therapy",
    `Quantitative HR (95% CI)` = ifelse(!is.na(hr_os_line),
                                        paste0(round(hr_os_line, 2), " (", round(hr_os_line_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_line_upper, 2), ")"),
                                        "N/A"),
    `Quantitative P-value` = ifelse(!is.na(p_os_line),
                                   ifelse(p_os_line < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_line, 3))),
                                   "N/A"),
    `Quantitative AIC` = ifelse(!is.na(aic_os_quant_line), round(aic_os_quant_line, 1), NA),
    `Quantitative BIC` = ifelse(!is.na(bic_os_quant_line), round(bic_os_quant_line, 1), NA),
    `Qualitative HR (95% CI)` = ifelse(!is.na(hr_os_binary_line),
                                       paste0(round(hr_os_binary_line, 2), " (", round(hr_os_binary_line_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_binary_line_upper, 2), ")"),
                                       "N/A"),
    `Qualitative P-value` = ifelse(!is.na(p_os_binary_line),
                                   ifelse(p_os_binary_line < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_binary_line, 3))),
                                   "N/A"),
    `Qualitative AIC` = ifelse(!is.na(aic_os_binary_line), round(aic_os_binary_line, 1), NA),
    `Qualitative BIC` = ifelse(!is.na(bic_os_binary_line), round(bic_os_binary_line, 1), NA)
  )
  
  # 3. Multivariate models (if available)
  if (!is.null(cox_os_binary_multiv) && !is.null(cox_os_binary_multiv_summary)) {
    ctdna_idx_os_binary_multiv <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_os_binary_multiv_summary$coefficients), "ctdna_binary_factor"))
    if (length(ctdna_idx_os_binary_multiv) > 0) {
      hr_os_binary_multiv <- cox_os_binary_multiv_summary$conf.int[ctdna_idx_os_binary_multiv[1], "exp(coef)"]
      hr_os_binary_multiv_lower <- cox_os_binary_multiv_summary$conf.int[ctdna_idx_os_binary_multiv[1], "lower .95"]
      hr_os_binary_multiv_upper <- cox_os_binary_multiv_summary$conf.int[ctdna_idx_os_binary_multiv[1], "upper .95"]
      p_os_binary_multiv <- cox_os_binary_multiv_summary$coefficients[ctdna_idx_os_binary_multiv[1], "Pr(>|z|)"]
    } else {
      hr_os_binary_multiv <- NA
      hr_os_binary_multiv_lower <- NA
      hr_os_binary_multiv_upper <- NA
      p_os_binary_multiv <- NA
    }
    aic_os_binary_multiv <- AIC(cox_os_binary_multiv)
    bic_os_binary_multiv <- BIC(cox_os_binary_multiv)
  } else {
    hr_os_binary_multiv <- NA
    hr_os_binary_multiv_lower <- NA
    hr_os_binary_multiv_upper <- NA
    p_os_binary_multiv <- NA
    aic_os_binary_multiv <- NA
    bic_os_binary_multiv <- NA
  }
  
  if (!is.null(cox_os_adj) && exists("cox_os_adj_summary") && !is.null(cox_os_adj_summary)) {
    hr_os_adj <- cox_os_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_os_adj_lower <- cox_os_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_os_adj_upper <- cox_os_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_os_adj <- cox_os_adj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    aic_os_quant_multiv <- AIC(cox_os_adj)
    bic_os_quant_multiv <- BIC(cox_os_adj)
    
    adj_text_os_comparison <- "line of therapy"
    if (exists("has_therapy_class_os") && has_therapy_class_os) {
      adj_text_os_comparison <- paste0(adj_text_os_comparison, ", therapy class")
    } else if (has_therapy_class_os_binary) {
      adj_text_os_comparison <- paste0(adj_text_os_comparison, ", therapy class")
    }
    adj_text_os_comparison <- paste0(adj_text_os_comparison, ", KPS, and visceral metastases")
    
    os_comparison_results_list[[length(os_comparison_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
      `Model Type` = paste0("Adjusted for ", adj_text_os_comparison),
      `Quantitative HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_os_adj, 2), " (", round(hr_os_adj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_adj_upper, 2), ")"),
      `Quantitative P-value` = ifelse(p_os_adj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_adj, 3))),
      `Quantitative AIC` = round(aic_os_quant_multiv, 1),
      `Quantitative BIC` = round(bic_os_quant_multiv, 1),
      `Qualitative HR (95% CI)` = ifelse(!is.na(hr_os_binary_multiv),
                                         paste0(round(hr_os_binary_multiv, 2), " (", round(hr_os_binary_multiv_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_os_binary_multiv_upper, 2), ")"),
                                         "N/A"),
      `Qualitative P-value` = ifelse(!is.na(p_os_binary_multiv),
                                     ifelse(p_os_binary_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_os_binary_multiv, 3))),
                                     "N/A"),
      `Qualitative AIC` = ifelse(!is.na(aic_os_binary_multiv), round(aic_os_binary_multiv, 1), NA),
      `Qualitative BIC` = ifelse(!is.na(bic_os_binary_multiv), round(bic_os_binary_multiv, 1), NA)
    )
  }
  
  # Combine comparison results
  os_comparison_table <- bind_rows(os_comparison_results_list)
  
  # Add differences and better model indicators
  os_comparison_table <- os_comparison_table %>%
    mutate(
      `AIC Difference (Quant - Qual)` = ifelse(!is.na(`Quantitative AIC`) & !is.na(`Qualitative AIC`),
                                               round(`Quantitative AIC` - `Qualitative AIC`, 1),
                                               NA),
      `BIC Difference (Quant - Qual)` = ifelse(!is.na(`Quantitative BIC`) & !is.na(`Qualitative BIC`),
                                               round(`Quantitative BIC` - `Qualitative BIC`, 1),
                                               NA),
      `Better Model (AIC)` = case_when(
        !is.na(`AIC Difference (Quant - Qual)`) & `AIC Difference (Quant - Qual)` < -2 ~ "Quantitative",
        !is.na(`AIC Difference (Quant - Qual)`) & `AIC Difference (Quant - Qual)` > 2 ~ "Qualitative",
        !is.na(`AIC Difference (Quant - Qual)`) ~ "Similar",
        TRUE ~ "N/A"
      ),
      `Better Model (BIC)` = case_when(
        !is.na(`BIC Difference (Quant - Qual)`) & `BIC Difference (Quant - Qual)` < -2 ~ "Quantitative",
        !is.na(`BIC Difference (Quant - Qual)`) & `BIC Difference (Quant - Qual)` > 2 ~ "Qualitative",
        !is.na(`BIC Difference (Quant - Qual)`) ~ "Similar",
        TRUE ~ "N/A"
      ),
      `P-value (Quantitative Better)` = NA_character_  # Will be filled in after direct test
    )
  
  # ====================================================================================
  # Formal Statistical Tests: Comparing Quantitative vs Qualitative Models for OS
  # ====================================================================================
  # Perform likelihood ratio tests to formally compare model performance
  # ====================================================================================
  os_direct_comparison_results <- list()
  
  # Test 1: Unadjusted models
  if (!is.null(cox_os_binary_unadj) && !is.null(cox_os_unadj)) {
    # Model with both binary and continuous
    cox_os_both_unadj <- tryCatch({
      coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ ctdna_binary_factor + log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1), 
            data = outcomes_os_binary)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_os_both_unadj)) {
      lrt_os_unadj <- tryCatch({
        anova(cox_os_binary_unadj, cox_os_both_unadj, test = "LRT")
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(lrt_os_unadj) && nrow(lrt_os_unadj) >= 2) {
        p_lrt_os_unadj <- lrt_os_unadj$`Pr(>|Chi|)`[2]
        os_direct_comparison_results[[length(os_direct_comparison_results) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Model Type` = "Unadjusted",
          `P-value` = ifelse(p_lrt_os_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_lrt_os_unadj, 3)))
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Test 2: Adjusted for line of therapy
  if (!is.null(cox_os_binary_line) && !is.null(cox_os_line)) {
    cox_os_both_line <- tryCatch({
      coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ ctdna_binary_factor + log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1) + therapy_line_factor, 
            data = outcomes_os_binary)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_os_both_line)) {
      lrt_os_line <- tryCatch({
        anova(cox_os_binary_line, cox_os_both_line, test = "LRT")
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(lrt_os_line) && nrow(lrt_os_line) >= 2) {
        p_lrt_os_line <- lrt_os_line$`Pr(>|Chi|)`[2]
        os_direct_comparison_results[[length(os_direct_comparison_results) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Model Type` = "Adjusted for line of therapy",
          `P-value` = ifelse(p_lrt_os_line < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_lrt_os_line, 3)))
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Test 3: Multivariate models
  if (!is.null(cox_os_binary_multiv) && !is.null(cox_os_adj)) {
    # Build formula for model with both binary and continuous
    formula_parts_os_both <- c("ctdna_binary_factor", "log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1)", "therapy_line_factor")
    
    if (has_therapy_class_os_binary) {
      formula_parts_os_both <- c(formula_parts_os_both, "therapy_class_factor_filtered")
    }
    
    formula_parts_os_both <- c(formula_parts_os_both, "kps_factor", "visceral_mets_factor")
    formula_str_os_both <- paste("Surv(os_time, os_event) ~", paste(formula_parts_os_both, collapse = " + "))
    
    cox_os_both_multiv <- tryCatch({
      coxph(as.formula(formula_str_os_both), data = outcomes_os_binary_multiv)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_os_both_multiv)) {
      lrt_os_multiv <- tryCatch({
        anova(cox_os_binary_multiv, cox_os_both_multiv, test = "LRT")
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(lrt_os_multiv) && nrow(lrt_os_multiv) >= 2) {
        p_lrt_os_multiv <- lrt_os_multiv$`Pr(>|Chi|)`[2]
        adj_text_lrt_os <- "line of therapy"
        if (has_therapy_class_os_binary) {
          adj_text_lrt_os <- paste0(adj_text_lrt_os, ", therapy class")
        }
        adj_text_lrt_os <- paste0(adj_text_lrt_os, ", KPS, and visceral metastases")
        
        os_direct_comparison_results[[length(os_direct_comparison_results) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Model Type` = paste0("Adjusted for ", adj_text_lrt_os),
          `P-value` = ifelse(p_lrt_os_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_lrt_os_multiv, 3)))
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Combine direct comparison results
  if (length(os_direct_comparison_results) > 0) {
    os_direct_comparison_table <- bind_rows(os_direct_comparison_results)
    
    # Add p-values to comparison table
    for (i in 1:nrow(os_comparison_table)) {
      model_type <- os_comparison_table$`Model Type`[i]
      matching_row <- os_direct_comparison_table %>%
        filter(`Model Type` == model_type)
      
      if (nrow(matching_row) > 0) {
        os_comparison_table$`P-value (Quantitative Better)`[i] <- matching_row$`P-value`[1]
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Store distribution info for display
  os_ctdna_distribution <- ctdna_distribution_os
} else {
  os_comparison_table <- tibble()
  os_direct_comparison_table <- tibble()
  os_ctdna_distribution <- NULL
}
```

```{r os_quantitative_vs_qualitative_summary, results='asis'}
  }

  cat("**Conclusion:**\n")
  if (nrow(os_comparison_table) > 0) {
    final_aic_diff_os <- os_comparison_table$`AIC Difference (Quant - Qual)`[nrow(os_comparison_table)]
    final_quant_pval_os <- os_comparison_table$`Quantitative P-value`[nrow(os_comparison_table)]

      } else if (!is.na(final_quant_pval_os) && final_quant_pval_os == "<0.001") {

      }
      cat("\n")
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("Quantitative vs qualitative comparison for OS not available.\n")
}
```

## Sensitivity Analysis: Overall Survival by Histology

This sensitivity analysis examines whether the association between baseline ctDNA and overall survival differs between patients with pure urothelial carcinoma (UC) versus those with variant or unknown histology.

```{r os_histology_sensitivity_analysis, include=FALSE}
# ====================================================================================
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS: OS by Histology (UC vs Variant/Unknown)
# ====================================================================================

if (exists("outcomes_os_for_model") && nrow(outcomes_os_for_model) > 0) {
  # Get histology data
  histology_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^histology$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  
  if (length(histology_cols) > 0) {
    # Check for notes column to use when histology is "Other"
    notes_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^notes$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
    
    # Build select statement for histology join
    select_cols_hist <- c("patient_id", histology_cols[1])
    if (length(notes_cols) > 0) {
      select_cols_hist <- c(select_cols_hist, notes_cols[1])
    }
    
    # Add histology to outcomes_os_for_model
    outcomes_os_with_histology <- outcomes_os_for_model %>%
      left_join(
        dat_combined %>%
          select(all_of(select_cols_hist)) %>%
          rename(histology = all_of(histology_cols[1])) %>%
          mutate(
            notes = if(length(notes_cols) > 0) .data[[notes_cols[1]]] else NA_character_,
            histology_clean = str_trim(as.character(histology)),
            # If histology is "Other", use notes to determine actual histology
            histology_from_notes = if(length(notes_cols) > 0) {
              ifelse(
                !is.na(notes) & str_detect(tolower(histology_clean), "^other$"),
                str_trim(as.character(notes)),
                histology_clean
              )
            } else {
              histology_clean
            },
            histology_clean = ifelse(is.na(histology_from_notes) | histology_from_notes == "" | histology_from_notes == "NA", 
                                     ifelse(is.na(histology_clean) | histology_clean == "" | histology_clean == "NA", "Missing/Unknown", histology_clean),
                                     histology_from_notes),
            histology_clean = ifelse(is.na(histology_clean) | histology_clean == "" | histology_clean == "NA", "Missing/Unknown", histology_clean),
            # Categorize as UC vs Variant/Unknown
            # All histologies should be classified - if not UC, then Variant
            histology_group = case_when(
              # UC: urothelial/transitional, but exclude if it has variant features
              str_detect(tolower(histology_clean), regex("urothelial|pure|conventional|uc$|transitional", ignore_case = TRUE)) &
                !str_detect(tolower(histology_clean), regex("variant|mixed|squamous|adeno|sarcomatoid|micropapillary|plasmacytoid|nested|small.*cell|neuroendocrine|signet|ring.*cell|with.*differentiation|with.*features", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "UC",
              # Variant: any variant histology, mixed, squamous, adeno, sarcomatoid, micropapillary, neuroendocrine, signet ring, or TCC with features/differentiation
              str_detect(tolower(histology_clean), regex("variant|mixed|squamous|adeno|sarcomatoid|micropapillary|plasmacytoid|nested|small.*cell|neuroendocrine|signet|ring.*cell|with.*differentiation|with.*features", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "Variant",
              TRUE ~ "Variant"  # Default to Variant if not clearly UC (all histologies should be classified)
            ),
            histology_category = ifelse(histology_group == "UC", "UC", "Variant/Unknown")
          ) %>%
          select(patient_id, histology_category),
        by = "patient_id"
      ) %>%
      # Remove observations with missing histology category (if needed)
      filter(!is.na(histology_category))
    
    # Split into UC and Variant/Unknown groups
    outcomes_os_uc <- outcomes_os_with_histology %>%
      filter(histology_category == "UC")
    
    outcomes_os_variant <- outcomes_os_with_histology %>%
      filter(histology_category == "Variant/Unknown")
    
    # Counts
    n_os_uc <- nrow(outcomes_os_uc)
    n_os_variant <- nrow(outcomes_os_variant)
    
    # Function to fit OS models and extract results
    fit_os_models <- function(data, group_name) {
      results_list <- list()
      
      if (nrow(data) >= 3) {
        # Model 1: Unadjusted
        cox_unadj <- tryCatch({
          coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1), data = data)
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if (!is.null(cox_unadj)) {
          cox_unadj_summary <- summary(cox_unadj)
          hr_coef <- cox_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "coef"]
          hr_se <- cox_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "se(coef)"]
          hr <- exp(hr_coef)
          hr_ci_lower <- exp(hr_coef - 1.96 * hr_se)
          hr_ci_upper <- exp(hr_coef + 1.96 * hr_se)
          p_value <- cox_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
          
          results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
            `Histology Group` = group_name,
            Model = "Unadjusted",
            N = cox_unadj$n,
            HR = round(hr, 2),
            `95% CI Lower` = round(hr_ci_lower, 2),
            `95% CI Upper` = round(hr_ci_upper, 2),
            `P-value` = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_value, 3))),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
          )
        }
        
        # Model 2: Adjusted for line of therapy
        if (sum(!is.na(data$therapy_line_factor)) > 0) {
          cox_line <- tryCatch({
            coxph(Surv(os_time, os_event) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1) + therapy_line_factor, data = data)
          }, error = function(e) NULL)
          
          if (!is.null(cox_line)) {
            cox_line_summary <- summary(cox_line)
            hr_coef <- cox_line_summary$coefficients[1, "coef"]
            hr_se <- cox_line_summary$coefficients[1, "se(coef)"]
            hr <- exp(hr_coef)
            hr_ci_lower <- exp(hr_coef - 1.96 * hr_se)
            hr_ci_upper <- exp(hr_coef + 1.96 * hr_se)
            p_value <- cox_line_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
            
            results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
              Histology.Group = group_name,
              Model = "Adjusted for line of therapy",
              N = cox_line$n,
              HR = round(hr, 2),
              CI.Lower = round(hr_ci_lower, 2),
              CI.Upper = round(hr_ci_upper, 2),
              P.value = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_value, 3))),
              stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            )
          }
        }
        
        # Model 3: Multivariate (line + KPS + visceral mets)
        if (sum(!is.na(data$kps_binary)) > 0 && sum(!is.na(data$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0) {
          data_multiv <- data %>%
            filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
          
          if (nrow(data_multiv) >= 3) {
            # Build formula
            formula_parts <- c("log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1)", "therapy_line_factor")
            
            # Add therapy class if available
            if (exists("therapy_class_counts_os") && length(therapy_class_counts_os) > 0) {
              data_multiv <- data_multiv %>%
                mutate(
                  therapy_class_filtered = ifelse(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_os, therapy_class, "unspecified"),
                  therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
                )
              formula_parts <- c(formula_parts, "therapy_class_factor_filtered")
            }
            
            formula_parts <- c(formula_parts, "kps_factor", "visceral_mets_factor")
            formula_str <- paste("Surv(os_time, os_event) ~", paste(formula_parts, collapse = " + "))
            
            cox_multiv <- tryCatch({
              coxph(as.formula(formula_str), data = data_multiv)
            }, error = function(e) NULL)
            
            if (!is.null(cox_multiv)) {
              cox_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_multiv)
              hr_coef <- cox_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "coef"]
              hr_se <- cox_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "se(coef)"]
              hr <- exp(hr_coef)
              hr_ci_lower <- exp(hr_coef - 1.96 * hr_se)
              hr_ci_upper <- exp(hr_coef + 1.96 * hr_se)
              p_value <- cox_multiv_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
              
              results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
                Histology.Group = group_name,
                Model = "Adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases",
                N = cox_multiv$n,
                HR = round(hr, 2),
                CI.Lower = round(hr_ci_lower, 2),
                CI.Upper = round(hr_ci_upper, 2),
                P.value = ifelse(p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_value, 3))),
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE
              )
            }
          }
        }
      }
      
      return(results_list)
    }
    
    # Fit models for UC group
    os_results_uc <- fit_os_models(outcomes_os_uc, "UC")
    
    # Fit models for Variant/Unknown group
    os_results_variant <- fit_os_models(outcomes_os_variant, "Variant/Unknown")
    
    # Combine results
    os_histology_results_list <- c(os_results_uc, os_results_variant)
    
    # Test for interaction: Does the association between ctDNA and OS differ by histology group?
    # Fit models with and without interaction term
    if (nrow(outcomes_os_with_histology) >= 6) {  # Need sufficient data for both groups
      # Prepare data for interaction test (use same adjustments as main model)
      outcomes_os_interaction <- outcomes_os_with_histology %>%
        filter(!is.na(os_time), !is.na(os_event), !is.na(ctdna_before_line_value))
      
      # Check if we have both groups
      if (sum(outcomes_os_interaction$histology_category == "UC") > 0 && 
          sum(outcomes_os_interaction$histology_category == "Variant/Unknown") > 0) {
        
        # Create histology factor
        outcomes_os_interaction <- outcomes_os_interaction %>%
          mutate(
            histology_factor = factor(histology_category, levels = c("UC", "Variant/Unknown"))
          )
        
        # Model without interaction (main effects only)
        # Use the same adjustments as the main multivariate model
        has_kps_interaction <- sum(!is.na(outcomes_os_interaction$kps_binary)) > 0
        has_visceral_interaction <- sum(!is.na(outcomes_os_interaction$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0
        
        if (has_kps_interaction && has_visceral_interaction) {
          # Filter to complete cases for multivariate model
          outcomes_os_interaction_complete <- outcomes_os_interaction %>%
            filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary), !is.na(therapy_line_factor))
          
          if (nrow(outcomes_os_interaction_complete) >= 6) {
            # Build formula for model without interaction
            formula_parts_no_int <- c("log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1)", "histology_factor", "therapy_line_factor")
            
            # Add therapy class if available
            if (exists("therapy_class_counts_os") && length(therapy_class_counts_os) > 0) {
              outcomes_os_interaction_complete <- outcomes_os_interaction_complete %>%
                mutate(
                  therapy_class_filtered = ifelse(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_os, therapy_class, "unspecified"),
                  therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
                )
              formula_parts_no_int <- c(formula_parts_no_int, "therapy_class_factor_filtered")
            }
            
            formula_parts_no_int <- c(formula_parts_no_int, "kps_factor", "visceral_mets_factor")
            formula_str_no_int <- paste("Surv(os_time, os_event) ~", paste(formula_parts_no_int, collapse = " + "))
            
            # Model with interaction
            formula_parts_int <- c("log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1)", "histology_factor", 
                                   "log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1):histology_factor", "therapy_line_factor")
            
            if (exists("therapy_class_counts_os") && length(therapy_class_counts_os) > 0) {
              formula_parts_int <- c(formula_parts_int, "therapy_class_factor_filtered")
            }
            
            formula_parts_int <- c(formula_parts_int, "kps_factor", "visceral_mets_factor")
            formula_str_int <- paste("Surv(os_time, os_event) ~", paste(formula_parts_int, collapse = " + "))
            
            # Fit models
            cox_no_interaction <- tryCatch({
              coxph(as.formula(formula_str_no_int), data = outcomes_os_interaction_complete)
            }, error = function(e) NULL)
            
            cox_with_interaction <- tryCatch({
              coxph(as.formula(formula_str_int), data = outcomes_os_interaction_complete)
            }, error = function(e) NULL)
            
            # Perform likelihood ratio test
            if (!is.null(cox_no_interaction) && !is.null(cox_with_interaction)) {
              lrt_interaction <- tryCatch({
                anova(cox_no_interaction, cox_with_interaction, test = "LRT")
              }, error = function(e) NULL)
              
              if (!is.null(lrt_interaction) && nrow(lrt_interaction) >= 2) {
                # Extract p-value for interaction
                interaction_p_value <- lrt_interaction$`Pr(>|Chi|)`[2]
                interaction_p_value_formatted <- ifelse(interaction_p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                                                        as.character(round(interaction_p_value, 3)))
                
                # Store interaction test result
                os_histology_interaction_p <- interaction_p_value
                os_histology_interaction_p_formatted <- interaction_p_value_formatted
              } else {
                os_histology_interaction_p <- NA
                os_histology_interaction_p_formatted <- "Not available"
              }
            } else {
              os_histology_interaction_p <- NA
              os_histology_interaction_p_formatted <- "Not available"
            }
          } else {
            os_histology_interaction_p <- NA
            os_histology_interaction_p_formatted <- "Not available"
          }
        } else {
          os_histology_interaction_p <- NA
          os_histology_interaction_p_formatted <- "Not available"
        }
      } else {
        os_histology_interaction_p <- NA
        os_histology_interaction_p_formatted <- "Not available"
      }
    } else {
      os_histology_interaction_p <- NA
      os_histology_interaction_p_formatted <- "Not available"
    }
    
  } else {
    # Histology data not available
    os_histology_results_list <- list()
    n_os_uc <- 0
    n_os_variant <- 0
    os_histology_interaction_p <- NA
    os_histology_interaction_p_formatted <- "Not available"
  }
} else {
  os_histology_results_list <- list()
  n_os_uc <- 0
  n_os_variant <- 0
  os_histology_interaction_p <- NA
  os_histology_interaction_p_formatted <- "Not available"
}
```

```{r os_survival_curves_q1}
# Kaplan-Meier curves for OS by ctDNA tertiles
if (exists("outcomes_os_q1") && nrow(outcomes_os_q1) >= 3) {
  outcomes_os_tertiles <- outcomes_os_q1 %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_before_line_value)) %>%
    mutate(
      os_time_months = os_time / 30.44,
      ctdna_tertile = ntile(ctdna_before_line_value, 3),
      ctdna_tertile_label = case_when(
        ctdna_tertile == 1 ~ "T1 (Lowest)",
        ctdna_tertile == 2 ~ "T2",
        ctdna_tertile == 3 ~ "T3 (Highest)"
      )
    )
  
  # Check if we have enough events per tertile
  events_per_tertile_os <- outcomes_os_tertiles %>%
    group_by(ctdna_tertile_label) %>%
    summarise(n_events = sum(os_event, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  if (all(events_per_tertile_os$n_events > 0) && nrow(events_per_tertile_os) > 1) {
    # Fit survival curves (months)
    surv_fit_os <- survfit(Surv(os_time_months, os_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_label, 
                            data = outcomes_os_tertiles)
    
    # Calculate p-value
    logrank_test_os <- survdiff(Surv(os_time_months, os_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_label, 
                                 data = outcomes_os_tertiles)
    logrank_pvalue_os <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test_os$chisq, length(logrank_test_os$n) - 1)
    pval_text_os <- ifelse(logrank_pvalue_os < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                            as.character(round(logrank_pvalue_os, 3)))
    
    # Plot with 95% confidence intervals and risk table
    p_os <- ggsurvplot(
      surv_fit_os,
      data = outcomes_os_tertiles,
      pval = paste0("p = ", pval_text_os),
      conf.int = TRUE,
      conf.int.style = "ribbon",
      risk.table = TRUE,
      risk.table.position = "bottom",
      risk.table.height = 0.25,
      risk.table.y.text.col = TRUE,
      xlab = "Time (months)",
      ylab = "Overall Survival Probability",
      title = "Overall Survival by Baseline ctDNA Tertile",
      legend.title = "ctDNA Tertile",
      legend.labs = c("T1 (Lowest)", "T2", "T3 (Highest)"),
      xlim = c(0, 36)
    )
    
    # Print both plot and risk table
    print(p_os)
  } else {
    cat("Insufficient events for tertile analysis. Showing overall OS curve instead.\n")
    surv_fit_overall_os <- survfit(Surv(os_time / 30.44, os_event) ~ 1, 
                                    data = outcomes_os_q1)
    p_overall_os <- ggsurvplot(
      surv_fit_overall_os,
      data = outcomes_os_q1,
      conf.int = TRUE,
      xlab = "Time (months)",
      ylab = "Overall Survival Probability",
      title = "Overall Survival",
      xlim = c(0, 36)
    )
    p_overall_os$plot
  }
} else {
  cat("Insufficient sample size (n < 3) for OS tertile analysis.\n")
}
```

```{r continuous_association_plot_os}
# Scatter plot: ctDNA vs OS time (with events colored)

# Calculate median for reference line
if (exists("outcomes_os_q1") && nrow(outcomes_os_q1) > 0) {
  median_log10_ctdna_os <- log10(median(outcomes_os_q1$ctdna_before_line_value, na.rm = TRUE) + 1)
  
  # Get range of log10(ctDNA+1) values for better axis breaks
  log10_ctdna_range_os <- range(log10(outcomes_os_q1$ctdna_before_line_value + 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  log10_ctdna_min_os <- floor(log10_ctdna_range_os[1])
  log10_ctdna_max_os <- ceiling(log10_ctdna_range_os[2])
  
  # Create custom breaks for Y axis (log10 scale)
  y_breaks_os <- seq(log10_ctdna_min_os, log10_ctdna_max_os, by = 0.5)
  # Ensure median is included if not already in breaks
  if (!any(abs(y_breaks_os - median_log10_ctdna_os) < 0.1)) {
    y_breaks_os <- sort(c(y_breaks_os, median_log10_ctdna_os))
  }
  
  # Also create back-transformed labels showing actual ctDNA values for reference
  y_labels_os <- round(10^y_breaks_os, 1)
  
  p_scatter_os <- outcomes_os_q1 %>%
    mutate(
      os_time_months = os_time / 30.44,
      log10_ctdna = log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1)

    ggplot(aes(x = os_time_months, y = log10_ctdna, color = factor(os_event))) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +

    geom_hline(yintercept = median_log10_ctdna_os, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", size = 0.8) +
    annotate("text", x = max(outcomes_os_q1$os_time / 30.44, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.95, y = median_log10_ctdna_os,
             label = paste0("Median\n", round(median_log10_ctdna_os, 2)),
             hjust = 1, vjust = -0.1, size = 3, color = "gray30") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.03)),
      limits = c(-1, NA)  # Start slightly before 0 to see dots better
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(-0.2, NA),  # Start slightly before 0 to see dots better
      breaks = y_breaks_os,
      labels = round(y_breaks_os, 2),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.03)),
      sec.axis = sec_axis(
        trans = ~.,
        breaks = y_breaks_os,
        labels = y_labels_os,
        name = "ctDNA Value (back-transformed)"
      )

    scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "blue", "1" = "red"), 
                       labels = c("0" = "Censored", "1" = "Event"),
                       name = "Status") +
    labs(

      title = "Association between ctDNA Level Before Therapy and Overall Survival"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1))

} else {
```

```{r os_interpretation_q1}
    hr_os_upper_to_use <- cox_os_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_os_to_use <- cox_os_adj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    adj_text_os <- "line of therapy"
    if (has_therapy_class_os) adj_text_os <- paste0(adj_text_os, ", therapy class")
    adjustment_text_os <- paste0("adjusted for ", adj_text_os, ", KPS, and visceral metastases")
  } else if (!is.null(cox_os_line_class) && !is.null(cox_os_line_class_summary)) {

  } else if (!is.null(cox_os_line) && !is.null(cox_os_line_summary)) {
    hr_os_to_use <- cox_os_line_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_os_lower_to_use <- cox_os_line_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_os_upper_to_use <- cox_os_line_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_os_to_use <- cox_os_line_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    adjustment_text_os <- "adjusted for line of therapy"
  }
  
  if (hr_os_to_use > 1 && hr_os_lower_to_use > 1) {
    cat("Higher baseline ctDNA levels before starting a new line of therapy are significantly associated with shorter overall survival (HR = ", 
        round(hr_os_to_use, 2), ", 95% CI: ", round(hr_os_lower_to_use, 2), "-", 
        round(hr_os_upper_to_use, 2), "), ", adjustment_text_os, ". ", sep="")
    cat("This finding suggests that baseline ctDNA level may serve as a prognostic biomarker for overall survival outcomes.\n")
  } else if (hr_os_to_use > 1) {
    cat("Higher baseline ctDNA levels show a trend toward shorter overall survival (HR = ", 
        round(hr_os_to_use, 2), ", 95% CI: ", round(hr_os_lower_to_use, 2), "-", 
        round(hr_os_upper_to_use, 2), "), though the confidence interval includes 1.0.\n", sep="")
  } else if (hr_os_to_use < 1 && hr_os_upper_to_use < 1) {
    cat("Higher baseline ctDNA levels are significantly associated with longer overall survival (HR = ", 
        round(hr_os_to_use, 2), ", 95% CI: ", round(hr_os_lower_to_use, 2), "-", 
        round(hr_os_upper_to_use, 2), "), which is counterintuitive and warrants further investigation.\n", sep="")
  } else {
    cat("There is no significant association between baseline ctDNA level and overall survival (HR = ", 
        round(hr_os_to_use, 2), ", 95% CI: ", round(hr_os_lower_to_use, 2), "-", 
        round(hr_os_upper_to_use, 2), "), ", adjustment_text_os, ".\n", sep="")
  }
} else {
  cat("Overall Survival analysis could not be completed because the Cox models did not converge or produced extreme HR values.\n")
}
```
