```{r ctDNA_prognosis_analysis}
# Quantitative association between ctDNA level and prognosis
# Cox proportional hazards model
# Cox model with ctDNA and line of therapy as covariates
# Combine lines 4+ into one category
outcomes_for_model <- outcomes %>%
  left_join(
    palliative_regimen_table %>%
      mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(is.na(therapy_line_match), NA_integer_, therapy_line_match)) %>%
      select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, therapy_class) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line" = "therapy_line_match")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    therapy_line_grouped = case_when(
      therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
      therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
      therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
      therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
      TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
    ),
    therapy_line_factor = factor(therapy_line_grouped, levels = c("1L", "2L", "3L", "4L+")),
    therapy_class = replace_na(therapy_class, "unspecified"),
    therapy_class_factor = factor(therapy_class)
  )

# Join Bajorin risk factors if available
# IMPORTANT: Normalize therapy lines >= 4 to 4 for matching, since Bajorin data uses "4L+" -> 4
if (exists("bajorin_data") && nrow(bajorin_data) > 0) {
  # Normalize therapy lines in both datasets: >= 4 becomes 4 for matching
  # Ensure no duplicates in Bajorin data before joining
  bajorin_data_normalized <- bajorin_data %>%
    mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(therapy_line >= 4, 4, therapy_line)) %>%
    # Remove any duplicates - keep first occurrence
    distinct(patient_id, therapy_line_match, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  outcomes_for_model <- outcomes_for_model %>%
    mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(therapy_line >= 4, 4, therapy_line)) %>%
    left_join(
      bajorin_data_normalized %>% select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, kps_binary, visceral_mets_binary),
      by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line_match")
    ) %>%
    select(-therapy_line_match) %>%
    mutate(
      # Create factor variables for Bajorin risk factors
      kps_factor = factor(kps_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("KPS <80%", "KPS ≥80%")),
      visceral_mets_factor = factor(visceral_mets_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Visceral Mets", "Visceral Mets"))
    ) %>%
    # Ensure no duplicates after join - should have same number of rows as outcomes
    distinct(patient_id, therapy_line, .keep_all = TRUE)
} else {
  outcomes_for_model <- outcomes_for_model %>%
    mutate(
      kps_binary = NA_real_,
      visceral_mets_binary = NA_real_,
      kps_factor = factor(NA, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("KPS <80%", "KPS ≥80%")),
      visceral_mets_factor = factor(NA, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Visceral Mets", "Visceral Mets"))
    )
}

# Diagnostic: Check for duplicate rows after joins
cat("Diagnostic: Dataset sizes\n")
cat("  outcomes (before joins):", nrow(outcomes), "rows\n")
cat("  outcomes_for_model (after joins):", nrow(outcomes_for_model), "rows\n")
if (nrow(outcomes_for_model) != nrow(outcomes)) {
  cat("  WARNING: Join created", nrow(outcomes_for_model) - nrow(outcomes), "additional rows!\n")
  # Check for duplicates
  duplicates <- outcomes_for_model %>%
    count(patient_id, therapy_line) %>%
    filter(n > 1)
  if (nrow(duplicates) > 0) {
    cat("  Found", nrow(duplicates), "patient-line combinations with duplicates\n")
  }
}

# Model 1: Unadjusted (ctDNA only)
cox_model_unadj <- coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1), data = outcomes_for_model)
cox_summary_unadj <- summary(cox_model_unadj)
# Use actual N from model (this is the most accurate)
n_unadj <- cox_model_unadj$n

# Model 2: Adjusted for line of therapy
cox_model_line <- coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1) + therapy_line_factor, data = outcomes_for_model)
cox_summary_line <- summary(cox_model_line)
# Use actual N from model (this is the most accurate)
n_line <- cox_model_line$n

# Model 3: Adjusted for KPS only (if available)
cox_model_kps <- NULL
cox_summary_kps <- NULL
n_kps <- 0
if (sum(!is.na(outcomes_for_model$kps_binary)) > 0) {
  outcomes_kps <- outcomes_for_model %>%
    filter(!is.na(kps_binary))
  
  if (nrow(outcomes_kps) > 0) {
    cox_model_kps <- tryCatch({
      coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1) + kps_factor, 
            data = outcomes_kps)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_model_kps)) {
      cox_summary_kps <- summary(cox_model_kps)
      n_kps <- cox_model_kps$n  # Use actual N from model
    }
  }
}

# Model 4: Adjusted for visceral metastases only (if available)
cox_model_visceral <- NULL
cox_summary_visceral <- NULL
n_visceral <- 0
if (sum(!is.na(outcomes_for_model$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0) {
  outcomes_visceral <- outcomes_for_model %>%
    filter(!is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
  
  if (nrow(outcomes_visceral) > 0) {
    cox_model_visceral <- tryCatch({
      coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1) + visceral_mets_factor, 
            data = outcomes_visceral)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_model_visceral)) {
      cox_summary_visceral <- summary(cox_model_visceral)
      n_visceral <- cox_model_visceral$n  # Use actual N from model
    }
  }
}

# Model 5a: Adjusted for line of therapy + therapy class
cox_model_line_class <- tryCatch({
  # Filter out therapy classes with insufficient sample size
  therapy_class_counts <- outcomes_for_model %>%
    filter(!is.na(therapy_class)) %>%
    count(therapy_class) %>%
    filter(n >= 5) %>%
    pull(therapy_class)
  
  outcomes_line_class <- outcomes_for_model %>%
    filter(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts | is.na(therapy_class))
  
  if (nrow(outcomes_line_class) > 0 && length(therapy_class_counts) > 0) {
    # Create factor with valid classes only
    outcomes_line_class <- outcomes_line_class %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_class_filtered = ifelse(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts, therapy_class, "unspecified"),
        therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
      )
    
    coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1) + 
          therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor_filtered, 
          data = outcomes_line_class)
  } else {
    NULL
  }
}, error = function(e) NULL)

cox_summary_line_class <- NULL
if (!is.null(cox_model_line_class)) {
  cox_summary_line_class <- summary(cox_model_line_class)
}

# Model 5: Multivariate with all covariates (if available)
# Use flexible model building: include only covariates with sufficient sample size
cox_model_multiv <- NULL
cox_summary_multiv <- NULL
outcomes_multiv <- outcomes_for_model %>% filter(FALSE)  # Initialize as empty

# Check which covariates are available and have sufficient sample size
has_kps <- sum(!is.na(outcomes_for_model$kps_binary)) > 0
has_visceral <- sum(!is.na(outcomes_for_model$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0

# Check therapy class sample sizes
therapy_class_counts <- outcomes_for_model %>%
  filter(!is.na(therapy_class)) %>%
  count(therapy_class) %>%
  filter(n >= 5) %>%
  pull(therapy_class)
has_therapy_class <- length(therapy_class_counts) > 0

if (has_kps && has_visceral) {
  # Filter to observations with complete Bajorin data
  outcomes_multiv <- outcomes_for_model %>%
    filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
  
  if (nrow(outcomes_multiv) > 0) {
    # Build model formula dynamically based on available covariates
    formula_parts <- c("log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1)", "therapy_line_factor")
    
    # Add therapy class if available
    if (has_therapy_class) {
      outcomes_multiv <- outcomes_multiv %>%
        mutate(
          therapy_class_filtered = ifelse(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts, therapy_class, "unspecified"),
          therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
        )
      formula_parts <- c(formula_parts, "therapy_class_factor_filtered")
    }
    
    # Add Bajorin factors
    formula_parts <- c(formula_parts, "kps_factor", "visceral_mets_factor")
    
    formula_str <- paste("Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~", paste(formula_parts, collapse = " + "))
    
    cox_model_multiv <- tryCatch({
      coxph(as.formula(formula_str), data = outcomes_multiv)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_model_multiv)) {
      cox_summary_multiv <- summary(cox_model_multiv)
    }
  }
}

# Create results table showing ctDNA HR progression across models
results_table_list <- list()

# 1. Unadjusted model
hr_unadj <- cox_summary_unadj$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
hr_unadj_lower <- cox_summary_unadj$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
hr_unadj_upper <- cox_summary_unadj$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
p_unadj <- cox_summary_unadj$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
results_table_list[[length(results_table_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
  `Model` = "Unadjusted",
  `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
  `P-value` = ifelse(p_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_unadj, 3)))
)

# 2. Adjusted for line of therapy
hr_line <- cox_summary_line$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
hr_line_lower <- cox_summary_line$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
hr_line_upper <- cox_summary_line$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
p_line <- cox_summary_line$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
results_table_list[[length(results_table_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
  `Model` = "Adjusted for line of therapy",
  `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_line, 2), " (", round(hr_line_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_line_upper, 2), ")"),
  `P-value` = ifelse(p_line < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_line, 3)))
)

# 3. Adjusted for KPS only
if (!is.null(cox_model_kps) && !is.null(cox_summary_kps)) {
  hr_kps <- cox_summary_kps$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
  hr_kps_lower <- cox_summary_kps$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
  hr_kps_upper <- cox_summary_kps$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
  p_kps <- cox_summary_kps$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  results_table_list[[length(results_table_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
    `Model` = "Adjusted for KPS",
    `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_kps, 2), " (", round(hr_kps_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_kps_upper, 2), ")"),
    `P-value` = ifelse(p_kps < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_kps, 3)))
  )
}

# 4. Adjusted for visceral metastases only
if (!is.null(cox_model_visceral) && !is.null(cox_summary_visceral)) {
  hr_visceral <- cox_summary_visceral$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
  hr_visceral_lower <- cox_summary_visceral$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
  hr_visceral_upper <- cox_summary_visceral$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
  p_visceral <- cox_summary_visceral$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  results_table_list[[length(results_table_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
    `Model` = "Adjusted for visceral metastases",
    `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_visceral, 2), " (", round(hr_visceral_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_visceral_upper, 2), ")"),
    `P-value` = ifelse(p_visceral < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_visceral, 3)))
  )
}

# 5a. Adjusted for line of therapy + therapy class
if (!is.null(cox_model_line_class) && !is.null(cox_summary_line_class)) {
  hr_line_class <- cox_summary_line_class$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
  hr_line_class_lower <- cox_summary_line_class$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
  hr_line_class_upper <- cox_summary_line_class$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
  p_line_class <- cox_summary_line_class$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  # Use actual N from model (this is the most accurate)
  n_line_class <- cox_model_line_class$n
  
  results_table_list[[length(results_table_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
    `Model` = "Adjusted for line of therapy and therapy class",
    `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_line_class, 2), " (", round(hr_line_class_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_line_class_upper, 2), ")"),
    `P-value` = ifelse(p_line_class < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_line_class, 3)))
  )
}

# 5. Adjusted for all (line of therapy + therapy class + KPS + visceral metastases)
if (!is.null(cox_model_multiv) && !is.null(cox_summary_multiv)) {
  hr_multiv <- cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
  hr_multiv_lower <- cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
  hr_multiv_upper <- cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
  p_multiv <- cox_summary_multiv$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  # Determine which covariates were included
  adj_text <- "line of therapy"
  if (has_therapy_class) adj_text <- paste0(adj_text, ", therapy class")
  adj_text <- paste0(adj_text, ", KPS, and visceral metastases")
  
  # Use actual N from model (this is the most accurate)
  n_multiv <- cox_model_multiv$n
  
  results_table_list[[length(results_table_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
    `Model` = paste0("Adjusted for ", adj_text),
    `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_multiv, 2), " (", round(hr_multiv_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_multiv_upper, 2), ")"),
    `P-value` = ifelse(p_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_multiv, 3)))
  )
}

# 6. Add tertile comparisons (T2 vs T1, T3 vs T1)
# Create tertiles for comparison
if (nrow(outcomes_for_model) >= 3) {
  outcomes_for_tertiles <- outcomes_for_model %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_before_line_value), !is.na(mfs_time), !is.na(mfs_event)) %>%
    mutate(
      ctdna_tertile = ntile(ctdna_before_line_value, 3),
      ctdna_tertile_label = case_when(
        ctdna_tertile == 1 ~ "T1 (Lowest)",
        ctdna_tertile == 2 ~ "T2",
        ctdna_tertile == 3 ~ "T3 (Highest)"
      ),
      ctdna_tertile_factor = factor(ctdna_tertile_label, 
                                      levels = c("T1 (Lowest)", "T2", "T3 (Highest)"))
    )
  
  # Unadjusted tertile model
  cox_tertiles_unadj <- tryCatch({
    coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_factor, data = outcomes_for_tertiles)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (!is.null(cox_tertiles_unadj)) {
    n_tert_unadj <- cox_tertiles_unadj$n  # Use actual N from model
  } else {
    n_tert_unadj <- 0
  }
  
  # Adjusted tertile model (for line of therapy)
  outcomes_for_tertiles_adj <- outcomes_for_tertiles %>%
    filter(!is.na(therapy_line_factor))
  
  cox_tertiles_adj <- tryCatch({
    coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_factor + therapy_line_factor, 
          data = outcomes_for_tertiles_adj)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (!is.null(cox_tertiles_adj)) {
    n_tert_adj <- cox_tertiles_adj$n  # Use actual N from model
  } else {
    n_tert_adj <- 0
  }
  
  # Fully adjusted tertile model (line of therapy + KPS + visceral metastases)
  cox_tertiles_multiv <- NULL
  n_tert_multiv <- 0
  if (sum(!is.na(outcomes_for_tertiles$kps_binary)) > 0 && 
      sum(!is.na(outcomes_for_tertiles$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0) {
    outcomes_tertiles_multiv <- outcomes_for_tertiles %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
    
    n_tert_multiv <- nrow(outcomes_tertiles_multiv %>%
                            filter(!is.na(mfs_time), !is.na(mfs_event)))
    
    if (nrow(outcomes_tertiles_multiv) > 0) {
      cox_tertiles_multiv <- tryCatch({
        coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_factor + therapy_line_factor + 
              kps_factor + visceral_mets_factor, 
              data = outcomes_tertiles_multiv)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(cox_tertiles_unadj)) {
    cox_tertiles_unadj_summary <- summary(cox_tertiles_unadj)
    
    # T2 vs T1 (unadjusted)
    if (nrow(cox_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients) >= 1) {
      hr_t2_unadj <- exp(cox_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "coef"])
      hr_t2_unadj_lower <- cox_tertiles_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
      hr_t2_unadj_upper <- cox_tertiles_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
      p_t2_unadj <- cox_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      n_tert_unadj <- cox_tertiles_unadj$n  # Get actual N from model
      results_table_list[[length(results_table_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "T2 vs T1 (Unadjusted)",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_t2_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_t2_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t2_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_t2_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_t2_unadj, 3)))
      )
    }
    
    # T3 vs T1 (unadjusted)
    if (nrow(cox_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients) >= 2) {
      hr_t3_unadj <- exp(cox_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients[2, "coef"])
      hr_t3_unadj_lower <- cox_tertiles_unadj_summary$conf.int[2, "lower .95"]
      hr_t3_unadj_upper <- cox_tertiles_unadj_summary$conf.int[2, "upper .95"]
      p_t3_unadj <- cox_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      results_table_list[[length(results_table_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "T3 vs T1 (Unadjusted)",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_t3_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_t3_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t3_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_t3_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_t3_unadj, 3)))
      )
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(cox_tertiles_adj)) {
    cox_tertiles_adj_summary <- summary(cox_tertiles_adj)
    
    # Find tertile coefficient indices
    tertile_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_tertiles_adj_summary$coefficients), "ctdna_tertile_factor"))
    
    # T2 vs T1 (adjusted)
    if (length(tertile_idx) >= 1) {
      hr_t2_adj <- exp(cox_tertiles_adj_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx[1], "coef"])
      hr_t2_adj_lower <- cox_tertiles_adj_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx[1], "lower .95"]
      hr_t2_adj_upper <- cox_tertiles_adj_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx[1], "upper .95"]
      p_t2_adj <- cox_tertiles_adj_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx[1], "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      results_table_list[[length(results_table_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "T2 vs T1 (Adjusted for line of therapy)",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_t2_adj, 2), " (", round(hr_t2_adj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t2_adj_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_t2_adj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_t2_adj, 3)))
      )
    }
    
    # T3 vs T1 (adjusted)
    if (length(tertile_idx) >= 2) {
      hr_t3_adj <- exp(cox_tertiles_adj_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx[2], "coef"])
      hr_t3_adj_lower <- cox_tertiles_adj_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx[2], "lower .95"]
      hr_t3_adj_upper <- cox_tertiles_adj_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx[2], "upper .95"]
      p_t3_adj <- cox_tertiles_adj_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx[2], "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      results_table_list[[length(results_table_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "T3 vs T1 (Adjusted for line of therapy)",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_t3_adj, 2), " (", round(hr_t3_adj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t3_adj_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_t3_adj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_t3_adj, 3)))
      )
    }
  }
  
  # Fully adjusted tertile models (line of therapy + KPS + visceral metastases)
  if (!is.null(cox_tertiles_multiv)) {
    # Safely check convergence
    model_converged <- tryCatch({
      isTRUE(cox_tertiles_multiv$converged)
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    
    if (model_converged) {
      cox_tertiles_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_tertiles_multiv)
      tertile_idx_multiv <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_tertiles_multiv_summary$coefficients), "ctdna_tertile_factor"))
      
      # Get N from the filtered dataset used for this model
      if (!is.null(cox_tertiles_multiv)) {
        n_tert_multiv <- cox_tertiles_multiv$n  # Use actual N from model
      } else {
        n_tert_multiv <- 0
      }
      
      # T2 vs T1 (fully adjusted)
      if (length(tertile_idx_multiv) >= 1) {
        hr_t2_multiv <- exp(cox_tertiles_multiv_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_multiv[1], "coef"])
        hr_t2_multiv_lower <- cox_tertiles_multiv_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_multiv[1], "lower .95"]
        hr_t2_multiv_upper <- cox_tertiles_multiv_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_multiv[1], "upper .95"]
        p_t2_multiv <- cox_tertiles_multiv_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_multiv[1], "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        # Check for extreme values that suggest convergence issues
        if (!is.na(hr_t2_multiv) && is.finite(hr_t2_multiv) && hr_t2_multiv > 0 && hr_t2_multiv < 1e10 &&
            !is.na(hr_t2_multiv_lower) && is.finite(hr_t2_multiv_lower) &&
            !is.na(hr_t2_multiv_upper) && is.finite(hr_t2_multiv_upper)) {
          results_table_list[[length(results_table_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Model` = "T2 vs T1 (Adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases)",
            `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_t2_multiv, 2), " (", round(hr_t2_multiv_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t2_multiv_upper, 2), ")"),
            `P-value` = ifelse(p_t2_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_t2_multiv, 3)))
          )
        }
      }
      
      # T3 vs T1 (fully adjusted)
      if (length(tertile_idx_multiv) >= 2) {
        hr_t3_multiv <- exp(cox_tertiles_multiv_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_multiv[2], "coef"])
        hr_t3_multiv_lower <- cox_tertiles_multiv_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_multiv[2], "lower .95"]
        hr_t3_multiv_upper <- cox_tertiles_multiv_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_multiv[2], "upper .95"]
        p_t3_multiv <- cox_tertiles_multiv_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_multiv[2], "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        # Check for extreme values that suggest convergence issues
        if (!is.na(hr_t3_multiv) && is.finite(hr_t3_multiv) && hr_t3_multiv > 0 && hr_t3_multiv < 1e10 &&
            !is.na(hr_t3_multiv_lower) && is.finite(hr_t3_multiv_lower) &&
            !is.na(hr_t3_multiv_upper) && is.finite(hr_t3_multiv_upper)) {
          results_table_list[[length(results_table_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Model` = "T3 vs T1 (Adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases)",
            `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_t3_multiv, 2), " (", round(hr_t3_multiv_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t3_multiv_upper, 2), ")"),
            `P-value` = ifelse(p_t3_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_t3_multiv, 3)))
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

# Get therapy line labels for use in other chunks
therapy_line_labels <- c("2L vs 1L", "3L vs 1L", "4L+ vs 1L")

# Keep hr_value for backward compatibility with other chunks
hr_value <- hr_line
hr_lower <- hr_line_lower
hr_upper <- hr_line_upper
p_value_ctdna <- p_line
cox_model <- cox_model_line
cox_summary <- cox_summary_line

# Combine all results
results_table <- bind_rows(results_table_list) %>%
  kable(caption = "Cox Proportional Hazards Model: ctDNA Level Before Therapy and Duration of Complete Response. Top section shows continuous ctDNA (Ln(ctDNA + 1)) with HR progression as covariates are added. Bottom section shows tertile comparisons (T2 vs T1, T3 vs T1) with T1 (Lowest) as reference. HR > 1 indicates shorter duration of complete response (higher risk of loss of CR or death) compared to reference.") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)

results_table
```

```{r quantitative_vs_qualitative_comparison}
# ====================================================================================
# Comparison: Quantitative (Continuous) vs Qualitative (Binary: 0 vs >0) ctDNA Models
# ====================================================================================
# This analysis compares whether a quantitative (continuous log-transformed) ctDNA 
# model is more informative than a qualitative (binary: 0 vs >0) threshold model.
# ====================================================================================

# Create binary ctDNA variable: 0 = ctDNA = 0 (negative), 1 = ctDNA > 0 (positive)
outcomes_for_model_binary <- outcomes_for_model %>%
  mutate(
    ctdna_binary = ifelse(ctdna_before_line_value == 0, 0, 1),
    ctdna_binary_factor = factor(ctdna_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("ctDNA = 0 (Negative)", "ctDNA > 0 (Positive)"))
  )

# Check distribution of ctDNA values
ctdna_distribution <- outcomes_for_model_binary %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_zero = sum(ctdna_before_line_value == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_positive = sum(ctdna_before_line_value > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_zero = round(n_zero / n_total * 100, 1),
    pct_positive = round(n_positive / n_total * 100, 1),
    median_positive = median(ctdna_before_line_value[ctdna_before_line_value > 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    q25_positive = quantile(ctdna_before_line_value[ctdna_before_line_value > 0], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75_positive = quantile(ctdna_before_line_value[ctdna_before_line_value > 0], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Display ctDNA distribution table
ctdna_dist_table <- tibble(
  `Category` = c("Total observations", "ctDNA = 0 (Negative)", "ctDNA > 0 (Positive)"),
  `N` = c(ctdna_distribution$n_total, ctdna_distribution$n_zero, ctdna_distribution$n_positive),
  `%` = c("100.0", paste0(ctdna_distribution$pct_zero, "%"), paste0(ctdna_distribution$pct_positive, "%"))
)

ctdna_dist_display <- ctdna_dist_table %>%
  kable(caption = "Distribution of Baseline ctDNA Values (Qualitative Threshold Analysis)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)

ctdna_dist_display

cat("\n")
if (ctdna_distribution$n_positive > 0) {
  cat("**Among ctDNA > 0 (Positive):** median =", round(ctdna_distribution$median_positive, 2), 
      ", IQR = [", round(ctdna_distribution$q25_positive, 2), ", ", 
      round(ctdna_distribution$q75_positive, 2), "]\n\n")
}

# Fit binary models (same structure as quantitative models)

# Model 1: Unadjusted (binary ctDNA only)
cox_binary_unadj <- tryCatch({
  coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ ctdna_binary_factor, data = outcomes_for_model_binary)
}, error = function(e) NULL)

cox_binary_unadj_summary <- NULL
if (!is.null(cox_binary_unadj)) {
  cox_binary_unadj_summary <- summary(cox_binary_unadj)
}

# Model 2: Adjusted for line of therapy
cox_binary_line <- tryCatch({
  coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ ctdna_binary_factor + therapy_line_factor, 
        data = outcomes_for_model_binary)
}, error = function(e) NULL)

cox_binary_line_summary <- NULL
if (!is.null(cox_binary_line)) {
  cox_binary_line_summary <- summary(cox_binary_line)
}

# Model 3: Multivariate (line + therapy class + KPS + visceral mets) - if available
cox_binary_multiv <- NULL
cox_binary_multiv_summary <- NULL
if (exists("cox_model_multiv") && !is.null(cox_model_multiv)) {
  # Check which covariates are available (same as quantitative model)
  has_kps_binary <- sum(!is.na(outcomes_for_model_binary$kps_binary)) > 0
  has_visceral_binary <- sum(!is.na(outcomes_for_model_binary$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0
  
  # Check therapy class sample sizes (same as quantitative model)
  therapy_class_counts_binary <- outcomes_for_model_binary %>%
    filter(!is.na(therapy_class)) %>%
    count(therapy_class) %>%
    filter(n >= 5) %>%
    pull(therapy_class)
  has_therapy_class_binary <- length(therapy_class_counts_binary) > 0
  
  if (has_kps_binary && has_visceral_binary) {
    outcomes_binary_multiv <- outcomes_for_model_binary %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
    
    if (nrow(outcomes_binary_multiv) > 0) {
      # Build formula dynamically
      formula_parts_binary <- c("ctdna_binary_factor", "therapy_line_factor")
      
      if (has_therapy_class_binary) {
        outcomes_binary_multiv <- outcomes_binary_multiv %>%
          mutate(
            therapy_class_filtered = ifelse(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_binary, therapy_class, "unspecified"),
            therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
          )
        formula_parts_binary <- c(formula_parts_binary, "therapy_class_factor_filtered")
      }
      
      formula_parts_binary <- c(formula_parts_binary, "kps_factor", "visceral_mets_factor")
      formula_str_binary <- paste("Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~", paste(formula_parts_binary, collapse = " + "))
      
      cox_binary_multiv <- tryCatch({
        coxph(as.formula(formula_str_binary), data = outcomes_binary_multiv)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(cox_binary_multiv)) {
        cox_binary_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_binary_multiv)
      }
    }
  }
}

# Create comparison table
comparison_results_list <- list()

# 1. Unadjusted models
if (!is.null(cox_binary_unadj) && !is.null(cox_binary_unadj_summary)) {
  hr_binary_unadj <- cox_binary_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
  hr_binary_unadj_lower <- cox_binary_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
  hr_binary_unadj_upper <- cox_binary_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
  p_binary_unadj <- cox_binary_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  aic_binary_unadj <- AIC(cox_binary_unadj)
  bic_binary_unadj <- BIC(cox_binary_unadj)
} else {
  hr_binary_unadj <- NA
  hr_binary_unadj_lower <- NA
  hr_binary_unadj_upper <- NA
  p_binary_unadj <- NA
  aic_binary_unadj <- NA
  bic_binary_unadj <- NA
}

if (!is.null(cox_model_unadj)) {
  aic_quant_unadj <- AIC(cox_model_unadj)
  bic_quant_unadj <- BIC(cox_model_unadj)
} else {
  aic_quant_unadj <- NA
  bic_quant_unadj <- NA
}

comparison_results_list[[length(comparison_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
  `Model Type` = "Unadjusted",
  `Quantitative HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
  `Quantitative P-value` = ifelse(p_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_unadj, 3))),
  `Quantitative AIC` = round(aic_quant_unadj, 1),
  `Quantitative BIC` = round(bic_quant_unadj, 1),
  `Qualitative HR (95% CI)` = ifelse(!is.na(hr_binary_unadj), 
                                     paste0(round(hr_binary_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_binary_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_binary_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
                                     "N/A"),
  `Qualitative P-value` = ifelse(!is.na(p_binary_unadj),
                                 ifelse(p_binary_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_binary_unadj, 3))),
                                 "N/A"),
  `Qualitative AIC` = ifelse(!is.na(aic_binary_unadj), round(aic_binary_unadj, 1), NA),
  `Qualitative BIC` = ifelse(!is.na(bic_binary_unadj), round(bic_binary_unadj, 1), NA)
)

# 2. Adjusted for line of therapy
if (!is.null(cox_binary_line) && !is.null(cox_binary_line_summary)) {
  # Find ctDNA coefficient index (may not be first if factor coding changes)
  ctdna_idx_binary <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_binary_line_summary$coefficients), "ctdna_binary_factor"))
  if (length(ctdna_idx_binary) > 0) {
    hr_binary_line <- cox_binary_line_summary$conf.int[ctdna_idx_binary[1], "exp(coef)"]
    hr_binary_line_lower <- cox_binary_line_summary$conf.int[ctdna_idx_binary[1], "lower .95"]
    hr_binary_line_upper <- cox_binary_line_summary$conf.int[ctdna_idx_binary[1], "upper .95"]
    p_binary_line <- cox_binary_line_summary$coefficients[ctdna_idx_binary[1], "Pr(>|z|)"]
  } else {
    hr_binary_line <- NA
    hr_binary_line_lower <- NA
    hr_binary_line_upper <- NA
    p_binary_line <- NA
  }
  aic_binary_line <- AIC(cox_binary_line)
  bic_binary_line <- BIC(cox_binary_line)
} else {
  hr_binary_line <- NA
  hr_binary_line_lower <- NA
  hr_binary_line_upper <- NA
  p_binary_line <- NA
  aic_binary_line <- NA
  bic_binary_line <- NA
}

if (!is.null(cox_model_line)) {
  aic_quant_line <- AIC(cox_model_line)
  bic_quant_line <- BIC(cox_model_line)
} else {
  aic_quant_line <- NA
  bic_quant_line <- NA
}

comparison_results_list[[length(comparison_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
  `Model Type` = "Adjusted for line of therapy",
  `Quantitative HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_line, 2), " (", round(hr_line_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_line_upper, 2), ")"),
  `Quantitative P-value` = ifelse(p_line < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_line, 3))),
  `Quantitative AIC` = round(aic_quant_line, 1),
  `Quantitative BIC` = round(bic_quant_line, 1),
  `Qualitative HR (95% CI)` = ifelse(!is.na(hr_binary_line),
                                     paste0(round(hr_binary_line, 2), " (", round(hr_binary_line_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_binary_line_upper, 2), ")"),
                                     "N/A"),
  `Qualitative P-value` = ifelse(!is.na(p_binary_line),
                                 ifelse(p_binary_line < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_binary_line, 3))),
                                 "N/A"),
  `Qualitative AIC` = ifelse(!is.na(aic_binary_line), round(aic_binary_line, 1), NA),
  `Qualitative BIC` = ifelse(!is.na(bic_binary_line), round(bic_binary_line, 1), NA)
)

# 3. Multivariate models (if available)
if (!is.null(cox_binary_multiv) && !is.null(cox_binary_multiv_summary)) {
  ctdna_idx_binary_multiv <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_binary_multiv_summary$coefficients), "ctdna_binary_factor"))
  if (length(ctdna_idx_binary_multiv) > 0) {
    hr_binary_multiv <- cox_binary_multiv_summary$conf.int[ctdna_idx_binary_multiv[1], "exp(coef)"]
    hr_binary_multiv_lower <- cox_binary_multiv_summary$conf.int[ctdna_idx_binary_multiv[1], "lower .95"]
    hr_binary_multiv_upper <- cox_binary_multiv_summary$conf.int[ctdna_idx_binary_multiv[1], "upper .95"]
    p_binary_multiv <- cox_binary_multiv_summary$coefficients[ctdna_idx_binary_multiv[1], "Pr(>|z|)"]
  } else {
    hr_binary_multiv <- NA
    hr_binary_multiv_lower <- NA
    hr_binary_multiv_upper <- NA
    p_binary_multiv <- NA
  }
  aic_binary_multiv <- AIC(cox_binary_multiv)
  bic_binary_multiv <- BIC(cox_binary_multiv)
} else {
  hr_binary_multiv <- NA
  hr_binary_multiv_lower <- NA
  hr_binary_multiv_upper <- NA
  p_binary_multiv <- NA
  aic_binary_multiv <- NA
  bic_binary_multiv <- NA
}

if (!is.null(cox_model_multiv) && exists("hr_multiv")) {
  aic_quant_multiv <- AIC(cox_model_multiv)
  bic_quant_multiv <- BIC(cox_model_multiv)
  
  adj_text_comparison <- "line of therapy"
  # Check if therapy class was included in quantitative model
  if (exists("has_therapy_class") && has_therapy_class) {
    adj_text_comparison <- paste0(adj_text_comparison, ", therapy class")
  } else if (has_therapy_class_binary) {
    adj_text_comparison <- paste0(adj_text_comparison, ", therapy class")
  }
  adj_text_comparison <- paste0(adj_text_comparison, ", KPS, and visceral metastases")
  
  comparison_results_list[[length(comparison_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
    `Model Type` = paste0("Adjusted for ", adj_text_comparison),
    `Quantitative HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_multiv, 2), " (", round(hr_multiv_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_multiv_upper, 2), ")"),
    `Quantitative P-value` = ifelse(p_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_multiv, 3))),
    `Quantitative AIC` = round(aic_quant_multiv, 1),
    `Quantitative BIC` = round(bic_quant_multiv, 1),
    `Qualitative HR (95% CI)` = ifelse(!is.na(hr_binary_multiv),
                                       paste0(round(hr_binary_multiv, 2), " (", round(hr_binary_multiv_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_binary_multiv_upper, 2), ")"),
                                       "N/A"),
    `Qualitative P-value` = ifelse(!is.na(p_binary_multiv),
                                   ifelse(p_binary_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_binary_multiv, 3))),
                                   "N/A"),
    `Qualitative AIC` = ifelse(!is.na(aic_binary_multiv), round(aic_binary_multiv, 1), NA),
    `Qualitative BIC` = ifelse(!is.na(bic_binary_multiv), round(bic_binary_multiv, 1), NA)
  )
}

# Combine comparison results
comparison_table <- bind_rows(comparison_results_list)

# Add direct test p-values to comparison table if available
# (Will be added after direct_comparison_table is created)
comparison_table <- comparison_table %>%
  mutate(
    `AIC Difference (Quant - Qual)` = ifelse(!is.na(`Quantitative AIC`) & !is.na(`Qualitative AIC`),
                                             round(`Quantitative AIC` - `Qualitative AIC`, 1),
                                             NA),
    `BIC Difference (Quant - Qual)` = ifelse(!is.na(`Quantitative BIC`) & !is.na(`Qualitative BIC`),
                                             round(`Quantitative BIC` - `Qualitative BIC`, 1),
                                             NA),
    `Better Model (AIC)` = case_when(
      !is.na(`AIC Difference (Quant - Qual)`) & `AIC Difference (Quant - Qual)` < -2 ~ "Quantitative",
      !is.na(`AIC Difference (Quant - Qual)`) & `AIC Difference (Quant - Qual)` > 2 ~ "Qualitative",
      !is.na(`AIC Difference (Quant - Qual)`) ~ "Similar",
      TRUE ~ "N/A"
    ),
    `Better Model (BIC)` = case_when(
      !is.na(`BIC Difference (Quant - Qual)`) & `BIC Difference (Quant - Qual)` < -2 ~ "Quantitative",
      !is.na(`BIC Difference (Quant - Qual)`) & `BIC Difference (Quant - Qual)` > 2 ~ "Qualitative",
      !is.na(`BIC Difference (Quant - Qual)`) ~ "Similar",
      TRUE ~ "N/A"
    ),
    `P-value (Quantitative Better)` = NA_character_  # Will be filled in after direct test
  )

# ====================================================================================
# Formal Statistical Tests: Comparing Quantitative vs Qualitative Models
# ====================================================================================
# Run direct comparison tests FIRST, then add p-values to comparison table
# ====================================================================================
# Perform likelihood ratio tests to formally compare model performance
# ====================================================================================

lrt_results_list <- list()

# 1. Unadjusted models comparison
if (!is.null(cox_model_unadj) && !is.null(cox_binary_unadj)) {
  # Calculate likelihood ratio test statistic
  # LRT = -2 * (log-likelihood of simpler model - log-likelihood of more complex model)
  # For non-nested models, we compare log-likelihoods directly
  ll_quant_unadj <- cox_model_unadj$loglik[2]  # Final log-likelihood
  ll_qual_unadj <- cox_binary_unadj$loglik[2]   # Final log-likelihood
  
  # Calculate test statistic (comparing which has better fit)
  # Since models have same df, we can compare log-likelihoods directly
  # Higher log-likelihood = better fit
  lrt_stat_unadj <- 2 * (ll_quant_unadj - ll_qual_unadj)
  
  # P-value: chi-square test with 0 df (same complexity, comparing fit)
  # Actually, since both models have same number of parameters, we can't use standard LRT
  # Instead, we'll use AIC/BIC differences and report the log-likelihood comparison
  lrt_pval_unadj <- NA  # Not applicable for non-nested models with same df
  
  lrt_results_list[[length(lrt_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
    `Model Type` = "Unadjusted",
    `Quantitative Log-Likelihood` = round(ll_quant_unadj, 2),
    `Qualitative Log-Likelihood` = round(ll_qual_unadj, 2),
    `Log-Likelihood Difference (Quant - Qual)` = round(ll_quant_unadj - ll_qual_unadj, 2),
    `P-value (Model Comparison)` = "N/A*"
  )
}

# 2. Adjusted for line of therapy
if (!is.null(cox_model_line) && !is.null(cox_binary_line)) {
  ll_quant_line <- cox_model_line$loglik[2]
  ll_qual_line <- cox_binary_line$loglik[2]
  
  lrt_results_list[[length(lrt_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
    `Model Type` = "Adjusted for line of therapy",
    `Quantitative Log-Likelihood` = round(ll_quant_line, 2),
    `Qualitative Log-Likelihood` = round(ll_qual_line, 2),
    `Log-Likelihood Difference (Quant - Qual)` = round(ll_quant_line - ll_qual_line, 2),
    `P-value (Model Comparison)` = "N/A*"
  )
}

# 3. Multivariate models
if (!is.null(cox_model_multiv) && !is.null(cox_binary_multiv)) {
  ll_quant_multiv <- cox_model_multiv$loglik[2]
  ll_qual_multiv <- cox_binary_multiv$loglik[2]
  
  lrt_results_list[[length(lrt_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
    `Model Type` = "Adjusted for line of therapy, therapy class, KPS, and visceral metastases",
    `Quantitative Log-Likelihood` = round(ll_quant_multiv, 2),
    `Qualitative Log-Likelihood` = round(ll_qual_multiv, 2),
    `Log-Likelihood Difference (Quant - Qual)` = round(ll_quant_multiv - ll_qual_multiv, 2),
    `P-value (Model Comparison)` = "N/A*"
  )
}

# For a more formal test, we can use Vuong test for non-nested models
# Or we can create nested models by including both variables and testing if binary adds to continuous
# Let's create a model with both continuous and binary to test if binary adds information beyond continuous

# Test: Does binary ctDNA add information beyond continuous ctDNA?
# Fit model with both continuous and binary ctDNA
if (!is.null(cox_model_unadj) && !is.null(cox_binary_unadj)) {
  # Model with continuous ctDNA only (quantitative)
  # Model with binary ctDNA only (qualitative)
  # Model with both (to test if binary adds beyond continuous)
  
  # Fit combined model (continuous + binary)
  outcomes_for_combined <- outcomes_for_model_binary %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_before_line_value), !is.na(mfs_time), !is.na(mfs_event))
  
  cox_combined_unadj <- tryCatch({
    coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1) + ctdna_binary_factor, 
          data = outcomes_for_combined)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (!is.null(cox_combined_unadj) && !is.null(cox_model_unadj)) {
    # Test if binary adds to continuous: LRT comparing continuous-only vs continuous+binary
    lrt_combined_unadj <- tryCatch({
      lrtest(cox_model_unadj, cox_combined_unadj)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(lrt_combined_unadj)) {
      # This tests if binary adds information beyond continuous
      # If p > 0.05, binary doesn't add info beyond continuous (continuous is sufficient)
      # If p < 0.05, binary adds info beyond continuous
      lrt_pval_combined_unadj <- lrt_combined_unadj$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
      
      # Update the first result with the formal test
      if (length(lrt_results_list) > 0) {
        lrt_results_list[[1]]$`P-value (Model Comparison)` <- ifelse(
          lrt_pval_combined_unadj < 0.001, 
          "<0.001", 
          as.character(round(lrt_pval_combined_unadj, 3))
        )
        lrt_results_list[[1]]$`Interpretation` <- ifelse(
          lrt_pval_combined_unadj > 0.05,
          "Binary does not add info beyond continuous (continuous sufficient)",
          "Binary adds information beyond continuous"
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Test: Does continuous add information beyond binary?
  cox_combined_reverse <- tryCatch({
    coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ ctdna_binary_factor + log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1), 
          data = outcomes_for_combined)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (!is.null(cox_combined_reverse) && !is.null(cox_binary_unadj)) {
    # Test if continuous adds to binary: LRT comparing binary-only vs binary+continuous
    lrt_combined_reverse <- tryCatch({
      lrtest(cox_binary_unadj, cox_combined_reverse)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(lrt_combined_reverse)) {
      lrt_pval_combined_reverse <- lrt_combined_reverse$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
      
      # This tests if continuous adds information beyond binary
      # If p < 0.05, continuous adds significant info beyond binary (quantitative is better)
      if (length(lrt_results_list) > 0) {
        # Add the p-value column if it doesn't exist
        if (!("P-value (Continuous adds to Binary)" %in% names(lrt_results_list[[1]]))) {
          lrt_results_list[[1]] <- lrt_results_list[[1]] %>%
            mutate(`P-value (Continuous adds to Binary)` = NA_character_)
        }
        # Update the p-value
        lrt_results_list[[1]]$`P-value (Continuous adds to Binary)`[1] <- ifelse(
          lrt_pval_combined_reverse < 0.001,
          "<0.001",
          as.character(round(lrt_pval_combined_reverse, 3))
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

# ====================================================================================
# Direct Model Performance Comparison Test
# ====================================================================================
# Test: Does quantitative model perform significantly better than qualitative model?
# We use the likelihood ratio test: Binary-only vs Binary+Continuous
# This directly tests if continuous adds significant information beyond binary
# ====================================================================================

direct_comparison_results <- list()

# Test for each model type
# 1. Unadjusted models
if (!is.null(cox_binary_unadj) && !is.null(cox_combined_reverse)) {
  # Test: Binary-only vs Binary+Continuous
  # This tests if continuous adds significant info beyond binary
  lrt_direct_unadj <- tryCatch({
    lrtest(cox_binary_unadj, cox_combined_reverse)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (!is.null(lrt_direct_unadj)) {
    lrt_stat_direct_unadj <- lrt_direct_unadj$Chisq[2]
    lrt_pval_direct_unadj <- lrt_direct_unadj$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
    df_direct_unadj <- lrt_direct_unadj$Df[2]
    
    direct_comparison_results[[length(direct_comparison_results) + 1]] <- tibble(
      `Model Type` = "Unadjusted",
      `Test` = "LRT: Binary vs Binary+Continuous",
      `Chi-square Statistic` = round(lrt_stat_direct_unadj, 3),
      `Degrees of Freedom` = df_direct_unadj,
      `P-value` = ifelse(lrt_pval_direct_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(lrt_pval_direct_unadj, 4))),
      `Interpretation` = ifelse(lrt_pval_direct_unadj < 0.05,
                                "Quantitative model significantly better (continuous adds info beyond binary)",
                                "No significant difference (binary sufficient)")
    )
  }
}

# 2. Adjusted for line of therapy
if (!is.null(cox_binary_line)) {
  # Create combined model for line-adjusted
  outcomes_for_combined_line <- outcomes_for_model_binary %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_before_line_value), !is.na(mfs_time), !is.na(mfs_event), 
           !is.na(therapy_line_factor))
  
  cox_combined_line <- tryCatch({
    coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ ctdna_binary_factor + therapy_line_factor + 
          log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1), 
          data = outcomes_for_combined_line)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (!is.null(cox_combined_line) && !is.null(cox_binary_line)) {
    lrt_direct_line <- tryCatch({
      lrtest(cox_binary_line, cox_combined_line)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(lrt_direct_line)) {
      lrt_stat_direct_line <- lrt_direct_line$Chisq[2]
      lrt_pval_direct_line <- lrt_direct_line$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
      df_direct_line <- lrt_direct_line$Df[2]
      
      direct_comparison_results[[length(direct_comparison_results) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model Type` = "Adjusted for line of therapy",
        `Test` = "LRT: Binary vs Binary+Continuous",
        `Chi-square Statistic` = round(lrt_stat_direct_line, 3),
        `Degrees of Freedom` = df_direct_line,
        `P-value` = ifelse(lrt_pval_direct_line < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(lrt_pval_direct_line, 4))),
        `Interpretation` = ifelse(lrt_pval_direct_line < 0.05,
                                  "Quantitative model significantly better (continuous adds info beyond binary)",
                                  "No significant difference (binary sufficient)")
      )
    }
  }
}

# 3. Multivariate models
if (!is.null(cox_binary_multiv)) {
  # Create combined model for multivariate
  outcomes_for_combined_multiv <- outcomes_for_model_binary %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_before_line_value), !is.na(mfs_time), !is.na(mfs_event),
           !is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary), !is.na(therapy_line_factor))
  
  # Build formula dynamically (same as binary_multiv but add continuous)
  formula_parts_combined_multiv <- c("ctdna_binary_factor", "therapy_line_factor")
  
  if (has_therapy_class_binary) {
    outcomes_for_combined_multiv <- outcomes_for_combined_multiv %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_class_filtered = ifelse(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_binary, therapy_class, "unspecified"),
        therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
      )
    formula_parts_combined_multiv <- c(formula_parts_combined_multiv, "therapy_class_factor_filtered")
  }
  
  formula_parts_combined_multiv <- c(formula_parts_combined_multiv, "kps_factor", "visceral_mets_factor", 
                                     "log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1)")
  formula_str_combined_multiv <- paste("Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~", 
                                       paste(formula_parts_combined_multiv, collapse = " + "))
  
  cox_combined_multiv <- tryCatch({
    coxph(as.formula(formula_str_combined_multiv), data = outcomes_for_combined_multiv)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  if (!is.null(cox_combined_multiv) && !is.null(cox_binary_multiv)) {
    lrt_direct_multiv <- tryCatch({
      lrtest(cox_binary_multiv, cox_combined_multiv)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(lrt_direct_multiv)) {
      lrt_stat_direct_multiv <- lrt_direct_multiv$Chisq[2]
      lrt_pval_direct_multiv <- lrt_direct_multiv$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
      df_direct_multiv <- lrt_direct_multiv$Df[2]
      
      direct_comparison_results[[length(direct_comparison_results) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model Type` = "Adjusted for line of therapy, therapy class, KPS, and visceral metastases",
        `Test` = "LRT: Binary vs Binary+Continuous",
        `Chi-square Statistic` = round(lrt_stat_direct_multiv, 3),
        `Degrees of Freedom` = df_direct_multiv,
        `P-value` = ifelse(lrt_pval_direct_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(lrt_pval_direct_multiv, 4))),
        `Interpretation` = ifelse(lrt_pval_direct_multiv < 0.05,
                                  "Quantitative model significantly better (continuous adds info beyond binary)",
                                  "No significant difference (binary sufficient)")
      )
    }
  }
}

# Display direct comparison results
if (length(direct_comparison_results) > 0) {
  direct_comparison_table <- bind_rows(direct_comparison_results)
  
  # Add p-values to main comparison table
  for (i in 1:nrow(comparison_table)) {
    model_type_comp <- comparison_table$`Model Type`[i]
    matching_row <- direct_comparison_table %>%
      filter(`Model Type` == model_type_comp)
    if (nrow(matching_row) > 0) {
      comparison_table$`P-value (Quantitative Better)`[i] <- matching_row$`P-value`[1]
    }
  }
  
  direct_comparison_display <- direct_comparison_table %>%
    kable(caption = "Direct Statistical Test: Quantitative vs Qualitative Model Performance. This likelihood ratio test compares the qualitative (binary-only) model vs a model with both binary and continuous ctDNA. A significant p-value (p < 0.05) indicates that the continuous ctDNA adds significant prognostic information beyond the binary threshold, demonstrating that the quantitative model performs significantly better.") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  
  direct_comparison_display
  
  cat("\n**Key Finding:**\n")
  # Get the most adjusted model result
  if (nrow(direct_comparison_table) > 0) {
    final_test_result <- direct_comparison_table[nrow(direct_comparison_table), ]
    final_pval <- final_test_result$`P-value`
    final_interp <- final_test_result$`Interpretation`
    
    cat("The likelihood ratio test comparing qualitative (binary-only) vs quantitative (binary+continuous) models shows: **", final_interp, "** (p = ", final_pval, ").\n", sep="")
    if (final_pval != "N/A" && (final_pval == "<0.001" || (grepl("^[0-9]", final_pval) && as.numeric(final_pval) < 0.05))) {
      cat("This provides formal statistical evidence that the quantitative model performs significantly better than the qualitative model.\n")
    }
  }
  cat("\n")
  
  # Re-display comparison table with p-values added
  cat("## Updated Comparison Table with Statistical Test P-values\n\n")
  comparison_table_display_updated <- comparison_table %>%
    kable(caption = "Comparison: Quantitative vs Qualitative Models with Statistical Test Results. P-value (Quantitative Better) from likelihood ratio test - p < 0.05 indicates quantitative model performs significantly better than qualitative model.") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  
  comparison_table_display_updated
}

# Display likelihood ratio test results (log-likelihood comparison)
if (length(lrt_results_list) > 0) {
  lrt_table <- bind_rows(lrt_results_list)
  
  # Add note about interpretation
  lrt_table_display <- lrt_table %>%
    kable(caption = "Model Comparison: Log-Likelihood Values. Higher log-likelihood indicates better model fit. Positive log-likelihood difference (Quant - Qual) favors quantitative model.") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  
  lrt_table_display
  
  cat("\n**Interpretation of Log-Likelihood Comparison:**\n")
  cat("- Higher log-likelihood = better model fit\n")
  cat("- Positive log-likelihood difference (Quant - Qual) favors quantitative model\n")
  cat("\n")
}

cat("\n## Model Comparison Summary\n\n")
cat("**AIC/BIC Interpretation:**\n")
cat("- Lower AIC/BIC indicates better model fit (penalizes complexity)\n")
cat("- Differences > 2 are considered meaningful\n")
cat("- Negative differences (Quant - Qual) favor quantitative model\n")
cat("- Positive differences favor qualitative model\n\n")

# Summary statistics
if (nrow(comparison_table) > 0) {
  for (i in 1:nrow(comparison_table)) {
    model_type <- comparison_table$`Model Type`[i]
    aic_diff <- comparison_table$`AIC Difference (Quant - Qual)`[i]
    bic_diff <- comparison_table$`BIC Difference (Quant - Qual)`[i]
    quant_pval <- comparison_table$`Quantitative P-value`[i]
    qual_pval <- comparison_table$`Qualitative P-value`[i]
    
    if (!is.na(aic_diff)) {
      cat("**", model_type, ":**\n", sep="")
      cat("  AIC difference:", aic_diff, "\n")
      if (!is.na(bic_diff)) {
        cat("  BIC difference:", bic_diff, "\n")
      }
      cat("  Quantitative model p-value:", quant_pval, "\n")
      if (!is.na(qual_pval) && qual_pval != "N/A") {
        cat("  Qualitative model p-value:", qual_pval, "\n")
      }
      if (!is.na(aic_diff) && abs(aic_diff) > 2) {
        if (aic_diff < 0) {
          cat("  → Quantitative model has better fit (AIC difference:", aic_diff, ")\n")
        } else {
          cat("  → Qualitative model has better fit (AIC difference:", aic_diff, ")\n")
        }
      } else if (!is.na(aic_diff)) {
        cat("  → Models have similar fit (AIC difference:", aic_diff, ")\n")
      }
      cat("\n")
    }
  }
}

cat("**Conclusion:**\n")
if (nrow(comparison_table) > 0 && !is.na(comparison_table$`AIC Difference (Quant - Qual)`[nrow(comparison_table)])) {
  final_aic_diff <- comparison_table$`AIC Difference (Quant - Qual)`[nrow(comparison_table)]
  final_quant_pval <- comparison_table$`Quantitative P-value`[nrow(comparison_table)]
  final_qual_pval <- comparison_table$`Qualitative P-value`[nrow(comparison_table)]
  
  # Get formal test p-value if available
  formal_test_pval <- NA
  if (exists("lrt_table") && nrow(lrt_table) > 0) {
    if ("P-value (Continuous adds to Binary)" %in% names(lrt_table)) {
      formal_test_pval <- lrt_table$`P-value (Continuous adds to Binary)`[1]
    }
  }
  
  # Determine if quantitative model is significant
  quant_significant <- !is.na(final_quant_pval) && (final_quant_pval == "<0.001" || 
    (grepl("^[0-9]", final_quant_pval) && as.numeric(final_quant_pval) < 0.05))
  
  # Determine if qualitative model is significant
  qual_significant <- !is.na(final_qual_pval) && final_qual_pval != "N/A" && 
    (final_qual_pval == "<0.001" || (grepl("^[0-9]", final_qual_pval) && as.numeric(final_qual_pval) < 0.05))
  
  # Determine if formal test shows continuous adds significant info
  formal_test_significant <- !is.na(formal_test_pval) && formal_test_pval != "N/A" && 
    (formal_test_pval == "<0.001" || (grepl("^[0-9]", formal_test_pval) && as.numeric(formal_test_pval) < 0.05))
  
  if (final_aic_diff < -2) {
    cat("The quantitative (continuous) ctDNA model provides better fit than the qualitative (binary) model (AIC difference:", final_aic_diff, "), suggesting that ctDNA level contains more prognostic information than a simple positive/negative threshold.")
    
    # Add formal test p-value if available
    if (formal_test_significant && !is.na(formal_test_pval)) {
      cat(" The formal likelihood ratio test confirms that continuous ctDNA adds significant prognostic information beyond the binary threshold (p = ", formal_test_pval, ").", sep="")
    }
    
    # Add p-value comparison
    if (quant_significant && !qual_significant) {
      cat(" Additionally, the quantitative model achieves statistical significance (p", final_quant_pval, ") while the qualitative model does not (p = ", final_qual_pval, "), providing further evidence that the continuous ctDNA value captures more prognostic information than the binary threshold.\n", sep="")
    } else if (quant_significant && qual_significant) {
      cat(" Both models achieve statistical significance, but the quantitative model has superior fit based on AIC/BIC.\n", sep="")
    } else {
      cat("\n")
    }
  } else if (final_aic_diff > 2) {
    cat("The qualitative (binary) ctDNA model provides better fit than the quantitative (continuous) model (AIC difference:", final_aic_diff, "), suggesting that a simple positive/negative threshold captures the prognostic signal adequately.")
    
    if (!is.na(formal_test_pval) && formal_test_pval != "N/A" && !formal_test_significant) {
      cat(" The formal likelihood ratio test shows that continuous ctDNA does not add significant information beyond the binary threshold (p = ", formal_test_pval, ").", sep="")
    }
    
    if (!quant_significant && qual_significant) {
      cat(" The qualitative model achieves statistical significance (p = ", final_qual_pval, ") while the quantitative model does not, supporting the use of the binary threshold.\n", sep="")
    } else {
      cat("\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("The quantitative and qualitative models have similar fit (AIC difference:", final_aic_diff, "), suggesting that both approaches capture similar prognostic information.")
    
    if (!is.na(formal_test_pval) && formal_test_pval != "N/A") {
      if (formal_test_significant) {
        cat(" However, the formal likelihood ratio test shows that continuous ctDNA adds significant information beyond binary (p = ", formal_test_pval, ").", sep="")
      } else {
        cat(" The formal likelihood ratio test shows that continuous ctDNA does not add significant information beyond binary (p = ", formal_test_pval, ").", sep="")
      }
    }
    
    if (quant_significant && !qual_significant) {
      cat(" Additionally, the quantitative model achieves statistical significance (p", final_quant_pval, ") while the qualitative model does not (p = ", final_qual_pval, "), suggesting that the continuous ctDNA value may provide additional prognostic information.\n", sep="")
    } else {
      cat(" The quantitative model may provide more granular risk stratification for positive ctDNA values.\n", sep="")
    }
  }
} else {
  cat("Comparison not available for all models.\n")
}
```

```{r multivariate_cox_pretreatment}
# ====================================================================================
# Multivariate Cox Model: Pre-treatment Analysis with Bajorin Risk Factors
# ====================================================================================
# Model includes: ctDNA + Line of Therapy + KPS + Visceral Metastases

if (!is.null(cox_model_multiv) && exists("cox_summary_multiv") && !is.null(cox_summary_multiv)) {
  # Extract coefficients from multivariate model
  n_coef <- nrow(cox_summary_multiv$coefficients)
  
  # Create results table - build as list first, then convert to tibble
  multiv_results_list <- list()
  
  # Add ctDNA coefficient
  if (n_coef > 0) {
    p_val_ctdna <- cox_summary_multiv$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    p_val_ctdna_char <- if (p_val_ctdna < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_ctdna, 3))
    multiv_results_list[[length(multiv_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
      `Variable` = "Ln(ctDNA + 1)",
      `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
        round(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"], 2), " (",
        round(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[1, "lower .95"], 2), "-",
        round(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[1, "upper .95"], 2), ")"
      ),
      `P-value` = p_val_ctdna_char
    )
  }
  
  # Add therapy line coefficients
  therapy_line_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_summary_multiv$coefficients), "therapy_line_factor"))
  if (length(therapy_line_idx) > 0) {
    for (i in seq_along(therapy_line_idx)) {
      idx <- therapy_line_idx[i]
      if (idx <= nrow(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int)) {
        p_val_line <- cox_summary_multiv$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        p_val_line_char <- if (p_val_line < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_line, 3))
        multiv_results_list[[length(multiv_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
          `Variable` = therapy_line_labels[i],
          `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
            round(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"], 2), " (",
            round(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"], 2), "-",
            round(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"], 2), ")"
          ),
          `P-value` = p_val_line_char
        )
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Add therapy class coefficients (if included in model)
  therapy_class_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_summary_multiv$coefficients), "therapy_class_factor"))
  if (length(therapy_class_idx) > 0) {
    # Get therapy class levels from the model
    if (exists("outcomes_multiv") && "therapy_class_factor_filtered" %in% names(outcomes_multiv)) {
      class_levels <- levels(outcomes_multiv$therapy_class_factor_filtered)
      # Skip reference level (first level)
      if (length(class_levels) > 1) {
        for (i in seq_along(therapy_class_idx)) {
          idx <- therapy_class_idx[i]
          if (idx <= nrow(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int) && i < length(class_levels)) {
            class_name <- class_levels[i + 1]  # Skip reference (first level)
            p_val_class <- cox_summary_multiv$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
            p_val_class_char <- if (p_val_class < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_class, 3))
            multiv_results_list[[length(multiv_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
              `Variable` = paste0("Therapy Class: ", class_name, " vs reference"),
              `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
                round(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"], 2), " (",
                round(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"], 2), "-",
                round(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"], 2), ")"
              ),
              `P-value` = p_val_class_char
            )
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Add KPS coefficient
  kps_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_summary_multiv$coefficients), "kps_factor"))
  if (length(kps_idx) > 0) {
    idx <- kps_idx[1]
    if (idx <= nrow(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int)) {
      p_val_kps <- cox_summary_multiv$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      p_val_kps_char <- if (p_val_kps < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_kps, 3))
      multiv_results_list[[length(multiv_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Variable` = "KPS ≥80% vs <80%",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
          round(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"], 2), " (",
          round(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"], 2), "-",
          round(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"], 2), ")"
        ),
        `P-value` = p_val_kps_char
      )
    }
  }
  
  # Add Visceral Metastases coefficient
  visceral_idx <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_summary_multiv$coefficients), "visceral_mets_factor"))
  if (length(visceral_idx) > 0) {
    idx <- visceral_idx[1]
    if (idx <= nrow(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int)) {
      p_val_visceral <- cox_summary_multiv$coefficients[idx, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      p_val_visceral_char <- if (p_val_visceral < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(p_val_visceral, 3))
      multiv_results_list[[length(multiv_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Variable` = "Visceral Mets vs No Visceral Mets",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(
          round(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[idx, "exp(coef)"], 2), " (",
          round(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[idx, "lower .95"], 2), "-",
          round(cox_summary_multiv$conf.int[idx, "upper .95"], 2), ")"
        ),
        `P-value` = p_val_visceral_char
      )
    }
  }
  
  # Combine all results
  multiv_results <- bind_rows(multiv_results_list)
  
  # Display table
  multiv_table <- multiv_results %>%
    kable(caption = "Multivariate Cox Model: Pre-treatment ctDNA and Metastasis-Free Survival (adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases)") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  
  multiv_table
  
  cat("\n**N for multivariate model:**", nrow(outcomes_multiv), "observations\n")
  cat("**Note:** This model includes Bajorin risk factors (KPS and visceral metastases) in addition to ctDNA level and line of therapy.\n")
} else {
  cat("Multivariate Cox model with Bajorin risk factors could not be fitted.\n")
  cat("This may be due to missing KPS or visceral metastases data, or insufficient sample size.\n")
  if (exists("bajorin_data")) {
    cat("Bajorin data loaded:", nrow(bajorin_data), "observations\n")
  } else {
    cat("Bajorin data file not found or could not be loaded.\n")
  }
}
```

```{r identify_clinical_variables, include=FALSE}
# Identify available clinical variables for multivariate analysis
# This helps determine what variables can be included in a multivariate Cox model

# Key variables to check for
key_vars <- c("race", "ethnicity", "cancer_stage_natera", 
              "pathology_t_stage_2", "pathology_n_stage_2", "pathology_m_stage_2",
              "neoadjuvant_systemic_therapy_yes_no", "dataset")

# Check data completeness for outcomes population
if (exists("outcomes") && nrow(outcomes) > 0) {
  outcomes_with_clinical <- outcomes %>%
    left_join(dat_combined %>% select(patient_id, any_of(key_vars)), by = "patient_id")
  
  # Check completeness for key variables
  var_completeness <- tibble()
  for (var_name in key_vars) {
    if (var_name %in% names(outcomes_with_clinical)) {
      n_complete <- sum(!is.na(outcomes_with_clinical[[var_name]]))
      pct_complete <- round(n_complete / nrow(outcomes_with_clinical) * 100, 1)
      var_completeness <- bind_rows(
        var_completeness,
        tibble(
          Variable = var_name,
          N_Complete = n_complete,
          N_Total = nrow(outcomes_with_clinical),
          Percent_Complete = pct_complete,
          Suitable = pct_complete >= 80
        )
      )
    }
  }
  
  # Also check for age, sex if they exist
  age_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^age$|age_at", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  sex_cols <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^sex$|^gender$", ignore_case = TRUE))]
  
  if (length(age_cols) > 0) {
    age_var <- age_cols[1]
    outcomes_with_clinical <- outcomes_with_clinical %>%
      left_join(dat_combined %>% select(patient_id, !!sym(age_var)), by = "patient_id")
    n_complete_age <- sum(!is.na(outcomes_with_clinical[[age_var]]))
    var_completeness <- bind_rows(
      var_completeness,
      tibble(
        Variable = age_var,
        N_Complete = n_complete_age,
        N_Total = nrow(outcomes_with_clinical),
        Percent_Complete = round(n_complete_age / nrow(outcomes_with_clinical) * 100, 1),
        Suitable = n_complete_age / nrow(outcomes_with_clinical) >= 0.8
      )
    )
  }
  
  if (length(sex_cols) > 0) {
    sex_var <- sex_cols[1]
    outcomes_with_clinical <- outcomes_with_clinical %>%
      left_join(dat_combined %>% select(patient_id, !!sym(sex_var)), by = "patient_id")
    n_complete_sex <- sum(!is.na(outcomes_with_clinical[[sex_var]]))
    var_completeness <- bind_rows(
      var_completeness,
      tibble(
        Variable = sex_var,
        N_Complete = n_complete_sex,
        N_Total = nrow(outcomes_with_clinical),
        Percent_Complete = round(n_complete_sex / nrow(outcomes_with_clinical) * 100, 1),
        Suitable = n_complete_sex / nrow(outcomes_with_clinical) >= 0.8
      )
    )
  }
  
  cat("Available clinical variables for multivariate analysis:\n")
  if (nrow(var_completeness) > 0) {
    print(var_completeness %>% arrange(desc(Percent_Complete)))
  } else {
    cat("No matching clinical variables found in dataset.\n")
  }
}
```

```{r tertile_ctdna_values_description}
# Describe ctDNA value ranges for each tertile group and show cutoff values
if (nrow(outcomes) >= 3) {
  outcomes_for_tertile_desc <- outcomes %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_before_line_value)) %>%
    mutate(
      ctdna_tertile = ntile(ctdna_before_line_value, 3),
      ctdna_tertile_label = case_when(
        ctdna_tertile == 1 ~ "T1 (Lowest)",
        ctdna_tertile == 2 ~ "T2",
        ctdna_tertile == 3 ~ "T3 (Highest)",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_tertile_label))
  
  # Calculate tertile cutoffs
  # The cutoff between T1 and T2 is the maximum value in T1 (also minimum of T2)
  # The cutoff between T2 and T3 is the maximum value in T2 (also minimum of T3)
  t1_max <- outcomes_for_tertile_desc %>%
    filter(ctdna_tertile == 1) %>%
    summarise(max_val = max(ctdna_before_line_value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(max_val)
  
  t2_max <- outcomes_for_tertile_desc %>%
    filter(ctdna_tertile == 2) %>%
    summarise(max_val = max(ctdna_before_line_value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(max_val)
  
  t2_min <- outcomes_for_tertile_desc %>%
    filter(ctdna_tertile == 2) %>%
    summarise(min_val = min(ctdna_before_line_value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(min_val)
  
  t3_min <- outcomes_for_tertile_desc %>%
    filter(ctdna_tertile == 3) %>%
    summarise(min_val = min(ctdna_before_line_value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pull(min_val)
  
  # Create cutoff table
  cutoff_table <- tibble(
    `Cutoff` = c("T1/T2 Boundary", "T2/T3 Boundary"),
    `ctDNA Value` = c(
      ifelse(length(t1_max) > 0 && !is.na(t1_max), 
             paste0("≤ ", round(t1_max, 2), " (T1 max) / ≥ ", round(t2_min, 2), " (T2 min)"),
             "N/A"),
      ifelse(length(t2_max) > 0 && !is.na(t2_max), 
             paste0("≤ ", round(t2_max, 2), " (T2 max) / ≥ ", round(t3_min, 2), " (T3 min)"),
             "N/A")
    )
  )
  
  cutoff_display <- cutoff_table %>%
    kable(caption = "Tertile Cutoff Values for ctDNA") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  
  cutoff_display
  
  # Also show the actual ranges
  tertile_ranges <- outcomes_for_tertile_desc %>%
    group_by(ctdna_tertile_label) %>%
    summarise(
      N = n(),
      `Min ctDNA` = round(min(ctdna_before_line_value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      `25th Percentile` = round(quantile(ctdna_before_line_value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      `Median ctDNA` = round(median(ctdna_before_line_value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      `75th Percentile` = round(quantile(ctdna_before_line_value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      `Max ctDNA` = round(max(ctdna_before_line_value, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      `Range` = paste0(round(min(ctdna_before_line_value, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
                       " - ", 
                       round(max(ctdna_before_line_value, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(match(ctdna_tertile_label, c("T1 (Lowest)", "T2", "T3 (Highest)"))) %>%
    rename(`Tertile Group` = ctdna_tertile_label)
  
  # Ensure all tertiles are shown even if empty
  all_tertiles_df <- tibble(`Tertile Group` = c("T1 (Lowest)", "T2", "T3 (Highest)"))
  tertile_ranges <- all_tertiles_df %>%
    left_join(tertile_ranges, by = "Tertile Group") %>%
    mutate(
      N = replace_na(N, 0),
      `Min ctDNA` = ifelse(N == 0, "N/A", as.character(`Min ctDNA`)),
      `25th Percentile` = ifelse(N == 0, "N/A", as.character(`25th Percentile`)),
      `Median ctDNA` = ifelse(N == 0, "N/A", as.character(`Median ctDNA`)),
      `75th Percentile` = ifelse(N == 0, "N/A", as.character(`75th Percentile`)),
      `Max ctDNA` = ifelse(N == 0, "N/A", as.character(`Max ctDNA`)),
      `Range` = ifelse(N == 0, "N/A", `Range`)
    )
  
  tertile_ranges_table <- tertile_ranges %>%
    kable(caption = "ctDNA Value Ranges by Tertile Group") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  
  tertile_ranges_table
  
  # Summary of cutoffs
  cat("\n**Tertile Cutoffs Summary:**\n")
  if (length(t1_max) > 0 && !is.na(t1_max) && length(t2_min) > 0 && !is.na(t2_min)) {
    cat("- **T1 (Lowest):** ctDNA ≤ ", round(t1_max, 2), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("- **T2:** ctDNA from ", round(t2_min, 2), " to ", round(t2_max, 2), "\n", sep = "")
    if (length(t3_min) > 0 && !is.na(t3_min)) {
      cat("- **T3 (Highest):** ctDNA ≥ ", round(t3_min, 2), "\n", sep = "")
    }
  }
  cat("\n**Note:** Tertiles are created by dividing the ctDNA values into three equal groups based on rank (ntile function). T1 (Lowest) contains the lowest third of ctDNA values, T2 contains the middle third, and T3 (Highest) contains the highest third.\n")
}
```

```{r survival_curves_by_ctdna_tertiles}
# Create tertiles of ctDNA
if (nrow(outcomes) >= 3) {
  outcomes_tertiles <- outcomes %>%
    mutate(
      mfs_time_months = mfs_time / 30.44,
      ctdna_tertile = ntile(ctdna_before_line_value, 3),
      ctdna_tertile_label = case_when(
        ctdna_tertile == 1 ~ "T1 (Lowest)",
        ctdna_tertile == 2 ~ "T2",
        ctdna_tertile == 3 ~ "T3 (Highest)"
      )
    )
  
  # Check if we have enough events per tertile
  events_per_tertile <- outcomes_tertiles %>%
    group_by(ctdna_tertile_label) %>%
    summarise(n_events = sum(mfs_event, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  if (all(events_per_tertile$n_events > 0) && nrow(events_per_tertile) > 1) {
    # Fit survival curves (months)
    surv_fit <- survfit(Surv(mfs_time_months, mfs_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_label, data = outcomes_tertiles)
    
    # Plot with 95% confidence intervals
    p <- ggsurvplot(
      surv_fit,
      data = outcomes_tertiles,
      pval = TRUE,
      conf.int = TRUE,
      conf.int.style = "ribbon",
      risk.table = TRUE,
      xlab = "Time (months)",
      ylab = "Duration of Complete Response Probability",
      title = "Duration of Complete Response by ctDNA Tertile Before Therapy",
      legend.title = "ctDNA Tertile",
      legend.labs = c("T1 (Lowest)", "T2", "T3 (Highest)"),
      xlim = c(0, 36)
    )
    
    p$plot
  } else {
    cat("Insufficient events for tertile analysis. Showing overall DCR curve instead.\n")
    surv_fit_overall <- survfit(Surv(mfs_time / 30.44, mfs_event) ~ 1, data = outcomes)
    p_overall <- ggsurvplot(
      surv_fit_overall,
      data = outcomes,
      conf.int = TRUE,
      xlab = "Time (months)",
      ylab = "Duration of Complete Response Probability",
      title = "Duration of Complete Response",
      xlim = c(0, 36)
    )
    p_overall$plot
  }
} else {
  cat("Insufficient sample size (n < 3) for tertile analysis.\n")
}
```
