```{r cox_model_tertiles_comparison, include=FALSE}
# Cox model comparing ctDNA tertiles for DCR
# Note: Tertile comparisons are now included in the main Cox model table above
# This chunk is kept for backward compatibility but results are shown in ctDNA_prognosis_analysis
if (nrow(outcomes) >= 3) {
  # Create tertiles if not already created
  if (!exists("outcomes_tertiles") || nrow(outcomes_tertiles) == 0) {
    outcomes_tertiles <- outcomes %>%
      mutate(
        mfs_time_months = mfs_time / 30.44,
        ctdna_tertile = ntile(ctdna_before_line_value, 3),
        ctdna_tertile_label = case_when(
          ctdna_tertile == 1 ~ "T1 (Lowest)",
          ctdna_tertile == 2 ~ "T2",
          ctdna_tertile == 3 ~ "T3 (Highest)"
        )
      )
  }
  
  if (exists("outcomes_tertiles") && nrow(outcomes_tertiles) >= 3) {
  # Fit Cox model with tertiles as factor (T1 as reference)
  outcomes_tertiles_factor <- outcomes_tertiles %>%
    mutate(
      ctdna_tertile_factor = factor(ctdna_tertile_label, 
                                      levels = c("T1 (Lowest)", "T2", "T3 (Highest)")),
      therapy_line_grouped = case_when(
        therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
        therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
        therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
        therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
        TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
      ),
      therapy_line_factor = factor(therapy_line_grouped, levels = c("1L", "2L", "3L", "4L+"))
    )
  
  # Unadjusted model
  cox_model_tertiles_unadj <- coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_factor, 
                                     data = outcomes_tertiles_factor)
  cox_summary_tertiles_unadj <- summary(cox_model_tertiles_unadj)
  
  # Adjusted model (for line of therapy)
  cox_model_tertiles_adj <- coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_factor + therapy_line_factor, 
                                   data = outcomes_tertiles_factor)
  cox_summary_tertiles_adj <- summary(cox_model_tertiles_adj)
  
  # Extract HRs and CIs for each tertile vs T1 (unadjusted)
  hr_t2_unadj <- exp(cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$coefficients[1, "coef"])
  hr_t2_unadj_lower <- cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
  hr_t2_unadj_upper <- cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
  p_t2_unadj <- cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  hr_t3_unadj <- exp(cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$coefficients[2, "coef"])
  hr_t3_unadj_lower <- cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$conf.int[2, "lower .95"]
  hr_t3_unadj_upper <- cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$conf.int[2, "upper .95"]
  p_t3_unadj <- cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  # Extract HRs and CIs for each tertile vs T1 (adjusted)
  # Find indices for tertile coefficients (they come after intercept if present)
  tertile_idx_adj <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_summary_tertiles_adj$coefficients), "ctdna_tertile_factor"))
  hr_t2_adj <- exp(cox_summary_tertiles_adj$coefficients[tertile_idx_adj[1], "coef"])
  hr_t2_adj_lower <- cox_summary_tertiles_adj$conf.int[tertile_idx_adj[1], "lower .95"]
  hr_t2_adj_upper <- cox_summary_tertiles_adj$conf.int[tertile_idx_adj[1], "upper .95"]
  p_t2_adj <- cox_summary_tertiles_adj$coefficients[tertile_idx_adj[1], "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  hr_t3_adj <- exp(cox_summary_tertiles_adj$coefficients[tertile_idx_adj[2], "coef"])
  hr_t3_adj_lower <- cox_summary_tertiles_adj$conf.int[tertile_idx_adj[2], "lower .95"]
  hr_t3_adj_upper <- cox_summary_tertiles_adj$conf.int[tertile_idx_adj[2], "upper .95"]
  p_t3_adj <- cox_summary_tertiles_adj$coefficients[tertile_idx_adj[2], "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  # Create comparison table
  tertile_comparisons <- tibble(
    `Comparison` = c("T2 vs T1 (Unadjusted)", "T3 vs T1 (Unadjusted)", 
                      "T2 vs T1 (Adjusted for line of therapy)", "T3 vs T1 (Adjusted for line of therapy)"),
    `HR (95% CI)` = c(
      paste0(round(hr_t2_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_t2_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t2_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
      paste0(round(hr_t3_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_t3_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t3_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
      paste0(round(hr_t2_adj, 2), " (", round(hr_t2_adj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t2_adj_upper, 2), ")"),
      paste0(round(hr_t3_adj, 2), " (", round(hr_t3_adj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t3_adj_upper, 2), ")")
    ),
    `P-value` = c(
      ifelse(p_t2_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_t2_unadj, 3))),
      ifelse(p_t3_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_t3_unadj, 3))),
      ifelse(p_t2_adj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_t2_adj, 3))),
      ifelse(p_t3_adj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_t3_adj, 3)))
    )
  )
  
  # Note: Tertile comparisons are now shown in the main Cox model table
  # This section is kept for diagnostic purposes
  cat("Tertile comparisons are included in the main Cox model table above.\n")
  
  # Overall test for trend
  cat("\n**Overall Test for Trend (Unadjusted):**\n")
  overall_p_unadj <- cox_summary_tertiles_unadj$sctest["pvalue"]
  cat("Wald test p-value:", 
      ifelse(overall_p_unadj < 0.001, 
             "<0.001", 
             round(overall_p_unadj, 3)), "\n")
  
  cat("\n**Overall Test for Trend (Adjusted for line of therapy):**\n")
  overall_p_adj <- cox_summary_tertiles_adj$sctest["pvalue"]
  cat("Wald test p-value:", 
      ifelse(overall_p_adj < 0.001, 
             "<0.001", 
             round(overall_p_adj, 3)), "\n")
  
  } else {
    cat("Insufficient data for tertile Cox model comparisons.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Insufficient sample size (n < 3) for tertile Cox model comparisons.\n")
}
```

```{r pairwise_tertile_comparisons}
# Pairwise comparisons between tertiles using Cox models
if (exists("outcomes_tertiles") && nrow(outcomes_tertiles) >= 3) {
  # Fit Cox model with tertiles as factor (T1 as reference)
  outcomes_tertiles_factor <- outcomes_tertiles %>%
    mutate(
      ctdna_tertile_factor = factor(ctdna_tertile_label, 
                                      levels = c("T1 (Lowest)", "T2", "T3 (Highest)"))
    )
  
  cox_model_tertiles <- coxph(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_factor, 
                                data = outcomes_tertiles_factor)
  cox_summary_tertiles <- summary(cox_model_tertiles)
  
  # Extract HRs and CIs for each tertile vs T1
  hr_t2 <- exp(cox_summary_tertiles$coefficients[1, "coef"])
  hr_t2_lower <- cox_summary_tertiles$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
  hr_t2_upper <- cox_summary_tertiles$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
  p_t2 <- cox_summary_tertiles$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  hr_t3 <- exp(cox_summary_tertiles$coefficients[2, "coef"])
  hr_t3_lower <- cox_summary_tertiles$conf.int[2, "lower .95"]
  hr_t3_upper <- cox_summary_tertiles$conf.int[2, "upper .95"]
  p_t3 <- cox_summary_tertiles$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  
  tertile_comparisons <- tibble(
    `Comparison` = c("T2 vs T1", "T3 vs T1"),
    `HR (95% CI)` = c(
      paste0(round(hr_t2, 2), " (", round(hr_t2_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t2_upper, 2), ")"),
      paste0(round(hr_t3, 2), " (", round(hr_t3_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_t3_upper, 2), ")")
    ),
    `P-value` = c(
      ifelse(p_t2 < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_t2, 3)),
      ifelse(p_t3 < 0.001, "<0.001", round(p_t3, 3))
    )
  )
  
  # Also do pairwise log-rank tests
  pairwise_logrank <- tryCatch(
    pairwise_survdiff(Surv(mfs_time, mfs_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_label, 
                      data = outcomes_tertiles),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  # Create pairwise comparison table with log-rank p-values
  if (!is.null(pairwise_logrank) && !is.null(pairwise_logrank$p.value)) {
    pval_matrix <- pairwise_logrank$p.value
    # Extract p-values safely - check matrix dimensions
    n_rows <- nrow(pval_matrix)
    n_cols <- ncol(pval_matrix)
    
    # Get p-values for T2, T3 vs T1 (row 1, columns 2, 3)
    pval_t2 <- if (n_rows >= 1 && n_cols >= 2 && !is.na(pval_matrix[1, 2])) {
      if (pval_matrix[1, 2] < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(pval_matrix[1, 2], 3))
    } else "N/A"
    pval_t3 <- if (n_rows >= 1 && n_cols >= 3 && !is.na(pval_matrix[1, 3])) {
      if (pval_matrix[1, 3] < 0.001) "<0.001" else as.character(round(pval_matrix[1, 3], 3))
    } else "N/A"
    
    pairwise_table <- tertile_comparisons %>%
      mutate(`Log-rank P-value` = c(pval_t2, pval_t3))
  } else {
    pairwise_table <- tertile_comparisons %>%
      mutate(`Log-rank P-value` = c("N/A", "N/A"))
  }
  
  pairwise_table_display <- pairwise_table %>%
    kable(caption = "Pairwise Comparisons: ctDNA Tertiles vs. T1 (Lowest)") %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  
  pairwise_table_display
  
  # Overall test for trend
  cat("\n**Overall Test for Trend:**\n")
  overall_p <- cox_summary_tertiles$sctest["pvalue"]
  cat("Wald test p-value:", 
      ifelse(overall_p < 0.001, 
             "<0.001", 
             round(overall_p, 3)), "\n")
  
} else {
  cat("Insufficient data for pairwise tertile comparisons.\n")
}
```

```{r sensitivity_analysis_censored_as_events}
# Sensitivity Analysis: Treat censored observations as events (worst-case scenario)
# This addresses the question: "What if all censored patients had events?"

outcomes_sensitivity <- outcomes %>%
  mutate(
    mfs_event_sensitivity = 1,  # Treat all as events
    mfs_time_sensitivity = mfs_time  # Keep same time
  )

# Cox model treating all censored as events
outcomes_sensitivity <- outcomes_sensitivity %>%
  mutate(
    therapy_line_grouped = case_when(
      therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
      therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
      therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
      therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
      TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
    ),
    therapy_line_factor = factor(therapy_line_grouped, levels = c("1L", "2L", "3L", "4L+"))
  )

cox_model_sensitivity <- coxph(Surv(mfs_time_sensitivity, mfs_event_sensitivity) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1) + therapy_line_factor,
                                data = outcomes_sensitivity)
cox_summary_sensitivity <- summary(cox_model_sensitivity)

# Extract HR and CI for sensitivity analysis
hr_sens_value <- exp(cox_summary_sensitivity$coefficients[1, "coef"])
hr_sens_lower <- cox_summary_sensitivity$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
hr_sens_upper <- cox_summary_sensitivity$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]

# Compare results
sensitivity_comparison <- tibble(
  `Analysis` = c("Standard (Censored)", "Sensitivity (All Events)"),
  `HR (95% CI)` = c(
    paste0(
      round(hr_value, 2),
      " (",
      round(hr_lower, 2),
      "-",
      round(hr_upper, 2),
      ")"
    ),
    paste0(
      round(hr_sens_value, 2),
      " (",
      round(hr_sens_lower, 2),
      "-",
      round(hr_sens_upper, 2),
      ")"
    )
  ),
  `P-value` = c(
    ifelse(cox_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, 
           "<0.001", 
           round(cox_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3)),
    ifelse(cox_summary_sensitivity$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, 
           "<0.001", 
           round(cox_summary_sensitivity$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3))
  ),
    `N Events` = c(
    sum(outcomes$mfs_event, na.rm = TRUE),
    nrow(outcomes_sensitivity)
  )
) %>%
  kable(caption = "Sensitivity Analysis: Treating Censored Observations as Events (Worst-Case Scenario)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)

sensitivity_comparison
```

## Secondary Analysis: Time to Next Treatment

**What is the association between baseline ctDNA level before starting a new line of therapy and time to next treatment?**

This secondary analysis examines whether baseline ctDNA levels (measured within 21 days before starting therapy) are associated with time to next treatment. Time to next treatment is defined as the time from therapy initiation until the start of the next line of therapy or death, whichever occurs first.

```{r time_to_next_treatment_setup_q1, include=FALSE}
# ====================================================================================
# TIME TO NEXT TREATMENT ANALYSIS FOR QUESTION 1
# ====================================================================================
# Time to next treatment = time from therapy start to next therapy line OR death
# Event = 1 if patient started next therapy OR died
# Censored = 0 if patient is alive and hasn't started next therapy by last follow-up
# ====================================================================================

# For each patient-line observation, find the next therapy line
# Next therapy = therapy_line + 1 for the same patient
next_therapy_data_q1 <- all_palliative_therapy_lines %>%
  arrange(patient_id, therapy_line) %>%
  group_by(patient_id) %>%
  mutate(
    next_therapy_line = lead(therapy_line),
    next_therapy_start_date = lead(therapy_start_date)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(patient_id, therapy_line, next_therapy_line, next_therapy_start_date)

# Get death dates and last follow-up dates (already defined above, but ensure they're available)
death_date_cols_ttnt <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^death_date$|death.*date$", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                       !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("cause|reason", ignore_case = TRUE))]
survival_cols_ttnt <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("last.*follow.*up.*date|follow.*up.*date", ignore_case = TRUE)) & 
                                     !str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("death", ignore_case = TRUE))]
alive_cols_ttnt <- names(dat_combined)[str_detect(names(dat_combined), regex("^alive_yes_no$|alive.*yes.*no", ignore_case = TRUE))]

# Create time to next treatment outcomes for baseline analysis
outcomes_ttnt_q1 <- outcomes %>%
  select(patient_id, therapy_line, time_zero_date, ctdna_before_line_value) %>%
  # Join with next therapy data
  left_join(next_therapy_data_q1, by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line")) %>%
  # Join with death and follow-up data
  left_join(
    dat_combined %>%
      select(patient_id, all_of(c(death_date_cols_ttnt, survival_cols_ttnt, alive_cols_ttnt))),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    death_date = if (length(death_date_cols_ttnt) > 0) {
      as_date_safe(.data[[death_date_cols_ttnt[1]]])
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    last_fu_date = if (length(survival_cols_ttnt) > 0) {
      as_date_safe(.data[[survival_cols_ttnt[1]]])
    } else {
      as.Date(NA)
    },
    alive_status = if (length(alive_cols_ttnt) > 0) {
      case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols_ttnt[1]]])), "yes|y|1") ~ "Yes",
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(.data[[alive_cols_ttnt[1]]])), "no|n|0") ~ "No",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    },
    # Time 0 for TTNT analysis = therapy start date (time_zero_date)
    # Event date = next therapy start date OR death date, whichever comes first
    event_date = case_when(
      !is.na(next_therapy_start_date) & !is.na(death_date) ~ 
        pmin(next_therapy_start_date, death_date, na.rm = TRUE),
      !is.na(next_therapy_start_date) ~ next_therapy_start_date,
      !is.na(death_date) ~ death_date,
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    ),
    # Censor date = last follow-up if no event
    censor_date = case_when(
      !is.na(event_date) ~ event_date,
      !is.na(last_fu_date) ~ last_fu_date,
      TRUE ~ as.Date(NA)
    ),
    # TTNT time = time from therapy start to event/censor
    ttnt_time = as.numeric(censor_date - time_zero_date),
    # TTNT event = 1 if next therapy started OR death occurred
    ttnt_event = case_when(
      !is.na(next_therapy_start_date) & !is.na(death_date) ~ 
        ifelse(next_therapy_start_date <= death_date, 1, 1),  # Both are events
      !is.na(next_therapy_start_date) ~ 1,  # Next therapy started
      !is.na(death_date) ~ 1,  # Death occurred
      TRUE ~ 0  # Censored (alive, no next therapy)
    ),
    # Event type for clarity
    event_type = case_when(
      !is.na(next_therapy_start_date) & !is.na(death_date) & next_therapy_start_date <= death_date ~ "Next Therapy",
      !is.na(next_therapy_start_date) & !is.na(death_date) & death_date < next_therapy_start_date ~ "Death",
      !is.na(next_therapy_start_date) ~ "Next Therapy",
      !is.na(death_date) ~ "Death",
      TRUE ~ "Censored"
    )
  ) %>%
  # Filter: require valid TTNT time
  filter(!is.na(ttnt_time), ttnt_time > 0)

cat("Time to Next Treatment Analysis Setup (Question 1):\n")
cat("Patients in baseline analysis:", nrow(outcomes), "\n")
cat("Patients with valid TTNT data:", nrow(outcomes_ttnt_q1), "\n")
cat("TTNT events (next therapy or death):", sum(outcomes_ttnt_q1$ttnt_event, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("TTNT censored (alive, no next therapy):", sum(outcomes_ttnt_q1$ttnt_event == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Median TTNT time (days):", round(median(outcomes_ttnt_q1$ttnt_time, na.rm = TRUE), 0), "\n")
```

```{r time_to_next_treatment_analysis_q1, include=FALSE}
# ====================================================================================
# TIME TO NEXT TREATMENT ANALYSIS: Baseline ctDNA and TTNT
# ====================================================================================
# Perform Cox models for TTNT with baseline ctDNA as predictor
# ====================================================================================

if (exists("outcomes_ttnt_q1") && nrow(outcomes_ttnt_q1) > 0) {
  # Prepare data for models (similar to DCR analysis)
  outcomes_ttnt_for_model <- outcomes_ttnt_q1 %>%
    # Join therapy class
    left_join(
      palliative_regimen_table %>%
        mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(is.na(therapy_line_match), NA_integer_, therapy_line_match)) %>%
        select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, therapy_class) %>%
        distinct(),
      by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line" = "therapy_line_match")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      therapy_line_grouped = case_when(
        therapy_line == 1 ~ "1L",
        therapy_line == 2 ~ "2L",
        therapy_line == 3 ~ "3L",
        therapy_line >= 4 ~ "4L+",
        TRUE ~ as.character(therapy_line)
      ),
      therapy_line_factor = factor(therapy_line_grouped, levels = c("1L", "2L", "3L", "4L+")),
      therapy_class = replace_na(therapy_class, "unspecified"),
      therapy_class_factor = factor(therapy_class)
    )
  
  # Join Bajorin risk factors if available
  # IMPORTANT: Normalize therapy lines >= 4 to 4 for matching
  if (exists("bajorin_data") && nrow(bajorin_data) > 0) {
    bajorin_data_normalized_ttnt <- bajorin_data %>%
      mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(therapy_line >= 4, 4, therapy_line))
    
    outcomes_ttnt_for_model <- outcomes_ttnt_for_model %>%
      mutate(therapy_line_match = ifelse(therapy_line >= 4, 4, therapy_line)) %>%
      left_join(
        bajorin_data_normalized_ttnt %>% select(patient_id, therapy_line_match, kps_binary, visceral_mets_binary),
        by = c("patient_id", "therapy_line_match")
      ) %>%
      select(-therapy_line_match) %>%
      mutate(
        kps_factor = factor(kps_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("KPS <80%", "KPS ≥80%")),
        visceral_mets_factor = factor(visceral_mets_binary, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Visceral Mets", "Visceral Mets"))
      )
  } else {
    outcomes_ttnt_for_model <- outcomes_ttnt_for_model %>%
      mutate(
        kps_binary = NA_real_,
        visceral_mets_binary = NA_real_,
        kps_factor = factor(NA, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("KPS <80%", "KPS ≥80%")),
        visceral_mets_factor = factor(NA, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No Visceral Mets", "Visceral Mets"))
      )
  }
  
  # Filter to observations with baseline ctDNA
  outcomes_ttnt_for_model <- outcomes_ttnt_for_model %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_before_line_value))
  
  # Model 1: Unadjusted (ctDNA only)
  # Count complete cases
  outcomes_ttnt_unadj <- outcomes_ttnt_for_model %>%
    filter(!is.na(ttnt_time), !is.na(ttnt_event))
  n_ttnt_unadj <- nrow(outcomes_ttnt_unadj)
  
  cox_ttnt_unadj <- tryCatch({
    coxph(Surv(ttnt_time, ttnt_event) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1), 
          data = outcomes_ttnt_for_model)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  cox_ttnt_unadj_summary <- NULL
  if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_unadj)) {
    cox_ttnt_unadj_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_unadj)
  }
  
  # Model 2: Adjusted for line of therapy
  # Count complete cases
  outcomes_ttnt_line <- outcomes_ttnt_for_model %>%
    filter(!is.na(ttnt_time), !is.na(ttnt_event), !is.na(therapy_line_factor))
  n_ttnt_line <- nrow(outcomes_ttnt_line)
  
  cox_ttnt_line <- tryCatch({
    coxph(Surv(ttnt_time, ttnt_event) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1) + therapy_line_factor, 
          data = outcomes_ttnt_for_model)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  cox_ttnt_line_summary <- NULL
  if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_line)) {
    cox_ttnt_line_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_line)
  }
  
  # Model 3: Adjusted for line of therapy + therapy class
  # Filter therapy classes with sufficient sample size
  therapy_class_counts_ttnt <- outcomes_ttnt_for_model %>%
    filter(!is.na(therapy_class)) %>%
    count(therapy_class) %>%
    filter(n >= 5) %>%
    pull(therapy_class)
  
  outcomes_ttnt_line_class <- outcomes_ttnt_for_model %>%
    filter(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_ttnt | is.na(therapy_class))
  
  cox_ttnt_line_class <- NULL
  cox_ttnt_line_class_summary <- NULL
  n_ttnt_line_class <- 0
  if (nrow(outcomes_ttnt_line_class) > 0 && length(therapy_class_counts_ttnt) > 0) {
    outcomes_ttnt_line_class <- outcomes_ttnt_line_class %>%
      mutate(
        therapy_class_filtered = ifelse(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_ttnt, therapy_class, "unspecified"),
        therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
      )
    
    cox_ttnt_line_class <- tryCatch({
      coxph(Surv(ttnt_time, ttnt_event) ~ log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1) + 
            therapy_line_factor + therapy_class_factor_filtered, 
            data = outcomes_ttnt_line_class)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_line_class)) {
      cox_ttnt_line_class_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_line_class)
      n_ttnt_line_class <- cox_ttnt_line_class$n  # Use actual N from model
    } else {
      n_ttnt_line_class <- 0
    }
  }
  
  # Model 4: Multivariate (line + therapy class + KPS + visceral mets)
  # Use flexible model building
  has_kps_ttnt <- sum(!is.na(outcomes_ttnt_for_model$kps_binary)) > 0
  has_visceral_ttnt <- sum(!is.na(outcomes_ttnt_for_model$visceral_mets_binary)) > 0
  has_therapy_class_ttnt <- length(therapy_class_counts_ttnt) > 0
  
  cox_ttnt_adj <- NULL
  cox_ttnt_adj_summary <- NULL
  outcomes_ttnt_multiv <- outcomes_ttnt_for_model %>% filter(FALSE)
  n_ttnt_adj <- 0
  
  if (has_kps_ttnt && has_visceral_ttnt) {
    outcomes_ttnt_multiv <- outcomes_ttnt_for_model %>%
      filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
    
    if (nrow(outcomes_ttnt_multiv) > 0) {
      # Build formula dynamically
      formula_parts_ttnt <- c("log10(ctdna_before_line_value + 1)", "therapy_line_factor")
      
      if (has_therapy_class_ttnt) {
        outcomes_ttnt_multiv <- outcomes_ttnt_multiv %>%
          mutate(
            therapy_class_filtered = ifelse(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_ttnt, therapy_class, "unspecified"),
            therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
          )
        formula_parts_ttnt <- c(formula_parts_ttnt, "therapy_class_factor_filtered")
      }
      
      formula_parts_ttnt <- c(formula_parts_ttnt, "kps_factor", "visceral_mets_factor")
      formula_str_ttnt <- paste("Surv(ttnt_time, ttnt_event) ~", paste(formula_parts_ttnt, collapse = " + "))
      
      cox_ttnt_adj <- tryCatch({
        coxph(as.formula(formula_str_ttnt), data = outcomes_ttnt_multiv)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_adj)) {
        cox_ttnt_adj_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_adj)
        n_ttnt_adj <- cox_ttnt_adj$n  # Use actual N from model
      } else {
        n_ttnt_adj <- 0
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Add tertile comparisons (T2 vs T1, T3 vs T1) for TTNT
  if (nrow(outcomes_ttnt_for_model) >= 3) {
    outcomes_ttnt_for_tertiles <- outcomes_ttnt_for_model %>%
      filter(!is.na(ctdna_before_line_value), !is.na(ttnt_time), !is.na(ttnt_event)) %>%
      mutate(
        ctdna_tertile = ntile(ctdna_before_line_value, 3),
        ctdna_tertile_label = case_when(
          ctdna_tertile == 1 ~ "T1 (Lowest)",
          ctdna_tertile == 2 ~ "T2",
          ctdna_tertile == 3 ~ "T3 (Highest)"
        ),
        ctdna_tertile_factor = factor(ctdna_tertile_label, 
                                        levels = c("T1 (Lowest)", "T2", "T3 (Highest)"))
      )
    
    # Unadjusted tertile model
    cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj <- tryCatch({
      coxph(Surv(ttnt_time, ttnt_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_factor, data = outcomes_ttnt_for_tertiles)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj)) {
      n_ttnt_tert_unadj <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj$n  # Use actual N from model
    } else {
      n_ttnt_tert_unadj <- 0
    }
    
    # Adjusted tertile model (for line of therapy)
    outcomes_ttnt_tertiles_adj <- outcomes_ttnt_for_tertiles %>%
      filter(!is.na(therapy_line_factor))
    
    cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj <- tryCatch({
      coxph(Surv(ttnt_time, ttnt_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_factor + therapy_line_factor, 
            data = outcomes_ttnt_tertiles_adj)
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
    
    if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj)) {
      n_ttnt_tert_adj <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj$n  # Use actual N from model
    } else {
      n_ttnt_tert_adj <- 0
    }
    
    # Fully adjusted tertile model (line + therapy class + KPS + visceral mets)
    cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv <- NULL
    n_ttnt_tert_multiv <- 0
    if (has_kps_ttnt && has_visceral_ttnt) {
      outcomes_ttnt_tertiles_multiv <- outcomes_ttnt_for_tertiles %>%
        filter(!is.na(kps_binary), !is.na(visceral_mets_binary))
      
      if (nrow(outcomes_ttnt_tertiles_multiv) > 0) {
        formula_parts_ttnt_tert <- c("ctdna_tertile_factor", "therapy_line_factor")
        
        if (has_therapy_class_ttnt) {
          outcomes_ttnt_tertiles_multiv <- outcomes_ttnt_tertiles_multiv %>%
            mutate(
              therapy_class_filtered = ifelse(therapy_class %in% therapy_class_counts_ttnt, therapy_class, "unspecified"),
              therapy_class_factor_filtered = factor(therapy_class_filtered)
            )
          formula_parts_ttnt_tert <- c(formula_parts_ttnt_tert, "therapy_class_factor_filtered")
        }
        
        formula_parts_ttnt_tert <- c(formula_parts_ttnt_tert, "kps_factor", "visceral_mets_factor")
        formula_str_ttnt_tert <- paste("Surv(ttnt_time, ttnt_event) ~", paste(formula_parts_ttnt_tert, collapse = " + "))
        
        cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv <- tryCatch({
          coxph(as.formula(formula_str_ttnt_tert), data = outcomes_ttnt_tertiles_multiv)
        }, error = function(e) NULL)
        
        if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv)) {
          n_ttnt_tert_multiv <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv$n  # Use actual N from model
        } else {
          n_ttnt_tert_multiv <- 0
        }
      } else {
        n_ttnt_tert_multiv <- 0
      }
    } else {
      n_ttnt_tert_multiv <- 0
    }
  } else {
    cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj <- NULL
    cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj <- NULL
    cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv <- NULL
    outcomes_ttnt_for_tertiles <- outcomes_ttnt_for_model %>% filter(FALSE)
  }
  
  cat("TTNT Cox Models:\n")
  cat("Unadjusted model:", ifelse(!is.null(cox_ttnt_unadj), "Fitted", "Not fitted"), "\n")
  cat("Adjusted for line:", ifelse(!is.null(cox_ttnt_line), "Fitted", "Not fitted"), "\n")
  cat("Adjusted for line + class:", ifelse(!is.null(cox_ttnt_line_class), "Fitted", "Not fitted"), "\n")
  cat("Multivariate model:", ifelse(!is.null(cox_ttnt_adj), "Fitted", "Not fitted"), "\n")
} else {
  cox_ttnt_unadj <- NULL
  cox_ttnt_line <- NULL
  cox_ttnt_line_class <- NULL
  cox_ttnt_adj <- NULL
  cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj <- NULL
  cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj <- NULL
  cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv <- NULL
  outcomes_ttnt_for_tertiles <- outcomes_ttnt_for_model %>% filter(FALSE)
  cat("TTNT analysis not available - insufficient data.\n")
}
```

```{r ttnt_results_table_q1}
# Display TTNT Cox model results
if (exists("cox_ttnt_unadj") && !is.null(cox_ttnt_unadj) && 
    exists("cox_ttnt_unadj_summary") && !is.null(cox_ttnt_unadj_summary)) {
  
  # Build results table
  ttnt_results_list <- list()
  
  # Unadjusted
  if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_unadj_summary)) {
    hr_ttnt_unadj <- cox_ttnt_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_ttnt_unadj_lower <- cox_ttnt_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_ttnt_unadj_upper <- cox_ttnt_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_ttnt_unadj <- cox_ttnt_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
      ttnt_results_list[[length(ttnt_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "Unadjusted",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_ttnt_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_ttnt_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_ttnt_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_ttnt_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_ttnt_unadj, 3)))
      )
  }
  
  # Adjusted for line
  if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_line) && !is.null(cox_ttnt_line_summary)) {
    hr_ttnt_line <- cox_ttnt_line_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_ttnt_line_lower <- cox_ttnt_line_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_ttnt_line_upper <- cox_ttnt_line_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_ttnt_line <- cox_ttnt_line_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    ttnt_results_list[[length(ttnt_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
      `Model` = "Adjusted for line of therapy",
      `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_ttnt_line, 2), " (", round(hr_ttnt_line_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_ttnt_line_upper, 2), ")"),
      `P-value` = ifelse(p_ttnt_line < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_ttnt_line, 3)))
    )
  }
  
  # Adjusted for line + class
  if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_line_class) && !is.null(cox_ttnt_line_class_summary)) {
    hr_ttnt_line_class <- cox_ttnt_line_class_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_ttnt_line_class_lower <- cox_ttnt_line_class_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_ttnt_line_class_upper <- cox_ttnt_line_class_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_ttnt_line_class <- cox_ttnt_line_class_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    ttnt_results_list[[length(ttnt_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
      `Model` = "Adjusted for line of therapy and therapy class",
      `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_ttnt_line_class, 2), " (", round(hr_ttnt_line_class_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_ttnt_line_class_upper, 2), ")"),
      `P-value` = ifelse(p_ttnt_line_class < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_ttnt_line_class, 3)))
    )
  }
  
  # Multivariate
  if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_adj) && !is.null(cox_ttnt_adj_summary)) {
    hr_ttnt_adj <- cox_ttnt_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_ttnt_adj_lower <- cox_ttnt_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_ttnt_adj_upper <- cox_ttnt_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_ttnt_adj <- cox_ttnt_adj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    
    adj_text_ttnt <- "line of therapy"
    if (has_therapy_class_ttnt) adj_text_ttnt <- paste0(adj_text_ttnt, ", therapy class")
    adj_text_ttnt <- paste0(adj_text_ttnt, ", KPS, and visceral metastases")
    
    ttnt_results_list[[length(ttnt_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
      `Model` = paste0("Adjusted for ", adj_text_ttnt),
      `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_ttnt_adj, 2), " (", round(hr_ttnt_adj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_ttnt_adj_upper, 2), ")"),
      `P-value` = ifelse(p_ttnt_adj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_ttnt_adj, 3)))
    )
  }
  
  # Add tertile comparisons (T2 vs T1, T3 vs T1) for TTNT
  if (exists("cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj") && !is.null(cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj)) {
    cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj)
    
    # T2 vs T1 (unadjusted)
    if (nrow(cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients) >= 1) {
      hr_ttnt_t2_unadj <- exp(cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "coef"])
      hr_ttnt_t2_unadj_lower <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
      hr_ttnt_t2_unadj_upper <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
      p_ttnt_t2_unadj <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      ttnt_results_list[[length(ttnt_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "T2 vs T1 (Unadjusted)",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_ttnt_t2_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_ttnt_t2_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_ttnt_t2_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_ttnt_t2_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_ttnt_t2_unadj, 3)))
      )
    }
    
    # T3 vs T1 (unadjusted)
    if (nrow(cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients) >= 2) {
      hr_ttnt_t3_unadj <- exp(cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients[2, "coef"])
      hr_ttnt_t3_unadj_lower <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj_summary$conf.int[2, "lower .95"]
      hr_ttnt_t3_unadj_upper <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj_summary$conf.int[2, "upper .95"]
      p_ttnt_t3_unadj <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_unadj_summary$coefficients[2, "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      ttnt_results_list[[length(ttnt_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "T3 vs T1 (Unadjusted)",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_ttnt_t3_unadj, 2), " (", round(hr_ttnt_t3_unadj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_ttnt_t3_unadj_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_ttnt_t3_unadj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_ttnt_t3_unadj, 3)))
      )
    }
  }
  
  # Check if fully adjusted tertile models are available first (prioritize these)
  fully_adj_ttnt_available <- FALSE
  if (exists("cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv") && !is.null(cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv)) {
    model_converged_ttnt <- tryCatch({
      isTRUE(cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv$converged)
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)
    
    if (model_converged_ttnt) {
      cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv)
      tertile_idx_ttnt_multiv <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv_summary$coefficients), "ctdna_tertile_factor"))
      
      # T2 vs T1 (fully adjusted)
      if (length(tertile_idx_ttnt_multiv) >= 1) {
        hr_ttnt_t2_multiv <- exp(cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_ttnt_multiv[1], "coef"])
        hr_ttnt_t2_multiv_lower <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_ttnt_multiv[1], "lower .95"]
        hr_ttnt_t2_multiv_upper <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_ttnt_multiv[1], "upper .95"]
        p_ttnt_t2_multiv <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_ttnt_multiv[1], "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        if (!is.na(hr_ttnt_t2_multiv) && is.finite(hr_ttnt_t2_multiv) && hr_ttnt_t2_multiv > 0 && hr_ttnt_t2_multiv < 1e10 &&
            !is.na(hr_ttnt_t2_multiv_lower) && is.finite(hr_ttnt_t2_multiv_lower) &&
            !is.na(hr_ttnt_t2_multiv_upper) && is.finite(hr_ttnt_t2_multiv_upper)) {
          
          adj_text_ttnt_tert <- "line of therapy"
          if (has_therapy_class_ttnt) adj_text_ttnt_tert <- paste0(adj_text_ttnt_tert, ", therapy class")
          adj_text_ttnt_tert <- paste0(adj_text_ttnt_tert, ", KPS, and visceral metastases")
          
          ttnt_results_list[[length(ttnt_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Model` = paste0("T2 vs T1 (Adjusted for ", adj_text_ttnt_tert, ")"),
            `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_ttnt_t2_multiv, 2), " (", round(hr_ttnt_t2_multiv_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_ttnt_t2_multiv_upper, 2), ")"),
            `P-value` = ifelse(p_ttnt_t2_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_ttnt_t2_multiv, 3)))
          )
          fully_adj_ttnt_available <- TRUE
        }
      }
      
      # T3 vs T1 (fully adjusted)
      if (length(tertile_idx_ttnt_multiv) >= 2) {
        hr_ttnt_t3_multiv <- exp(cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_ttnt_multiv[2], "coef"])
        hr_ttnt_t3_multiv_lower <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_ttnt_multiv[2], "lower .95"]
        hr_ttnt_t3_multiv_upper <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_ttnt_multiv[2], "upper .95"]
        p_ttnt_t3_multiv <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_multiv_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_ttnt_multiv[2], "Pr(>|z|)"]
        
        if (!is.na(hr_ttnt_t3_multiv) && is.finite(hr_ttnt_t3_multiv) && hr_ttnt_t3_multiv > 0 && hr_ttnt_t3_multiv < 1e10 &&
            !is.na(hr_ttnt_t3_multiv_lower) && is.finite(hr_ttnt_t3_multiv_lower) &&
            !is.na(hr_ttnt_t3_multiv_upper) && is.finite(hr_ttnt_t3_multiv_upper)) {
          
          adj_text_ttnt_tert <- "line of therapy"
          if (has_therapy_class_ttnt) adj_text_ttnt_tert <- paste0(adj_text_ttnt_tert, ", therapy class")
          adj_text_ttnt_tert <- paste0(adj_text_ttnt_tert, ", KPS, and visceral metastases")
          
          ttnt_results_list[[length(ttnt_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
            `Model` = paste0("T3 vs T1 (Adjusted for ", adj_text_ttnt_tert, ")"),
            `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_ttnt_t3_multiv, 2), " (", round(hr_ttnt_t3_multiv_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_ttnt_t3_multiv_upper, 2), ")"),
            `P-value` = ifelse(p_ttnt_t3_multiv < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_ttnt_t3_multiv, 3)))
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  # If fully adjusted models not available, fall back to line-adjusted models
  if (!fully_adj_ttnt_available && exists("cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj") && !is.null(cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj)) {
    cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj_summary <- summary(cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj)
    
    # Find tertile coefficient indices
    tertile_idx_ttnt <- which(str_detect(rownames(cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj_summary$coefficients), "ctdna_tertile_factor"))
    
    # T2 vs T1 (adjusted for line only)
    if (length(tertile_idx_ttnt) >= 1) {
      hr_ttnt_t2_adj <- exp(cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_ttnt[1], "coef"])
      hr_ttnt_t2_adj_lower <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_ttnt[1], "lower .95"]
      hr_ttnt_t2_adj_upper <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_ttnt[1], "upper .95"]
      p_ttnt_t2_adj <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_ttnt[1], "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      ttnt_results_list[[length(ttnt_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "T2 vs T1 (Adjusted for line of therapy)",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_ttnt_t2_adj, 2), " (", round(hr_ttnt_t2_adj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_ttnt_t2_adj_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_ttnt_t2_adj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_ttnt_t2_adj, 3)))
      )
    }
    
    # T3 vs T1 (adjusted for line only)
    if (length(tertile_idx_ttnt) >= 2) {
      hr_ttnt_t3_adj <- exp(cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_ttnt[2], "coef"])
      hr_ttnt_t3_adj_lower <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_ttnt[2], "lower .95"]
      hr_ttnt_t3_adj_upper <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj_summary$conf.int[tertile_idx_ttnt[2], "upper .95"]
      p_ttnt_t3_adj <- cox_ttnt_tertiles_adj_summary$coefficients[tertile_idx_ttnt[2], "Pr(>|z|)"]
      
      ttnt_results_list[[length(ttnt_results_list) + 1]] <- tibble(
        `Model` = "T3 vs T1 (Adjusted for line of therapy)",
        `HR (95% CI)` = paste0(round(hr_ttnt_t3_adj, 2), " (", round(hr_ttnt_t3_adj_lower, 2), "-", round(hr_ttnt_t3_adj_upper, 2), ")"),
        `P-value` = ifelse(p_ttnt_t3_adj < 0.001, "<0.001", as.character(round(p_ttnt_t3_adj, 3)))
      )
    }
  }
  
  if (length(ttnt_results_list) > 0) {
    ttnt_results_table <- bind_rows(ttnt_results_list) %>%
      kable(caption = "Cox Proportional Hazards Model: Baseline ctDNA Level and Time to Next Treatment. HR > 1 indicates shorter time to next treatment (higher risk of starting next therapy or death) compared to reference.") %>%
      kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
    
    ttnt_results_table
  } else {
    cat("Time to Next Treatment Cox model results not available.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Time to Next Treatment analysis results table not available.\n")
  cat("Unadjusted model not available or did not converge.\n")
}
```

```{r ttnt_survival_curves_q1}
# Kaplan-Meier curves for TTNT by ctDNA tertiles
if (exists("outcomes_ttnt_q1") && nrow(outcomes_ttnt_q1) >= 3) {
  outcomes_ttnt_tertiles <- outcomes_ttnt_q1 %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctdna_before_line_value)) %>%
    mutate(
      ttnt_time_months = ttnt_time / 30.44,
      ctdna_tertile = ntile(ctdna_before_line_value, 3),
      ctdna_tertile_label = case_when(
        ctdna_tertile == 1 ~ "T1 (Lowest)",
        ctdna_tertile == 2 ~ "T2",
        ctdna_tertile == 3 ~ "T3 (Highest)"
      )
    )
  
  # Check if we have enough events per tertile
  events_per_tertile_ttnt <- outcomes_ttnt_tertiles %>%
    group_by(ctdna_tertile_label) %>%
    summarise(n_events = sum(ttnt_event, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  
  if (all(events_per_tertile_ttnt$n_events > 0) && nrow(events_per_tertile_ttnt) > 1) {
    # Fit survival curves (months)
    surv_fit_ttnt <- survfit(Surv(ttnt_time_months, ttnt_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_label, 
                              data = outcomes_ttnt_tertiles)
    
    # Calculate p-value
    logrank_test_ttnt <- survdiff(Surv(ttnt_time_months, ttnt_event) ~ ctdna_tertile_label, 
                                   data = outcomes_ttnt_tertiles)
    logrank_pvalue_ttnt <- 1 - pchisq(logrank_test_ttnt$chisq, length(logrank_test_ttnt$n) - 1)
    pval_text_ttnt <- ifelse(logrank_pvalue_ttnt < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                             as.character(round(logrank_pvalue_ttnt, 3)))
    
    # Plot with 95% confidence intervals
    p_ttnt <- ggsurvplot(
      surv_fit_ttnt,
      data = outcomes_ttnt_tertiles,
      pval = paste0("p = ", pval_text_ttnt),
      conf.int = TRUE,
      conf.int.style = "ribbon",
      risk.table = TRUE,
      xlab = "Time (months)",
      ylab = "Time to Next Treatment Probability",
      title = "Time to Next Treatment by Baseline ctDNA Tertile",
      legend.title = "ctDNA Tertile",
      legend.labs = c("T1 (Lowest)", "T2", "T3 (Highest)"),
      xlim = c(0, 36)
    )
    
    p_ttnt$plot
  } else {
    cat("Insufficient events for tertile analysis. Showing overall TTNT curve instead.\n")
    surv_fit_overall_ttnt <- survfit(Surv(ttnt_time / 30.44, ttnt_event) ~ 1, 
                                      data = outcomes_ttnt_q1)
    p_overall_ttnt <- ggsurvplot(
      surv_fit_overall_ttnt,
      data = outcomes_ttnt_q1,
      conf.int = TRUE,
      xlab = "Time (months)",
      ylab = "Time to Next Treatment Probability",
      title = "Time to Next Treatment",
      xlim = c(0, 36)
    )
    p_overall_ttnt$plot
  }
} else {
  cat("Insufficient sample size (n < 3) for TTNT tertile analysis.\n")
}
```

```{r ttnt_interpretation_q1}
cat("## Time to Next Treatment Interpretation\n\n")
cat("**Interpretation:**\n")

if (exists("cox_ttnt_unadj") && !is.null(cox_ttnt_unadj) && 
    exists("cox_ttnt_unadj_summary") && !is.null(cox_ttnt_unadj_summary)) {
  
  hr_ttnt_to_use <- cox_ttnt_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
  hr_ttnt_lower_to_use <- cox_ttnt_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
  hr_ttnt_upper_to_use <- cox_ttnt_unadj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
  p_ttnt_to_use <- cox_ttnt_unadj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
  adjustment_text_ttnt <- "unadjusted"
  
  # Use multivariate if available
  if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_adj) && !is.null(cox_ttnt_adj_summary)) {
    hr_ttnt_to_use <- cox_ttnt_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_ttnt_lower_to_use <- cox_ttnt_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_ttnt_upper_to_use <- cox_ttnt_adj_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_ttnt_to_use <- cox_ttnt_adj_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    adj_text_ttnt <- "line of therapy"
    if (has_therapy_class_ttnt) adj_text_ttnt <- paste0(adj_text_ttnt, ", therapy class")
    adjustment_text_ttnt <- paste0("adjusted for ", adj_text_ttnt, ", KPS, and visceral metastases")
  } else if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_line_class) && !is.null(cox_ttnt_line_class_summary)) {
    hr_ttnt_to_use <- cox_ttnt_line_class_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_ttnt_lower_to_use <- cox_ttnt_line_class_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_ttnt_upper_to_use <- cox_ttnt_line_class_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_ttnt_to_use <- cox_ttnt_line_class_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    adjustment_text_ttnt <- "adjusted for line of therapy and therapy class"
  } else if (!is.null(cox_ttnt_line) && !is.null(cox_ttnt_line_summary)) {
    hr_ttnt_to_use <- cox_ttnt_line_summary$conf.int[1, "exp(coef)"]
    hr_ttnt_lower_to_use <- cox_ttnt_line_summary$conf.int[1, "lower .95"]
    hr_ttnt_upper_to_use <- cox_ttnt_line_summary$conf.int[1, "upper .95"]
    p_ttnt_to_use <- cox_ttnt_line_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"]
    adjustment_text_ttnt <- "adjusted for line of therapy"
  }
  
  if (hr_ttnt_to_use > 1 && hr_ttnt_lower_to_use > 1) {
    cat("Higher baseline ctDNA levels before starting a new line of therapy are significantly associated with shorter time to next treatment (HR = ", 
        round(hr_ttnt_to_use, 2), ", 95% CI: ", round(hr_ttnt_lower_to_use, 2), "-", 
        round(hr_ttnt_upper_to_use, 2), "), ", adjustment_text_ttnt, ". ", sep="")
    cat("This finding suggests that baseline ctDNA level may serve as a prognostic biomarker for time to next treatment outcomes.\n")
  } else if (hr_ttnt_to_use > 1) {
    cat("Higher baseline ctDNA levels show a trend toward shorter time to next treatment (HR = ", 
        round(hr_ttnt_to_use, 2), ", 95% CI: ", round(hr_ttnt_lower_to_use, 2), "-", 
        round(hr_ttnt_upper_to_use, 2), "), though the confidence interval includes 1.0.\n", sep="")
  } else if (hr_ttnt_to_use < 1 && hr_ttnt_upper_to_use < 1) {
    cat("Higher baseline ctDNA levels are significantly associated with longer time to next treatment (HR = ", 
        round(hr_ttnt_to_use, 2), ", 95% CI: ", round(hr_ttnt_lower_to_use, 2), "-", 
        round(hr_ttnt_upper_to_use, 2), "), which is counterintuitive and warrants further investigation.\n", sep="")
  } else {
    cat("There is no significant association between baseline ctDNA level and time to next treatment (HR = ", 
        round(hr_ttnt_to_use, 2), ", 95% CI: ", round(hr_ttnt_lower_to_use, 2), "-", 
        round(hr_ttnt_upper_to_use, 2), "), ", adjustment_text_ttnt, ".\n", sep="")
  }
} else {
  cat("Time to Next Treatment analysis could not be completed because the Cox models did not converge or produced extreme HR values.\n")
}
```

```{r summary_q1}
# Summary statistics for Question 1
cat("## Summary\n\n")
cat("**Universe - Prognostic Cohort (Baseline ctDNA Analysis):** Patients with metastatic disease starting a new line of therapy\n")
cat("  - Includes all lines of therapy (1L, 2L, 3L+, not limited to first-line)\n")
cat("  - ctDNA measured within 21 days before starting each new line\n")
cat("  - Time 0 = start of each new line of therapy\n")
cat("  - **N =", nrow(outcomes), " patient-line observations\n\n")

cat("**Key Findings - Prognostic (Baseline ctDNA):**\n")
cat("- Median ctDNA before therapy:", round(median(outcomes$ctdna_before_line_value, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
# Use fully adjusted model (line of therapy + KPS + visceral metastases) if available
if (!is.null(cox_model_multiv) && exists("hr_multiv") && !is.na(hr_multiv)) {
  cat("- Hazard Ratio per log10-unit increase in ctDNA (adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases):", 
      round(hr_multiv, 2), 
      " (95% CI: ", 
      round(hr_multiv_lower, 2), 
      "-", 
      round(hr_multiv_upper, 2), 
      ")\n")
  cat("- P-value:", ifelse(p_multiv < 0.001, 
                            "<0.001", 
                            round(p_multiv, 3)), "\n\n")
} else {
  # Fall back to model adjusted for line of therapy only
  cat("- Hazard Ratio per log10-unit increase in ctDNA (adjusted for line of therapy):", 
      round(hr_value, 2), 
      " (95% CI: ", 
      round(hr_lower, 2), 
      "-", 
      round(hr_upper, 2), 
      ")\n")
  cat("- P-value:", ifelse(cox_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"] < 0.001, 
                            "<0.001", 
                            round(cox_summary$coefficients[1, "Pr(>|z|)"], 3)), "\n\n")
}

cat("**Interpretation:**\n")
# Use multivariate HR if available, otherwise fall back to line-adjusted HR
hr_to_use <- if (!is.null(cox_model_multiv) && exists("hr_multiv") && !is.na(hr_multiv)) hr_multiv else hr_value
hr_lower_to_use <- if (!is.null(cox_model_multiv) && exists("hr_multiv_lower") && !is.na(hr_multiv_lower)) hr_multiv_lower else hr_lower
hr_upper_to_use <- if (!is.null(cox_model_multiv) && exists("hr_multiv_upper") && !is.na(hr_multiv_upper)) hr_multiv_upper else hr_upper
adjustment_text <- if (!is.null(cox_model_multiv) && exists("hr_multiv") && !is.na(hr_multiv)) 
  "adjusted for line of therapy, KPS, and visceral metastases" else "adjusted for line of therapy"

if (hr_to_use > 1 && hr_lower_to_use > 1) {
  cat("Higher ctDNA levels before starting a new line of therapy are significantly associated with worse duration of complete response (HR = ", round(hr_to_use, 2), ", 95% CI: ", round(hr_lower_to_use, 2), "-", round(hr_upper_to_use, 2), "), ", adjustment_text, ". ", sep="")
  cat("This finding suggests that ctDNA level before therapy initiation may serve as a prognostic biomarker for duration of complete response outcomes across multiple lines of therapy in patients with metastatic urothelial carcinoma.\n")
} else if (hr_to_use > 1) {
  cat("Higher ctDNA levels before starting a new line of therapy show a trend toward worse duration of complete response (HR = ", round(hr_to_use, 2), ", 95% CI: ", round(hr_lower_to_use, 2), "-", round(hr_upper_to_use, 2), "), though the confidence interval includes 1.0, indicating the association may not be statistically significant.\n", sep="")
} else if (hr_to_use < 1 && hr_upper_to_use < 1) {
  cat("Higher ctDNA levels before starting a new line of therapy are significantly associated with better duration of complete response (HR = ", round(hr_to_use, 2), ", 95% CI: ", round(hr_lower_to_use, 2), "-", round(hr_upper_to_use, 2), "), which is counterintuitive and warrants further investigation.\n", sep="")
} else {
  cat("There is no significant association between ctDNA level before starting a new line of therapy and duration of complete response (HR = ", round(hr_to_use, 2), ", 95% CI: ", round(hr_lower_to_use, 2), "-", round(hr_upper_to_use, 2), "), ", adjustment_text, ".\n", sep="")
}
```
